source_string: Add-Ons are a content type available in the Minecraft Marketplace that lets you add custom blocks, items, mobs, recipes, and other game content to your world.
translation: Add-Ons binne in ynhâldstype beskikber yn de Minecraft Marketplace dat jo tastiet om oanpaste blokken, items, mobs, resepten, en oare spulynhâld ta te foegjen oan jo wrâld.

source_string: Add-Ons allow you to modify your existing worlds and Realms through the Edit World screen and the Create New World screen.
translation: Add-Ons litte jo jo besteande wrâlden en Realms oanpasse fia it skerm Wrâld bewurkje en it skerm Nije wrâld oanmeitsje.

source_string: Stacking, or adding multiple Add-Ons, can increase loading times, and could result in unexpected results.
translation: Stapeljen, of it tafoegjen fan meardere Add-Ons, kin ladetiden ferheegje, en kin ûnferwachte resultaten opsmite.

source_string: We recommend that you save a copy of your world or Realm before adding or removing Add-Ons.
translation: Wy riede oan om in kopy fan jo wrâld of realm te bewarje foardatsto Add-Ons tafoegest of fuortsmytst.

source_string: For more information about how you can make the most out of Add-Ons, you can visit our FAQ page.
translation: Foar mear ynformaasje oer hoe jo it measte út Add-Ons helje kinne, kinne jo ús FAQ-side besykje.

source_string: Adventure Mode is a gamemode for world builders. In Adventure Mode, players must use special tools to place or break blocks.
translation: Adventure-modus is in spulmodus foar wrâldbouwers. Yn Adventure-modus moatte spilers spesjaal ark brûke om blokken te setten of te brekken.

source_string: To get these special tools, you must use §e/give§f with §ecanplace§f or §ecandestroy§f parameters while in creative mode.
translation: Om dit spesjale ark te krijen, moatst §e/give§f mei §ecanplace§f of §ecandestroy§f-parameters brûke wylst yn creative-modus.

source_string: Experience Levels can be used to repair, enchant, or rename items with the Anvil.
translation: Erfaringsnivo's kinne brûkt wurde om items te reparearje, te betsjoenen, of te omneame mei it Ambyld.

source_string: All items can be renamed, although only items with durability can be repaired or enchanted with Books on the Anvil.
translation: Alle items kinne omneamd wurde, alhoewol allinnich items mei duorsumheid reparearre of betsjoene wurde kinne mei boeken op it Ambyld.

source_string: An item can be repaired by placing it in one of the input slots on the left, along with either some raw materials of the item, like Iron Ingots for an Iron Sword, or combined with another item of the same type.
translation: In item kin reparearre wurde troch it yn ien fan de ynfierslots links te setten, tegearre mei óf wat rou materiaal fan it item, lykas Izeryngots foar in Izersword, óf kombinearre mei in oar item fan itselde type.

source_string: Combining items is more efficient when done with an Anvil.
translation: It kombinearjen fan items is effisjinter mei in Ambyld.

source_string: There is a chance that the Anvil will be damaged with each use and after enough usage it will be destroyed.
translation: Der is in kâns dat it Ambyld skeind wurdt mei elke brûk en nei genôch gebrûk sil it fernield wurde.

source_string: By wearing Armor, you can protect yourself from incoming damage. Your Armor level is represented by :armor: on the HUD, the higher the level, the less damage you will take.
translation: Troch bepantsering te dragen, kinne jo dysels beskermje tsjin ynkommende skea. Jo bepantseringsnivo wurdt toand troch :armor: op de HUD, hoe heger it nivo, hoe minder skea jo krije.

source_string: Armor can be crafted from Leather, Iron, Gold, or Diamond. Chainmail Armor can be obtained through villager trading and loot from zombies and skeletons.
translation: Bepantsering kin makke wurde fan learen, izer, goud, of diamant. Kettingbepantsering kin krigen wurde troch doarpelingehannel en plunder fan sombys en skeletten.

source_string: Equip Armor by opening your inventory and moving pieces of Armor to the appropriate slot next to your player skin.
translation: Doch bepantsering oan troch jo ynventaris te iepenjen en stikken bepantsering nei it passende slot neist jo spilerskin te ferpleatsen.

source_string: Iron, Chainmail, and Golden Armor can be smelted into Iron or Gold Nuggets in a Furnace.
translation: Izer-, ketting-, en golden bepantsering kinne smoltsjen wurde nei izer- of goudklompkes yn in fornús.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press and hold :_input_key.sneak: to block with the Shield.
translation: It Skyld sil ynkommende skea blokkearje. It Skyld kin oandien wurde yn it oare-hânslot lykas ek de hotbar. Hâld :_input_key.sneak: yndrukt om te blokkearjen mei it Skyld.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or press :_gamepad_stick_right: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: It Skyld sil ynkommende skea blokkearje. It Skyld kin oandien wurde yn it oare-hânslot lykas ek de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of druk :_gamepad_stick_right: om te wikseljen tusken blokkearje mei it Skyld.

source_string: The Shield blocks all kinds of incoming damage - even a Creeper explosion! It can be equipped in the offhand slot or the hotbar.
translation: It Skyld blokkearret alle soarten ynkommende skea - sels in Creeperûntploffing! It kin oandien wurde yn it oare-hânslot of de hotbar.

source_string: When using the "D-Pad & tap to interact" control scheme, tap :touch_sneak: to toggle blocking with the shield.
translation: By gebrûk fan de "D-pad & tikke om te ynteraksje"-bestjoerskema, tik :touch_sneak: om te wikseljen tusken blokkearje mei it skyld.

source_string: When using a "Joystick" control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to toggle blocking with the shield.
translation: By gebrûk fan in "Joystick"-bestjoerskema, tik :tip_virtual_button_sneak: om te wikseljen tusken blokkearje mei it skyld.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or click :rift_X: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: It Skyld sil ynkommende skea blokkearje. It Skyld kin oandien wurde yn it oare-hânslot lykas ek de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of klik :rift_X: om te wikseljen tusken blokkearje mei it Skyld.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or click :windowsmr_right_stick: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: It Skyld sil ynkommende skea blokkearje. It Skyld kin oandien wurde yn it oare-hânslot lykas ek de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of klik :windowsmr_right_stick: om te wikseljen tusken blokkearje mei it Skyld.

source_string: The Shield can even block a Creeper explosion!
translation: It Skyld kin sels in Creeperûntploffing blokkearje!

source_string: You can also wear a Carved Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.
translation: Jo kinne ek in útholde pompoen op jo kop drage. Dit jout dy gjin :armor:, mar makket dat Endermen net lilk wurde as jo har oansjocht.

source_string: An Armor Stand holds your armor while you aren't using it.
translation: In Bepantseringsstander hâldt jo bepantsering wylst jo it net brûke.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand while holding a piece of armor to place it on the Armor Stand.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Bepantseringsstander wylst jo in stik bepantsering hâlde om it op de Bepantseringsstander te setten.

source_string: Tap an Armor Stand while holding a piece of armor to place it on the Armor Stand.
translation: Tap in Bepantseringsstander wylst jo in stik bepantsering hâlde om it op de Bepantseringsstander te setten.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand with an open hand to remove something from the Armor Stand.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Bepantseringsstander mei in lege hân om wat fan de Bepantseringsstander fuort te heljen.

source_string: Tap an Armor Stand with an open hand to remove something from the Armor Stand.
translation: Tap in Bepantseringsstander mei in lege hân om wat fan de Bepantseringsstander fuort te heljen.

source_string: An Armor Stand can change its pose, sneak and press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand to change the pose.
translation: In Bepantseringsstander kin syn poaze feroarje, slûp en druk :_input_key.use: op in Bepantseringsstander om de poaze te feroarjen.

source_string: An Armor Stand can change its pose, sneak and tap an Armor Stand to change the pose.
translation: In Bepantseringsstander kin syn poaze feroarje, slûp en tap in Bepantseringsstander om de poaze te feroarjen.

source_string: Armor Stands will react to a Redstone signal, try giving it different signal strengths and see what happens.
translation: Bepantseringsstanders reagearje op in Redstone-sinjaal, probearje it ferskillende sinjaalstrekten te jaan en sjoch wat der bart.

source_string: Banners are a cool way to decorate your house or castle with custom patterns and colors.
translation: Banieren binne in coole manier om jo hûs of kastiel te fersieren mei oanpaste patroanen en kleuren.

source_string: After crafting a Banner, you can put it on a Crafting Table or Loom and add different dyes to create your own unique, cool design!
translation: Nei it meitsjen fan in Banier, kinne jo it op in Wurkbank of Weefgetou sette en ferskillende ferve tafoegje om jo eigen unike, coole ûntwerp te meitsjen!

source_string: There are many different patterns that you can create with your dye such as:
translation: Der binne in soad ferskillende patroanen dy'st mei jo ferve meitsje kinne, sa as:

source_string: - Making a triangle will give you a chevron pattern.
translation: - It meitsjen fan in trijehoeke jout dy in chevron-patroan.

source_string: - Making a cross gives you a cross pattern.
translation: - It meitsjen fan in krús jout dy in krúspatroan.

source_string: - Use an Oxeye Daisy to craft a flower pattern.
translation: - Brûk in Margryt om in bloempatroan te meitsjen.

source_string: Experiment with different combinations to get even more patterns!
translation: Experimintearje mei ferskillende kombinaasjes om noch mear patroanen te krijen!

source_string: A Banner can also have multiple layers, allowing you to have more than one pattern on your Banner. If you don't like the last pattern you put on a Banner, you can wash the last layer off in a Cauldron.
translation: In Banier kin ek meardere lagen hawwe, sadat jo mear as ien patroan op jo Banier hawwe kinne. As jo it lêste patroan dat jo op in Banier setten hawwe net leuk fine, kinne jo de lêste laach ôfwaskje yn in Kachel.

source_string: If you want to copy a Banner, put it on the Crafting Table with a blank Banner.
translation: As jo in Banier kopiearje wolle, set it op de Wurkbank mei in liuwe Banier.

source_string: Active Beacons project a bright beam of light into the sky.
translation: Aktive Beakens projektearje in helder ljochtbûndel de loft yn.

source_string: They are crafted with Glass, Obsidian, and Nether Stars (which is obtained by defeating the Wither).
translation: Se wurde makke mei glês, obsidian, en Netherstjerren (dy krigen wurde troch de Wither te ferslaan).

source_string: Beacons need to be on top of a Pyramid of Iron, Gold, Emerald, Diamond, or Netherite blocks with an unobstructed view of the sky.
translation: Beakens moatte op'e top fan in piramide fan izer-, goud-, emeraud-, diamant-, of Netherite-blokken stean mei in frije útsjoch nei de loft.

source_string: The material that the Beacon is placed on has no effect on the power of the Beacon.
translation: It materiaal wêrop it Beaken delset wurdt hat gjin effekt op de krêft fan it Beaken.

source_string: In the Beacon menu you can select one primary power for your Beacon. The more tiers your pyramid has the more powers you can have.
translation: Yn it Beakenmenu kinsto ien primêre krêft foar jo Beaken selektearje. Hoe mear lagen jo piramide hat, hoe mear krêften jo hawwe kinne.

source_string: To set the powers of your Beacon you must use a Netherite Ingot, Emerald, Diamond, Gold Ingot, or Iron Ingot in the payment slot.
translation: Om de krêften fan jo Beaken yn te stellen, moatst in Netherite-yngot, emeraud, diamant, goudyngot, of izeryngot yn it betelslot brûke.

source_string: Once set, the powers will emanate from the Beacon indefinitely. Powers are granted to all nearby players.
translation: Ienris ynsteld, sille de krêften fan it Beaken ûneindich útstrale. Krêften wurde jûn oan alle spilers yn de omkriten.

source_string: To change the color of the beam, place a stained glass block in its path.
translation: Om de kleur fan de bûndel te feroarjen, set in kleure glêsblok yn syn paad.

source_string: Sleeping in a Bed passes the night and sets your spawn point.
translation: Sliepen yn in Bêd lit de nacht foarbygean en stelt jo spawnpunt yn.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Bed to go to sleep. This can only be done at night.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Bêd om te sliepen. Dit kin allinnich by nacht dien wurde.

source_string: Tap a Bed to go to sleep. This can only be done at night.
translation: Tap in Bêd om te sliepen. Dit kin allinnich by nacht dien wurde.

source_string: If you are playing Multiplayer, everyone in the world must be in a Bed at the same time to pass the night.
translation: As jo Multyspiler spylje, moat elkenien yn de wrâld op itselde stuit yn in Bêd wêze om de nacht te litte foarbygean.

source_string: If your Bed is broken you will return to where you first spawned into the world.
translation: As jo Bêd brutsen is, geane jo werom nei wêr jo earst yn de wrâld spawnearren.

source_string: Be careful when using a Bed in the Nether, it's usually too hot to sleep.
translation: Wês foarsichtich by it brûken fan in Bêd yn de Nether, it is meastentiids te hjit om te sliepen.

source_string: A soft bed lets you sleep through the night. You'll need wool to craft one, as well as a safe spot to place it.
translation: In sêft bêd lit dy troch de nacht sliepe. Jo hawwe wol nedich om ien te meitsjen, en ek in feilich plak om it delte setten.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed will also set your §espawn point§f, meaning that if you die, you'll reappear right back home!
translation: Sliepen yn in bêd sil ek jo §espawnpunt§f ynstelle, wat betsjut dat as jo deagean, jo werom komme rjocht by thús!

source_string: You can only fall asleep when it's cozy, like when it's nighttime or during a thunderstorm.
translation: Jo kinne allinnich yn'e sliep falle as it noflik is, sa as by nacht of tidens in ûnwaar.

source_string: The world of Minecraft is made from millions of blocks. Each one is breakable, collectable, and placeable. There are almost no limits to what you can build!
translation: De wrâld fan Minecraft is makke fan miljoenen blokken. Elk is brekbar, sammelber, en delsetber. Der binne hast gjin limiten oan wat jo bouwe kinne!

source_string: Most blocks you will have to find in the world, but some can only be crafted such as combining other blocks on a crafting table like a Redstone Block or smelted in a furnace like Glass.
translation: De measte blokken moatst yn de wrâld fine, mar guon kinne allinnich makke wurde troch oare blokken op in wurkbank te kombinearjen sa as in Redstoneblok of smoltsjen wurde yn in fornús sa as glês.

source_string: Most blocks are not affected by gravity and can float in mid air, but some like Sand and Gravel, will fall if there is no block underneath them.
translation: De measte blokken wurde net beynfloede troch swiertekrêft en kinne yn'e loft sweve, mar guon sa as sân en gravel, sille falle as der gjin blok ûnder harren is.

source_string: Here are some examples of the more interesting blocks in Minecraft:
translation: Hjir binne guon foarbylden fan de mear ynteressante blokken yn Minecraft:

source_string: §eGlass§f - This is a transparent block that is made by smelting Sand in a Furnace.
translation: §eGlês§f - Dit is in trochsichtich blok dat makke wurdt troch sân te smoltsjen yn in Fornús.

source_string: §eConcrete§f - This is made by dropping a Concrete Powder block into water.
translation: §eBeton§f - Dit wurdt makke troch in betonpoeierblok yn wetter te smiten.

source_string: §eTerracotta§f - This is found naturally in Badlands biomes or can be crafted and dyed from Clay that is found underwater. Terracotta can be made into Glazed Terracotta by smelting it in a Furnace.
translation: §eTerrakotta§f - Dit wurdt natuerlik fûn yn Badlands-biomen of kin makke en ferve wurde fan klaai fûn ûnder wetter. Terrakotta kin makke wurde ta glaseare terrakotta troch it te smoltsjen yn in Fornús.

source_string: §eMagma Block§f - This is found naturally in the Nether, it gives off a little light and will burn whoever steps on it.
translation: §eMagmablok§f - Dit wurdt natuerlik fûn yn de Nether, it jout in lyts ljocht ôf en sil elkenien deroan barne dy't der op stapt.

source_string: §eCoarse Dirt§f - This is almost like a normal Dirt block but Grass can't grow on it. It can be found in Windswept Savanna and Old Growth Taiga biomes.
translation: §eGriezelich modder§f - Dit is hast lykas in normale modderblok mar der kin gjin gêrs op groeie. It kin fûn wurde yn Windswept Savanna- en Old Growth Taiga-biomen.

source_string: The Book and Quill lets you record your adventures. Tell your story by entering text into the pages. You can even change the title and the author! Sign the Book and Quill to finalize your work. The Book and Quill will be editable until it is signed.
translation: It Boek en fear lit dy jo aventoeren opskriuwe. Fertel jo ferhaal troch tekst yn de siden yn te fieren. Jo kinne sels de titel en de auteur feroarje! Tekenje it Boek en fear om jo wurk ôf te sluten. It Boek en fear is bewurkbar oant it tekene is.

source_string: Brewing potions requires a Brewing Stand. Every potion starts off with a bottle of water, which is made by filling a Glass Bottle with water from a Cauldron or water source.
translation: Drankjes brouwen fereasket in Brouwstander. Elk drankje begjint mei in fleske wetter, dat makke wurdt troch in glêzen fleske mei wetter te fulle fan in Kachel of wetterboarne.

source_string: A Brewing Stand has three slots for creating different potions. One ingredient can be used over all three bottles, so always brew three potions at the same time to best use your resources.
translation: In Brouwstander hat trije slots foar it meitsjen fan ferskillende drankjes. Ien yngrediïnt kin brûkt wurde oer alle trije flesken, dus brou altyd trije drankjes tegearre om jo boarnen it bêste te brûken.

source_string: Putting Nether Wart in the top position of the Brewing Stand will give you an Awkward Potion. This doesn't have any effect by itself, but creates a base potion that can be used to create more advanced potions.
translation: It sette fan Nether-wortel yn de topposysje fan de Brouwstander jout dy in Rare Drankje. Dit hat gjin effekt op himsels, mar makket in basisdrankje dat brûkt wurde kin om avansearre drankjes te meitsjen.

source_string: There are many potion effects to discover, experiment with different ingredients and combinations to become a true alchemist.
translation: Der binne in soad drankjeseffekten om te ûntdekke, experimintearje mei ferskillende yngrediïnten en kombinaasjes om in echte alchemist te wurde.

source_string: How to Play: Building a Shelter
translation: Hoe te spyljen: in ûnderkommen bouwe

source_string: When danger comes lurking, a sturdy §eshelter§f can protect you from the threats outside.
translation: As gefaar oankomt, kin in stevich §eûnderkommen§f dy beskermje tsjin de driigingen bûten.

source_string: Building a shelter is critical to surviving your first night, and it doesn't have to be hard.
translation: It bouwen fan in ûnderkommen is kritysk om jo earste nacht te oerlibjen, en it hoecht net dreech te wêzen.

source_string: You can build one with anything from dirt to stone, or even close up a cave for a makeshift lodging!
translation: Jo kinne ien bouwe mei alles fan modder ta stien, of sels in grot ôfslute foar in tydlik ûnderkommen!

source_string: The Cauldron is a container that can hold buckets or bottles of liquid.
translation: De Kachel is in kontener dy't buckets of flesken flûch hâlde kin.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron while holding a Bucket of Water or a Potion to fill the Cauldron with its contents.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Kachel wylst jo in Buckets fol wetter of in Drankje hâlde om de Kachel mei syn ynhâld te fulle.

source_string: Tap a Cauldron while holding a Bucket of Water or a Potion to fill the Cauldron with its contents.
translation: Tap in Kachel wylst jo in Buckets fol wetter of in Drankje hâlde om de Kachel mei syn ynhâld te fulle.

source_string: A Potion will only partially fill a Cauldron so you will have to use multiple Potions to fill it up completely.
translation: In Drankje sil in Kachel mar diels fulle, dus moatst meardere Drankjes brûke om it hielendal fol te meitsjen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron with your Arrow in hand to create all kinds of different arrows!
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Kachel mei jo Pylk yn de hân om alle soarten ferskillende pylken te meitsjen!

source_string: Tap a Cauldron with your Arrow in hand to create all kinds of different arrows!
translation: Tap in Kachel mei jo Pylk yn de hân om alle soarten ferskillende pylken te meitsjen!

source_string: To dye Leather Armor or Leather Horse Armor, press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron filled with water while holding the desired dye. This will change the color of the water inside of the Cauldron. Then dip your armor into the Cauldron by pressing :_input_key.use: with armor in your hand.
translation: Om Learen Bepantsering of Learen Hynstebepantsering te ferve, druk :_input_key.use: op in Kachel fol wetter wylst jo de winske ferve hâlde. Dit sil de kleur fan it wetter yn de Kachel feroarje. Dip dan jo bepantsering yn de Kachel troch :_input_key.use: te drukken mei bepantsering yn jo hân.

source_string: To dye Leather Armor or Leather Horse Armor, tap a Cauldron filled with water while holding the desired dye. This will change the color of the water inside of the Cauldron. Then dip your armor into the Cauldron by tapping the Cauldron with the armor in your hand.
translation: Om Learen Bepantsering of Learen Hynstebepantsering te ferve, tap in Kachel fol wetter wylst jo de winske ferve hâlde. Dit sil de kleur fan it wetter yn de Kachel feroarje. Dip dan jo bepantsering yn de Kachel troch de Kachel oan te tikjen mei de bepantsering yn jo hân.

source_string: If you want to wash the dye off, dip the dyed item into a Cauldron of undyed Water.
translation: As jo de ferve ôfwaskje wolle, dip it ferve item yn in Kachel fol ûnferve wetter.

source_string: Press :_input_key.chat: to open Chat. Type your message and press ENTER.
translation: Druk :_input_key.chat: om Chat te iepenjen. Typ jo berjocht en druk op ENTER.

source_string: Press :_input_key.chat: to open Chat. Type your message and press the send button.
translation: Druk :_input_key.chat: om Chat te iepenjen. Typ jo berjocht en druk op de ferstjoerknop.

source_string: Tap the chat button to open Chat. Type your message and tap the send button.
translation: Tap de chatknop om Chat te iepenjen. Typ jo berjocht en tap de ferstjoerknop.

source_string: Once you have crafted a Chest, you can place it in the world and then open it with :_input_key.use: to store items from your inventory.
translation: As jo in Kiste makke hawwe, kinne jo it yn de wrâld sette en dan iepenje mei :_input_key.use: om items út jo ynventaris te bewarjen.

source_string: Once you have crafted a Chest, you can place it in the world and then tap to open it and store items from your inventory.
translation: As jo in Kiste makke hawwe, kinne jo it yn de wrâld sette en dan tikke om it te iepenjen en items út jo ynventaris te bewarjen.

source_string: Items in the Chest will be stored there for you to put into your inventory later.
translation: Items yn de Kiste wurde dêr bewarre foar jo om letter yn jo ynventaris te setten.

source_string: Two Chests placed next to each other will be combined to form a Large Chest.
translation: Twa Kisten neist elkoar delset wurde kombinearre om in Grutte Kiste te foarmjen.

source_string: Command Blocks are a powerful tool for map creators. They store and execute commands upon receiving a Redstone signal.
translation: Opdrachtblokken binne in krêftich ark foar kaartmakkers. Se bewarje en útfiere opdrachten by it ûntfangen fan in Redstone-sinjaal.

source_string: To get a command block you must use /give.
translation: Om in opdrachtblok te krijen moatst /give brûke.

source_string: When a Command Block has either executed or failed to execute its stored command, it sends a Redstone signal from the side where the arrow is pointing.
translation: As in Opdrachtblok syn bewarre opdracht útfierd hat of net útfiere koe, stjoert it in Redstone-sinjaal út de kant dêr de pylk nei wiist.

source_string: You can set the name of the Command Block in the Hover Note field.
translation: Jo kinne de namme fan it Opdrachtblok ynstelle yn it Hover Note-fjild.

source_string: §eBlock Type§f - There are three types of Command Blocks, each with their own color and behavior:
translation: §eBloktype§f - Der binne trije soarten Opdrachtblokken, elk mei syn eigen kleur en gedrach:

source_string: §eImpulse§f - Only executes the stored command when the block receives a redstone signal.
translation: §eYmpulz§f - Fiert alleinnich de bewarre opdracht út as it blok in redstone-sinjaal ûntfangt.

source_string: §eChain§f - Executes the stored command when the Command Block behind it has or has not executed its command.
translation: §eKeatling§f - Fiert de bewarre opdracht út as it Opdrachtblok derfoar syn opdracht wol of net útfierd hat.

source_string: §eRepeat§f - Once activated, this Command Block will continue executing its stored command as long as it exists.
translation: §eWerhelje§f - Ienris aktivearre, sil dit Opdrachtblok bliuwend syn bewarre opdracht útfiere salang it bestiet.

source_string: §eCondition§f - There are two conditions, each will affect the behavior of the Command Block:
translation: §eKondisje§f - Der binne twa kondisjes, elk beynfloedet it gedrach fan it Opdrachtblok:

source_string: §eUnconditional§f - Executes the stored command even if the Command Block behind it failed to execute its command.
translation: §eUnkondisjoneel§f - Fiert de bewarre opdracht út sels as it Opdrachtblok derfoar syn opdracht net útfiere koe.

source_string: §eConditional§f - Only executes the stored command if the Command Block behind it succeeded in executing its command.
translation: §eKondisjoneel§f - Fiert de bewarre opdracht allinnich út as it Opdrachtblok derfoar syn opdracht slagge útfierd hat.

source_string: §eRedstone§f - There are two redstone settings, each will affect the behavior of the Command Block:
translation: §eRedstone§f - Der binne twa redstone-ynstellingen, elk beynfloedet it gedrach fan it Opdrachtblok:

source_string: §eNeeds Redstone§f - Requires a redstone signal to activate.
translation: §eBenediget Redstone§f - Fereasket in redstone-sinjaal om te aktivearjen.

source_string: §eAlways Active§f - Does not require a redstone signal to activate.
translation: §eAltyd Aktyf§f - Fereasket gjin redstone-sinjaal om te aktivearjen.

source_string: A Command Block will also show you its previous output. This will help you figure out if a Command Block failed to execute its command and why.
translation: In Opdrachtblok sil jo ek syn foarige útfier toane. Dit helpt jo útfine as in Opdrachtblok syn opdracht net útfiere koe en wêrom.

source_string: Commands can be executed from Chat. Type / before you type the command.
translation: Opdrachten kinne útfierd wurde fan Chat. Typ / foardatsto de opdracht typest.

source_string: There are multitudes of commands that will allow you to do amazing things. There are many sources out there that will provide you with all of the info that you'll ever need.
translation: Der binne in soad opdrachten dy't dy geweldige dingen dwaan litte. Der binne in soad boarnen dy't dy alle ynfo jouwe dyst nedich hast.

source_string: An active Conduit gives you powers when you are underwater and when it rains.
translation: In aktyf Kanaal jout dy krêften as jo ûnder wetter binne en as it reint.

source_string: A Conduit is crafted with Nautilus Shells and a Heart of the Sea. The Conduit draws power from Prismarine and Sea Lanterns.
translation: In Kanaal wurdt makke mei Nautilusskylpen en in Hert fan de See. It Kanaal helle krêft út Prismarine en Seelantearnen.

source_string: Once activated, a Conduit will grant Conduit Power to anything nearby.
translation: Ienris aktivearre, sil in Kanaal Kanaalkrêft jaan oan alles yn de omkriten.

source_string: The more power it draws in, the further its abilities reach.
translation: Hoe mear krêft it opnimt, hoe fierder syn fermogens berikke.

source_string: How to Play: Crafting a Tool
translation: Hoe te spyljen: in ark meitsje

source_string: §eTools§f help you get things done faster. Some, like the §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: , let you mine stone and various ores. Others, like the §esword§f:wood_sword: , help you keep enemies at bay.
translation: §eArk§f helpe dy dingen flugger dwaan. Guon, sa as de §epickaks§f:wood_pickaxe: , litte dy stien en ferskate erts winne. Oaren, sa as it §eswurd§f:wood_sword: , helpe dy fijannen op ôfstân te hâlden.

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and right-clicking it. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Om in ark te meitsjen, iepenje jo §ewurkbank§f:crafting_table: troch dernei ta te rinnen en der rjochts op te klikken. Jo kinne in basisferzje fan de measte ark meitsje mei twa stokken en in pear planken - jo §erseptboek§f sil dy sizze hoe!

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and pressing :_input_key.use:. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Om in ark te meitsjen, iepenje jo §ewurkbank§f:crafting_table: troch dernei ta te rinnen en :_input_key.use: te drukken. Jo kinne in basisferzje fan de measte ark meitsje mei twa stokken en in pear planken - jo §erseptboek§f sil dy sizze hoe!

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and tapping it. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Om in ark te meitsjen, iepenje jo §ewurkbank§f:crafting_table: troch dernei ta te rinnen en it oan te tikjen. Jo kinne in basisferzje fan de measte ark meitsje mei twa stokken en in pear planken - jo §erseptboek§f sil dy sizze hoe!

source_string: To place or use certain Minecraft Education blocks or items, a player must possess a special ability called 'World Builder'.
translation: Om beskate Minecraft Education-blokken of -items del te setten of te brûken, moat in spiler in spesjale fermogen hawwe neamd 'Wrâldbouwer'.

source_string: With cheats activated, the host can enable or disable the World Builder ability for any players in the world.
translation: Mei cheats aktivearre, kin de host de Wrâldbouwer-fermogen ynskeakelje of útskeakelje foar elke spiler yn de wrâld.

source_string: To grant World Builder ability to all players in the world, run the following command:
translation: Om Wrâldbouwer-fermogen te jaan oan alle spilers yn de wrâld, fier de folgjende opdracht út:

source_string: To quickly toggle your own World Builder ability, run either of the following commands:
translation: Om flugger jo eigen Wrâldbouwer-fermogen te wikseljen, fier ien fan de folgjende opdrachten út:

source_string: To query your World Builder ability, run the following command:
translation: Om jo Wrâldbouwer-fermogen op te freegjen, fier de folgjende opdracht út:

source_string: Minecraft Education features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. Only players with World Builder ability can place and destroy these blocks. Only players without World Builder ability are subject to the restrictions imposed by these blocks.
translation: Minecraft Education befettet ferskate spesjale blokken dy't it makliker meitsje foar dosinten om lessen te meitsjen en te brûken. Allinnich spilers mei Wrâldbouwer-fermogen kinne dizze blokken delsette en fernielje. Allinnich spilers sûnder Wrâldbouwer-fermogen binne ûnderwurpen oan de beheiningen troch dizze blokken opsteld.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks control where players can build in a world.
translation: Tastean- en ôfwize-blokken kontrolearje wêr spilers yn in wrâld bouwe kinne.

source_string: Players can place or destroy blocks above Allow blocks. Players cannot place or destroy blocks above Deny blocks.
translation: Spilers kinne blokken delsette of fernielje boppe Tastean-blokken. Spilers kinne gjin blokken delsette of fernielje boppe Ofwize-blokken.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks do not affect the area below them.
translation: Tastean- en ôfwize-blokken beynfloedje it gebiet ûnder harren net.

source_string: An Allow block with a Deny block somewhere below it prevents players from building in the space between the two blocks. Above the Allow block, players can place and destroy blocks.
translation: In Tastean-blok mei in Ofwize-blok earne dêrûnder wjerhâldt spilers fan it bouwen yn de romte tusken de twa blokken. Boppe it Tastean-blok kinne spilers blokken delsette en fernielje.

source_string: Border blocks provide a force field that extends infinitely upward and downward, regardless of the presence of other blocks. Players cannot move through, over, or under a Border block. Players cannot place or destroy blocks that are above or below a Border block.
translation: Grinsblokken jouwe in krêftfjild dat ûneindich omheech en omleech útstrekt, ûnôfhinklik fan de oanwêzigens fan oare blokken. Spilers kinne net troch, oer, of ûnder in Grinsblok bewege. Spilers kinne gjin blokken delsette of fernielje dy't boppe of ûnder in Grinsblok binne.

source_string: Minecraft is a §emultiplayer§f game by default.
Every new world you create starts with multiplayer enabled. If you want to make it §eprivate§f, go to World Settings to turn off multiplayer.
translation: Elke nije wrâld dyst makkest begjint mei multyspiler ynskeakele. As jo it §eprivee§f meitsje wolle, gean nei Wrâldynstellingen om multyspiler út te skeakeljen.

source_string: To play with others, go to the §eFriends tab§f to see all available Realms, Friends, and LAN games. Just select any game to join it.
translation: Om mei oaren te spyljen, gean nei de §efreoneljepper§f om alle beskikbere Realms, Freonen, en LAN-spullen te sjen. Selektearje gewoan elk spultsje om it by te wenjen.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, your friends can see this in their Friends tab. If they join, it'll be visible to their friends as well.
translation: As jo in online spultsje begjinne of bywenje, kinne jo freonen dit sjen yn har freoneljepper. As sy bywenje, sil it ek sichtber wêze foar har freonen.

source_string: You need to be signed in to a §eMicrosoft account§f with an active internet connection to play multiplayer.
translation: Jo moatte oanmeld wêze bij in §eMicrosoft-account§f mei in aktive ynternetferbining om multyspiler te spyljen.

source_string: Realms - The best way to play together
translation: Realms - De bêste manier om tegearre te spyljen

source_string: It's easy to play with friends using §eRealms§f.
translation: It is maklik om mei freonen te spyljen fia §eRealms§f.

source_string: You and up to 10 friends get 24/7 access to a world that's always online. Explore, get creative, or try curated content from Marketplace.
translation: Jo en oant 10 freonen krije 24/7 tagong ta in wrâld dy't altyd online is. Ferken, wurd kreatyf, of probearje kuratearre ynhâld fan de Marketplace.

source_string: All you need is a paid Realms subscription. Why not try a free 30-day trial?
translation: Alles wêr jo nedich foar binne is in betelle Realms-abonnemint. Wêrom probearje jo net in fergees 30-deiske probeperioade?

source_string: You decide what people can do in your world by changing §eplayer permissions§f.
translation: Jo beslute wat minsken dwaan kinne yn jo wrâld troch §espilertastimmingen§f te feroarjen.

source_string: Open the game menu to see a list of players currently in your world, then select the permissions icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Iepenje it spulmenu om in list fan spilers op dit stuit yn jo wrâld te sjen, dan selektearje it tastimmingsikoan om de tastimmingen fan dy spiler oan te passen.
Meld dy oan om Realms te probearjen

source_string: Chalkboards are used to display text in the world. Chalkboards display more text than Signs, can be edited after they have been placed, and come in three sizes: Slate, Poster, and Board. The lock toggle allows you to prevent non-World Builders from destroying or editing your chalkboards. Press :_input_key.use: on an existing chalkboard to edit it.
translation: Skoalboerden wurde brûkt om tekst yn de wrâld te toanen. Skoalboerden toane mear tekst as Boarden, kinne bewurkt wurde nei se delset binne, en komme yn trije grutten: Slate, Poster, en Board. De sluttingsskeakel lit dy net-Wrâldbouwers wjerhâlde fan it fernieljen of bewurkjen fan jo skoalboerden. Druk :_input_key.use: op in besteand skoalboerd om it te bewurkjen.

source_string: Chalkboards are used to display text in the world. Chalkboards display more text than Signs, can be edited after they have been placed, and come in three sizes: Slate, Poster, and Board. The lock toggle allows you to prevent non-World Builders from destroying or editing your chalkboards. Tap an existing chalkboard to edit it.
translation: Skoalboerden wurde brûkt om tekst yn de wrâld te toanen. Skoalboerden toane mear tekst as Boarden, kinne bewurkt wurde nei se delset binne, en komme yn trije grutten: Slate, Poster, en Board. De sluttingsskeakel lit dy net-Wrâldbouwers wjerhâlde fan it fernieljen of bewurkjen fan jo skoalboerden. Tap in besteand skoalboerd om it te bewurkjen.

source_string: Students can simulate real world chemistry by using the Chemistry Equipment blocks. Build any of the 118 different elements by adjusting the sliders in the Element Constructor or view the composition of elements by placing them in the Element Constructor. Combine elements in the Compound Creator to produce chemical compounds. Put elements and compounds into the Lab Table to create Minecraft items. Reduce blocks to their component elements with the Material Reducer.
translation: Studinten kinne echte wrâld-skiekunde simulearje troch de Skiekunde-apparatuurblokken te brûken. Bou elk fan de 118 ferskillende eleminten troch de skowers yn de Eleminten-konstruktor oan te passen, of besjoch de gearstalling fan eleminten troch se yn de Eleminten-konstruktor te setten. Kombinearje eleminten yn de Kompound-oanmakker om skiekundige kompounden te produsearjen. Set eleminten en kompounden yn de Labtafel om Minecraft-items te meitsjen. Ferminderje blokken ta har komponentseleminten mei de Materiaal-fermindere.

source_string: Download the Chemistry Journal from the Minecraft Education website for a comprehensive guide to chemistry in Minecraft.
translation: Download it Skiekundejournaal fan de Minecraft Education-website foar in útgebreide gids foar skiekunde yn Minecraft.

source_string: NPCs are non-player characters that can provide additional lesson information, hints, or instructions.
translation: NPCs binne net-spilerkarakters dy't ekstra lesynformaasje, tips, of ynstruksjes jaan kinne.

source_string: Only World Builders can place, delete, name, or edit NPCs. NPCs can execute commands and link to websites. Commands can be assigned to buttons in the NPC's dialog window; website links will always have a button.
translation: Allinnich Wrâldbouwers kinne NPCs delsette, wiskje, beneame, of bewurkje. NPCs kinne opdrachten útfiere en keppelje nei websites. Opdrachten kinne tawiisd wurde oan knoppen yn it dialoogfinster fan de NPC; website-keppelingen hawwe altyd in knop.

source_string: NPCs have a variety of skins to choose from and are immobile.
translation: NPCs hawwe in ferskaat oan skins om te kiezen en binne ymmobyl.

source_string: The Camera allows players to take pictures in the world.
translation: De Kamera lit spilers foto's yn de wrâld nimme.

source_string: To take a picture from your point of view, press :_input_key.use:.
translation: Om in foto fan jo perspektyf te nimmen, druk :_input_key.use:.

source_string: To take a picture from your point of view, tap and hold, then release.
translation: Om in foto fan jo perspektyf te nimmen, tap en hâld, en lit dan los.

source_string: To take a selfie, place a camera and press :_input_key.use: on it.
translation: Om in selfy te nimmen, set in kamera del en druk :_input_key.use: derop.

source_string: To take a selfie, place a camera and tap the Take Picture button.
translation: Om in selfy te nimmen, set in kamera del en tap de foto-knop.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into the Book and Quill.
translation: Foto's kinne besjoen wurde yn it Portfolio of ynfoege wurde yn it Boek en fear.

source_string: Pictures you have taken appear in the Portfolio. Press :_input_key.use: to view the Portfolio. When viewing the Portfolio, you can add captions to pictures, delete pictures, and export pictures as a PDF.
translation: Foto's dyst nommen hast steane yn it Portfolio. Druk :_input_key.use: om it Portfolio te besjen. By it besjen fan it Portfolio, kinne jo bysinjes tafoegje oan foto's, foto's wiskje, en foto's eksportearje as PDF.

source_string: Pictures you have taken appear in the Portfolio. Tap and hold to view the Portfolio. When viewing the Portfolio, you can add captions to pictures, delete pictures, and export pictures as a PDF.
translation: Foto's dyst nommen hast steane yn it Portfolio. Tap en hâld om it Portfolio te besjen. By it besjen fan it Portfolio, kinne jo bysinjes tafoegje oan foto's, foto's wiskje, en foto's eksportearje as PDF.

source_string: Classroom Mode is an external application that provides educators with features designed to facilitate interaction with students. You can download Classroom Mode from the Minecraft Education website.
translation: Klasmodus is in eksterne applikaasje dy't dosinten funksjes jout dy't ûntworpen binne om ynteraksje mei studinten te fasilitearje. Jo kinne Klasmodus downloade fan de Minecraft Education-website.

source_string: As the host of a world, use the command /classroommode to launch the Classroom Mode app and connect it to Minecraft Education.
translation: As de host fan in wrâld, brûk de opdracht /classroommode om de Klasmodus-app te starten en it te ferbine mei Minecraft Education.

source_string: Code Builder allows players to explore, create, and play in Minecraft by writing code using familiar learn-to-code platforms.
translation: Codebuilder lit spilers ferkenne, meitsje, en spylje yn Minecraft troch koade te skriuwen mei bekende leare-te-koadzje-platfoarmen.

source_string: Launch Code Builder by pressing :_input_key.codeBuilder: or by using the command /code.
translation: Start Codebuilder troch :_input_key.codeBuilder: te drukken of troch de opdracht /code te brûken.

source_string: Launch Code Builder by tapping :code_builder_button: or by using the command /code.
translation: Start Codebuilder troch :code_builder_button: oan te tikjen of troch de opdracht /code te brûken.

source_string: The Crafting Table will let you craft more complicated recipes.
translation: De Wurkbank lit dy meardere komplekse resepten meitsje.

source_string: Place it in the world, then press :_input_key.use: on the Crafting Table to use it.
translation: Set it yn de wrâld, en druk dan :_input_key.use: op de Wurkbank om it te brûken.

source_string: Place it in the world, then tap the Crafting Table to use it.
translation: Set it yn de wrâld, en tap dan de Wurkbank om it te brûken.

source_string: Creative Mode is there so you can build the land of your dreams mob free!
translation: Creative-modus is der sadatsto it lân fan jo dreamen mob-frij bouwe kinst!

source_string: The creative mode interface allows any item in the game to be moved into the player's inventory without the need for mining or crafting the item. The items in the player's inventory will not be removed when they are placed or used in the world, and this allows the player to focus on building rather than resource gathering.
translation: De creative-modus-ynterface lit elk item yn it spul nei de ynventaris fan de spiler ferpleatst wurde sûnder de need om it item te minen of te meitsjen. De items yn de ynventaris fan de spiler wurde net fuortsmiten as se delset of brûkt wurde yn de wrâld, en dit lit de spiler him rjochtsje op bouwe ynstee fan boarnesamling.

source_string: If you create, load, or save a world in Creative Mode, that world will have achievements and leaderboard updates disabled, even if it is then loaded in Survival Mode.
translation: As jo in wrâld yn Creative-modus meitsje, laden, of bewarje, sil dy wrâld achievements en leaderboard-updates útskeakele hawwe, sels as it letter laden wurdt yn Survival-modus.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, press :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, push :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: while flying. When in flying mode, you can hold down :_input_key.jump: to move up and :_input_key.sneak: to move down.
translation: Om te fleane yn Creative-modus, druk :_input_key.jump: twa kear flot. Om te ophâlden fleanen, werhelje de aksje. Om flugger te fleane, druk :_input_key.forward: twa kear flot achter elkoar of druk :_input_key.sprint: wylst fleanen. Yn fleanmodus kinsto :_input_key.jump: yndrukt hâlde om nei boppe te bewegen en :_input_key.sneak: om nei ûnder te bewegen.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, press :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can hold down :_input_key.jump: to move up and :_input_key.sneak: to move down.
translation: Om te fleane yn Creative-modus, druk :_input_key.jump: twa kear flot. Om te ophâlden fleanen, werhelje de aksje. Om flugger te fleane, druk :_gamepad_stick_left: foarút twa kear flot achter elkoar wylst fleanen. Yn fleanmodus kinsto :_input_key.jump: yndrukt hâlde om nei boppe te bewegen en :_input_key.sneak: om nei ûnder te bewegen.

source_string: To fly tap :tip_virtual_button_jump: twice quickly, and to stop flying tap :tip_virtual_button_fly_down: twice quickly.
translation: Om te fleane, tap :tip_virtual_button_jump: twa kear flot, en om te ophâlden fleanen tap :tip_virtual_button_fly_down: twa kear flot.

source_string: Tap :tip_virtual_button_sprint: to fly faster. To fly up tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_fly_up:, and to fly down tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_fly_down:.
translation: Tap :tip_virtual_button_sprint: om flugger te fleane. Om nei boppe te fleane, tap en hâld :tip_virtual_button_fly_up:, en om nei ûnder te fleane, tap en hâld :tip_virtual_button_fly_down:.

source_string: To fly tap :touch_jump: twice quickly, and to stop flying tap :touch_stop_flying: twice quickly.
translation: Om te fleane, tap :touch_jump: twa kear flot, en om te ophâlden fleanen tap :touch_stop_flying: twa kear flot.

source_string: Tap :touch_forward: twice quickly to fly faster. To fly up tap and hold :touch_fly_up:, and to fly down tap and hold :touch_fly_down:.
translation: Tap :touch_forward: twa kear flot om flugger te fleane. Om nei boppe te fleane, tap en hâld :touch_fly_up:, en om nei ûnder te fleane, tap en hâld :touch_fly_down:.

source_string: How to Play: Death and Respawn
translation: Hoe te spyljen: dea en werop stean

source_string: Enemies appear every night, and even the best of us can be caught off guard. If your §ehealth bar§f:heart: runs out, you'll die - and then respawn right where you started!
translation: Fijannen ferskine elke nacht, en sels de bêsten fan ús kinne oerfallen wurde. As jo §egesûnensbalke§f:heart: leech rint, geane jo dea - en dan komst jo werom krekt wêr jo begûn binne!

source_string: You have unlimited lives, but you drop all items in your inventory when you die. If you're quick enough, you can pick your items back up right where you dropped them.
translation: Jo hawwe ûnbeheinde libbens, mar jo lit alle items yn jo ynventaris falle as jo deagean. As jo flot binne, kinsto jo items werom pikke krekt wêr jo se lieten falle.

source_string: Minecraft has varying levels of difficulty so you can tailor the game to your level.
translation: Minecraft hat farieerjende nivo's fan dreechheid sadatsto it spul oanpasse kinst oan jo nivo.

source_string: No hostile mobs will spawn except for shulkers and the Ender Dragon, but they won't do any damage to you.
translation: Gjin fijannige mobs sille spawne útsûnderd Shulkers en de Ender Draak, mar sy sille dy gjin skea dwaan.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Fijannige mobs spawne, mar dogge minder skea. De hongerbalke ferminderet en tapt gesûnens ôf oant 5 herten.

source_string: Hostile mobs will do normal damage, and if your hunger level drops to zero your health will begin to drop, but you won't die.
translation: Fijannige mobs sille normale skea dwaan, en as jo hongernivo nei nul falt, sil jo gesûnens begjinne te falle, mar jo sille net deagean.

source_string: Hostile mobs will do more damage, zombies will break through doors, and if your hunger level drops to zero, your health will drop and you could die.
translation: Fijannige mobs sille mear skea dwaan, sombys sille troch doarren brekke, en as jo hongernivo nei nul falt, sil jo gesûnens falle en jo kinne deagean.

source_string: Dispensers are used to shoot out items. You will need to power each Dispenser with a redstone signal (for example, with a lever) to trigger it.
translation: Dispensers wurde brûkt om items út te sjitte. Jo moatte elke Dispenser fan krêft foarsjen mei in redstone-sinjaal (bygelyks mei in slinger) om it te triggerje.

source_string: To fill a Dispenser with items, press :_input_key.use: on the Dispenser, then move the items that you want to dispense from your inventory to the Dispenser.
translation: Om in Dispenser mei items te fulle, druk :_input_key.use: op de Dispenser, en ferpleats dan de items dyst útsjitte wolst fan jo ynventaris nei de Dispenser.

source_string: To fill a Dispenser, tap the Dispenser, then move the items that you want to dispense from your inventory into the Dispenser.
translation: Om in Dispenser te fulle, tap de Dispenser, en ferpleats dan de items dyst útsjitte wolst fan jo ynventaris yn de Dispenser.

source_string: Whenever you power a Dispenser, an item will shoot out.
translation: Wannear jo in Dispenser fan krêft foarsjogge, sjit der in item út.

source_string: Dispensers can also be used to place items as well, such as Pumpkins on Iron Golems and equipment on Armor Stands.
translation: Dispensers kinne ek brûkt wurde om items te setten, sa as pompoenen op izergolems en apparatuur op Bepantseringsstanders.

source_string: When powered by Redstone, Droppers will drop a single random item contained within. Press :_input_key.use: on the Dropper to open it and then you can load it with items from your inventory.
translation: As it fan Redstone foarsjoen wurdt, sil in Dropper ien willekeurich item dat der yn is falle litte. Druk :_input_key.use: op de Dropper om it te iepenjen en dan kinsto it fulle mei items fan jo ynventaris.

source_string: When powered by Redstone, Droppers will drop a single random item contained within. Tap the Dropper to open it and then you can load it with items from your inventory.
translation: As it fan Redstone foarsjoen wurdt, sil in Dropper ien willekeurich item dat der yn is falle litte. Tap de Dropper om it te iepenjen en dan kinsto it fulle mei items fan jo ynventaris.

source_string: If a Dropper is facing a Chest or another type of container, the item will be placed into that instead. Long chains of Droppers can be constructed to transport items over a distance.
translation: As in Dropper rjochting in Kiste of oar type kontener stiet, sil it item dêr yn setten wurde ynstee. Lange keatlingen fan Droppers kinne bout wurde om items oer in ôfstân te transportearje.

source_string: Dye is used to change the color of many things in Minecraft.
translation: Ferve wurdt brûkt om de kleur fan in soad dingen yn Minecraft te feroarjen.

source_string: Some Dye materials are harder to find than others. Most Dyes can be crafted from flowers, like §eRed Dye§f from a Poppy, but some Dyes are found or created in more obscure ways such as:
translation: Guon fervematerialen binne dreger te finen as oaren. De measte fervers kinne makke wurde fan blommen, lykas §eReade ferve§f fan in Papafer, mar guon fervers wurde fûn of makke op mear obskuere manieren sa as:

source_string: §eBlue Dye§f - Mining Lapis Lazuli deep underground
translation: §eBlauwe ferve§f - It winnen fan Lapis Lazuli djip ûnder de grûn

source_string: §eBlack Dye§f - Collecting Ink Sacs from Squids
translation: §eSwarte ferve§f - It sammeljen fan ynktsakken fan Inketfisken

source_string: §eBrown Dye§f - Harvesting Cocoa Beans in the Jungle
translation: §eBrune ferve§f - It rispjen fan kakaobeanen yn de Jungel

source_string: Elytra are an item that can be equipped to allow gliding. Elytra are equipped in the chest armor slot.
translation: Elytra binne in item dat oandien wurde kin om te glide. Elytra wurde oandien yn it boarstbepantseringsslot.

source_string: Elytra cannot be crafted, but are found in Item Frames in rare End Ships, guarded by fearsome Shulkers.
translation: Elytra kinne net makke wurde, mar wurde fûn yn Itemramen yn seldsume Endskippen, wachte troch freeslike Shulkers.

source_string: When equipped with Elytra, a player can press :_input_key.jump: while falling to start gliding. Note that you need to be quite high to really get the full effect!
translation: As oandien mei Elytra, kin in spiler :_input_key.jump: drukke wylst falend om te begjinnen mei glide. Wês bewust datsto nochal heech wêze moatst om echt it folle effekt te krijen!

source_string: When equipped with Elytra, tap :touch_jump: or :tip_virtual_button_fly_up: while falling to start gliding. Make sure you're high up to get the full effect!
translation: As oandien mei Elytra, tap :touch_jump: of :tip_virtual_button_fly_up: wylst falend om te begjinnen mei glide. Soargje derfoar datsto heech genôch bist om it folle effekt te krijen!

source_string: While gliding, you can steer by looking around. If you look downwards, you'll move faster - but you'll also hit the ground sooner. If you look upwards, you'll gain some height - but do it for too long and you'll stall, falling instead of rising!
translation: Wylst glide, kinsto stjoere troch om dy hinne te sjen. As jo nei ûnder sjoche, beweech jo flugger - mar jo reitse ek gauwer de grûn. As jo nei boppe sjoche, gean jo wat hichte krije - mar doch dat te lang en jo sille stalle, fallend ynstee fan opgeande!

source_string: You can steer while gliding by looking around. If you look downwards, you'll gain some speed, but you'll also hit the ground faster. If you look upward, you'll gain some height, but do it for too long and you'll stall - which means you'll start falling.
translation: Jo kinne stjoere wylst glide troch om dy hinne te sjen. As jo nei ûnder sjoche, gean jo wat snelheid krije, mar jo reitse ek de grûn flugger. As jo nei boppe sjoche, gean jo wat hichte krije, mar doch dat te lang en jo sille stalle - wat betsjut datsto begjinne te fallen.

source_string: Your Elytra will slowly lose durability while flying, and if they break mid-flight you'll fall. You can repair them by combining them with Phantom Membrane at an Anvil.
translation: Jo Elytra sille stadich duorsumheid ferlieze wylst fleanen, en as se midden yn de flecht brekke, sille jo falle. Jo kinne se reparearje troch se te kombinearjen mei Fantomembraan bij in Ambyld.

source_string: Firework Rockets that have no effects can be used to extend Elytra flight. You will be damaged if you use a Firework Rocket that has effects to extend flight.
translation: Fjoerwurkrockets sûnder effekten kinne brûkt wurde om Elytra-flecht te ferlingje. Jo krije skea as jo in Fjoerwurkrocket brûke mei effekten om de flecht te ferlingje.

source_string: The Experience Points collected by picking up Experience Orbs can be used to enchant Weapons, Armor, Tools, and Books.
translation: De erfaringspunten sammele troch erfaringsboljen op te pikken kinne brûkt wurde om Wapens, Bepantsering, Ark, en Boeken te betsjoenen.

source_string: When an enchantable item is placed in the slot below the book in the Enchanting Table, the three buttons to the right of the slot will display some enchantments with their Experience Level cost and Lapis Lazuli cost.
translation: As in te betsjoenjend item yn it slot ûnder it boek yn de Betsjoentafel setten wurdt, sille de trije knoppen rjochts fan it slot inkele betsjoeningen mei har erfaringsnivo-kosten en Lapis Lazuli-kosten toane.

source_string: The actual enchantment applied is randomly selected based on the cost displayed.
translation: De echte tapaste betsjoening wurdt willekeurich selektearre basearre op de toande kosten.

source_string: If the Enchanting Table is surrounded by Bookshelves (up to a maximum of 15), with a one block gap between the Bookshelf and the Enchanting Table, arcane glyphs will be seen going to the book on the Enchanting Table and the potency of the enchantments will be increased.
translation: As de Betsjoentafel omringe wurdt troch Boekplanken (oant in maksimum fan 15), mei in gat fan ien blok tusken de Boekplank en de Betsjoentafel, sille arkaanske symboalen te sjen wêze nei it boek op de Betsjoentafel geande en de krêft fan de betsjoeningen fergrutte wurdt.

source_string: Enchanted Books are used at the Anvil to apply enchantments to items. This gives you more control over which enchantments you would like on your items.
translation: Betsjoene boeken wurde brûkt op it Ambyld om betsjoeningen op items ta te passen. Dit jout dy mear kontrôle oer hokker betsjoeningen jo op jo items ha wolle.

source_string: After killing the Ender Dragon, an End Gateway will appear. Throwing an Ender Pearl into the portal will teleport you to the outer islands.
translation: Nei it deadzjen fan de Ender Draak, sil in End-poarte ferskine. It smiten fan in Enderparel yn it portaal sil dy teleporteare nei de bûtenste eilannen.

source_string: This alien new landscape must hide something interesting, and maybe something to bring back with you.
translation: Dit frjemde nije lânskip moat wat ynteressants ferbergje, en miskien wat om mei werom te nimmen.

source_string: All Ender Chests in a world are linked. Items placed into an Ender Chest are accessible in any other Ender Chest. However, the contents of the Ender Chests are specific for each player. This allows players to store items in any Ender Chest, and retrieve them from other Ender Chests in different positions in the world.
translation: Alle Enderkisten yn in wrâld binne keppele. Items setten yn in Enderkiste binne tagonklik yn elke oare Enderkiste. De ynhâld fan de Enderkisten is lykwols spesifyk foar elke spiler. Dit lit spilers items yn elke Enderkiste bewarje, en se ophelje út oare Enderkisten op ferskillende posysjes yn de wrâld.

context: How To Play help text header. {MaxLength="80"}

source_string: Eyes of Ender are mysteriously connected to the End and will behave strangely when used.
translation: Eagen fan Ender binne mystearjeus ferbûn mei de End en sille frjemd gedrach toane by gebrûk.

source_string: Rumor has it that they can lead you to open another dimension.
translation: It liket derop dat se dy nei it iepenjen fan in oare dimenzje liede kinne.

source_string: There are a variety of different crops that you can farm in Minecraft. Farming, while challenging, can provide an infinite food source.
translation: Der binne in ferskaat oan ferskillende oanwoaksen dy'st boere kinst yn Minecraft. Boere, hoe útdaagjend ek, kin in ûneindige fiedselboarne jaan.

source_string: Crops require light, water, and farmland to grow. You need a hoe, a water source, and seeds to farm.
translation: Oanwoaksen fereaskje ljocht, wetter, en boufjild om te groeien. Jo hawwe in skoffel, in wetterboarne, en siedden nedich om te boerjen.

source_string: The Blocks next to the water need to be converted to farmland, do this with the hoe. Water will saturate up to four block away.
translation: De blokken neist it wetter moatte omset wurde ta boufjild, doch dit mei de skoffel. Wetter fersadiget oant fjouwer blokken fuort.

source_string: Now you can plant your seeds. Make sure your crops are protected as they can easily die from being trampled or lack of water or light.
translation: No kinsto jo siedden plantsje. Soargje derfoar dat jo oanwoaksen beskerme binne, want se kinne maklik deagean troch fertreden wurden of it lack fan wetter of ljocht.

source_string: Fences can help protect your crops from hungry rabbits or trampling toes!
translation: Hikken kinne dyn oanwoaksen beskermje tsjin hongerige kninen of fertreden teanen!

source_string: When the crops are fully grown they change in appearance and can be harvested.
translation: As de oanwoaksen folslein groeid binne, feroarje se yn uterlik en kinne se rispe wurde.

source_string: Some plants like pumpkins and melons grow on stalks. Be careful not to harvest the stalks!
translation: Guon planten sa as pompoenen en meloenen groeie op stâlken. Wês foarsichtich net de stâlken te rispjen!

source_string: Fireworks are a fun way to create your own unique celebration in Minecraft!
translation: Fjoerwurk is in leuke manier om jo eigen unike fiering te meitsjen yn Minecraft!

source_string: Fireworks have two components, the Firework Rocket and the Firework Star.
translation: Fjoerwurk hat twa komponinten, it Fjoerwurkrocket en de Fjoerwurkstjer.

source_string: To use a Firework, press :_input_key.use: on a block to send the Firework shooting into the sky.
translation: Om Fjoerwurk te brûken, druk :_input_key.use: op in blok om it Fjoerwurk de loft ynskietten te litten.

source_string: To use a Firework, tap on a block to send the Firework shooting into the sky.
translation: Om Fjoerwurk te brûken, tap op in blok om it Fjoerwurk de loft ynskietten te litten.

source_string: Fireworks have no effect other than shooting up into the air.
translation: Fjoerwurk hat gjin effekt oars as it de loft ynsjitten.

source_string: Firework Stars can be added to during the crafting of the Firework Rocket to give it many different colors and effects.
translation: Fjoerwurkstjerren kinne tafoege wurde tidens it meitsjen fan de Fjoerwurkrocket om it in soad ferskillende kleuren en effekten te jaan.

source_string: Firework Stars are made from gunpowder and various other items:
translation: Fjoerwurkstjerren wurde makke fan poederkrûd en ferskate oare items:

source_string: §eColor§f - Adding dye of any color will make an explosion of that color.
translation: §eKleur§f - It tafoegjen fan ferve fan elke kleur sil in ûntploffing fan dy kleur meitsje.

source_string: §eTwinkle§f - Adding Glowstone Dust will make the explosion twinkle.
translation: §eTwinkel§f - It tafoegjen fan glêdstien-poeier sil de ûntploffing twinkelje litte.

source_string: §eCreeper Shaped§f - Adding a Head will make a creeper pattern in the sky.
translation: §eCreeper-foarm§f - It tafoegjen fan in Kop sil in creeper-patroan yn de loft meitsje.

source_string: §eBurst§f - Adding a feather will give the explosion a burst effect.
translation: §eBarst§f - It tafoegjen fan in fear jout de ûntploffing in barsteffekt.

source_string: §eTrail§f - Adding a Diamond will give the explosion trails.
translation: §eSpoar§f - It tafoegjen fan in Diamant jout de ûntploffing spoaren.

source_string: §eStar Shaped§f - Adding a Gold Nugget will make a star pattern in the sky.
translation: §eStjerfoarm§f - It tafoegjen fan in Goudklompke sil in stjerpatroan yn de loft meitsje.

source_string: Fireworks can be fired from a dispenser. This will shoot the Firework in the direction that the dispenser is facing.
translation: Fjoerwurk kin ôffjuord wurde fan in Dispenser. Dit sil it Fjoerwurk yn de rjochting sjitte dêr de Dispenser nei rjochte is.

source_string: Fishing must be done with a Fishing Rod and is an excellent way to catch some fish or other cool items from the sea!
translation: Fiskje moat dien wurde mei in Fiskangel en is in geweldige manier om fisk of oare coole items út de see te fangen!

source_string: Aim at a block of water and press :_input_key.use: while holding a fishing rod to cast the lure into the water.
translation: Rjochtje op in wetterblok en druk :_input_key.use: wylst jo in fiskangel hâlde om it aas yn it wetter te smiten.

source_string: Look at a block of water and tap the Fish button while holding a Fishing Rod to cast the lure into the water.
translation: Sjoch nei in wetterblok en tap de Fiskknop wylst jo in Fiskangel hâlde om it aas yn it wetter te smiten.

source_string: Wait until you start to see a trail of bubbles coming for the lure.
translation: Wachtsje oant jo in spoar fan bubbels sjogge kommende foar it aas.

source_string: When the bubbles touch the lure, it will bob up and down. Press :_input_key.use: to reel in the lure. Be careful not to let your fish get away!
translation: As de bubbels it aas oanreitsje, sil it op en del bewege. Druk :_input_key.use: om it aas yn te haaljen. Wês foarsichtich net dyn fisk kwyt te reitsjen!

source_string: When the bubbles touch the lure, it will bob up and down. Tap the Fish button again to reel in the lure. Be careful not to let your fish get away!
translation: As de bubbels it aas oanreitsje, sil it op en del bewege. Tap de Fiskknop wer om it aas yn te haaljen. Wês foarsichtich net dyn fisk kwyt te reitsjen!

source_string: You'll slowly get hungry during your adventures - fortunately the Overworld is full of food! You can gather apples from trees, meat from animals, or why not grow your own crops using a hoe?
translation: Jo krije stadichoan honger tidens jo aventoeren - lokkigernôch is de Oerwrâld fol mei fiedsel! Jo kinne apels sammelje fan beammen, fleis fan bisten, of wêrom net jo eigen oanwoaksen boere mei in skoffel?

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then click and hold the right mouse button. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Om iten te iten, selektearje it yn jo hotbar, en klik en hâld de rjochtermûsknop yn. Hâld de §ehongerbalke§f:shank: fol om gesûnens werom te krijen as jo skea nimme.

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then press and hold :_input_key.use:. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Om iten te iten, selektearje it yn jo hotbar, en druk en hâld :_input_key.use: yn. Hâld de §ehongerbalke§f:shank: fol om gesûnens werom te krijen as jo skea nimme.

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then tap the screen and hold. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Om iten te iten, selektearje it yn jo hotbar, en tap it skerm en hâld it yn. Hâld de §ehongerbalke§f:shank: fol om gesûnens werom te krijen as jo skea nimme.

source_string: Some raw foods are better when cooked first on a campfire or in a furnace - your tummy will thank you!
translation: Guon rou iten is better as it earst kookt wurdt op in kampfjoer of yn in fornús - jo mage sil dy tanke!

source_string: A Furnace allows you to cook or smelt items. For example, you can smelt Iron Ore into Iron Ingots.
translation: In Fornús lit dy items koke of smoltsjen. Bygelyks, jo kinne izerts smoltsje ta izeryngots.

source_string: Place the Furnace in the world and press :_input_key.use: to use it.
translation: Set it Fornús yn de wrâld en druk :_input_key.use: om it te brûken.

source_string: Place the Furnace in the world and tap to use it.
translation: Set it Fornús yn de wrâld en tap om it te brûken.

source_string: You need to put some fuel into the bottom of the Furnace, and the item that you want smelted in the top. The Furnace will then fire up and start working. Lots of things can be used as fuel; try experimenting with anything burnable!
translation: Jo moatte wat brânstof yn de ûnderkant fan it Fornús sette, en it item dat jo smoltsje wolle boppe-oan. It Fornús sil dan begjinne te wurkjen. In soad dingen kinne as brânstof brûkt wurde; probearje mei alles dat baarnber is te experimintearjen!

source_string: When creating a world, you have many options. Below are the various settings that can be used to fine tune your experience. Don't worry if you didn't set them when you created the world, they can be changed at any time.
translation: By it meitsjen fan in wrâld hawwe jo in soad opsjes. Hjirûnder binne de ferskate ynstellingen dy't brûkt wurde kinne om jo ûnderfining fyn te stellen. Gjin noed as jo se net ynsteld hawwe by it meitsjen fan de wrâld, se kinne altyd feroare wurde.

source_string: §eWorld Name§f: This is where you can name your world.

§eDefault Game Mode§f: This is the gamemode that all new players to the world will start with. You can have players start in either survival or creative mode. Selecting creative mode will turn cheats on.
translation: §eStandertspulmodus§f: Dit is de spulmodus wêrmei alle nije spilers yn de wrâld begjinne. Jo kinne spilers yn survival- of creative-modus begjinne litte. It selektearjen fan creative-modus set cheats oan.

source_string: §eDifficulty§f: This setting affects how difficult the world will be. You can choose Peaceful, Easy, Normal, or Hard.
translation: §eDreechheid§f: Dizze ynstelling beynfloedet hoe dreech de wrâld sil wêze. Jo kinne Freedsum, Maklik, Normaal, of Dreech kieze.

source_string: §eStarting Map§f: If this setting is turned on, every player will start with a map in their hotbar.
translation: §eStartkaart§f: As dizze ynstelling oanstiet, begjint elke spiler mei in kaart yn har hotbar.

source_string: §eBonus Chest§f: If this setting is turned on, there will be a chest with some starting loot near your initial spawn location.
translation: §eBonuskiste§f: As dizze ynstelling oanstiet, sil der in kiste mei wat startplunder wêze tichtby jo earste spawnlokaasje.

source_string: §eWorld Type§f: This setting controls the way the world is created. Select Infinite or Flat from the drop down menu to change the world type.
translation: §eWrâldtype§f: Dizze ynstelling kontrolearret de manier wêrop de wrâld makke wurdt. Selektearje Ûneindich of Flak út it útklapmenu om it wrâldtype te feroarjen.

source_string: §eInfinite worlds§f go on and on forever.
translation: §eÛneindige wrâlden§f geane hieltyd fierder oan en oan.

source_string: §eFlat worlds§f do not have any hills or trees, just an infinite flat area to fill with your creations.
translation: §eFlakke wrâlden§f hawwe gjin heuvels of beammen, mar in ûneindich flak gebiet om te fulle mei jo kreaasjes.

source_string: §eSeed§f: This is a unique number for the world. By entering a seed when you make a new world, you can control how it is created. You can also use a word or phrase for the seed and the game will convert it to a number for you.
translation: §eSied§f: Dit is in unyk nûmer foar de wrâld. Troch in sied yn te fieren by it meitsjen fan in nije wrâld, kinsto kontrolearje hoe't it makke wurdt. Jo kinne ek in wurd of frase brûke foar it sied en it spul sil it foar dy omsette ta in nûmer.

source_string: §eActivate Cheats§f: This setting allows players to use commands. When a world is created with this setting on, all achievements are disabled.
translation: §eCheats aktivearje§f: Dizze ynstelling lit spilers opdrachten brûke. As in wrâld makke is mei dizze ynstelling oan, wurde alle achievements útskeakele.

source_string: Below are gamerules, cheats must be turned on to use them:
translation: Hjirûnder binne spulregels, cheats moatte oanstean om se te brûken:

source_string: §eAlways Day§f: Night will never fall when this setting is turned on.
translation: §eAltyd dei§f: De nacht sil noait falle as dizze ynstelling oanstiet.

source_string: §eDaylight Cycle§f: The time will not advance when this setting is turned off.
translation: §eDeisljocht-syklus§f: De tiid sil net trochgean as dizze ynstelling útstiet.

source_string: §eKeep Inventory§f: This setting allows players to keep their inventory when they die.
translation: §eYnventaris hâlde§f: Dizze ynstelling lit spilers har ynventaris hâlde as se deagean.

source_string: §eMob Spawning§f: This prevents all mobs from spawning when this setting is off.
translation: §eMob-spawnen§f: Dit foarkomt dat alle mobs spawne as dizze ynstelling útstiet.

source_string: §eMob Griefing§f: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: §eMob-fernielsucht§f: Foarkomt dat mobs de wrâld fernielje.

source_string: §eEntities Drop Loot§f: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: §eEntiteiten litte plunder falle§f: Kontrolearret oft dingen sa as mynkarren en bepantseringsstanders harsels falle litte as se brutsen wurde.

source_string: §eWeather Cycle§f: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: §eWaarsyklus§f: It waar sil net feroarje as dizze ynstelling útstiet.

source_string: Hoppers are used to automatically move items. Hoppers can be attached to some other items like containers such as Chests or Jukeboxes.
translation: Trachters wurde brûkt om items automatysk te ferpleatsen. Trachters kinne oanhelle wurde oan guon oare items sa as konteners lykas Kisten of Jukeboxen.

source_string: Hoppers will continuously remove items out of a container placed above them and move them into the container they are pointing to.
translation: Trachters sille konstant items út in kontener delset dêrboppe helje en se ferpleatse yn de kontener dêr't se nei wize.

source_string: To make a Hopper point to a particular block, place the Hopper against that block while sneaking.
translation: Om in Trachter nei in bepaald blok wize te litten, set de Trachter tsjin dat blok wylst slûpend.

source_string: If a Hopper is powered by Redstone, it will become inactive and stop moving items.
translation: As in Trachter fan Redstone foarsjoen wurdt, wurdt it ynaktyf en hâldt op mei it ferpleatsen fan items.

source_string: When playing with cheats on, host options will allow you to teleport yourself or friends, change the weather, set the time of day, and change the entry point or world spawn of your game. Once cheats have been enabled, you can find these options in the chat window by pressing the [/] button next to the chat bar.
translation: By it spyljen mei cheats oan, litte hostopsjes dy teleporteare dysels of freonen, it waar feroarje, de tiid fan de dei ynstelle, en it yngongspunt of wrâldspawn fan jo spul feroarje. Ienris cheats ynskeakele binne, kinsto dizze opsjes fine yn it chatfinster troch de [/]-knop neist de chatbalke te drukken.

source_string: When playing with cheats on, host options will allow you to teleport yourself or friends, change the weather, set the time of day, and change the entry point or world spawn of your game. Once cheats have been enabled, you can find these options in the chat window by tapping the chat button.
translation: By it spyljen mei cheats oan, litte hostopsjes dy teleporteare dysels of freonen, it waar feroarje, de tiid fan de dei ynstelle, en it yngongspunt of wrâldspawn fan jo spul feroarje. Ienris cheats ynskeakele binne, kinsto dizze opsjes fine yn it chatfinster troch de chatknop oan te tikjen.

source_string: Use your tools a lot and they'll eventually break. As you gather new materials, such as stone, you'll be able to craft better tools.
translation: Brûk jo ark in soad en se sille úteinlik brekke. As jo nije materialen sammelje, sa as stien, kinsto better ark meitsje.

source_string: Tools of higher tiers are more durable, more efficient, and able to gather more valuable resources. Go out into the world and find out for yourself!
translation: Ark fan hegere nivo's binne duorsumer, effisjinter, en kinne weardefollere boarnen winne. Gean it wrâld yn en fyn it sels út!

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :_input_key.inventory: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Jo hotbar sil folraken as jo mear boarnen sammelje. Druk :_input_key.inventory: om tagong te krijen ta jo §eynventaris§f, dêr jo mear romte hawwe foar alles dat jo sammele hawwe.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Tap :tip_touch_inventory: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Jo hotbar sil folraken as jo mear boarnen sammelje. Tap :tip_touch_inventory: om tagong te krijen ta jo §eynventaris§f, dêr jo mear romte hawwe foar alles dat jo sammele hawwe.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :rift_B: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Jo hotbar sil folraken as jo mear boarnen sammelje. Druk :rift_B: om tagong te krijen ta jo §eynventaris§f, dêr jo mear romte hawwe foar alles dat jo sammele hawwe.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Jo hotbar sil folraken as jo mear boarnen sammelje. Druk :windowsmr_left_grab: om tagong te krijen ta jo §eynventaris§f, dêr jo mear romte hawwe foar alles dat jo sammele hawwe.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Open your inventory, click the item of your choice, then drag it to the empty item slot you'd like to move it to.
translation: Wolst wat ferpleatse tusken jo §ehotbar§f en jo ynventaris? Iepenje jo ynventaris, klik it item fan jo kiis, en sleep it dan nei it lege itemslot dêrst it nei ferpleatse wolst.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.
translation: Wolst wat ferpleatse tusken jo §ehotbar§f en jo ynventaris? Brûk de rinnerwizer om in item te selektearjen en druk :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Ferpleats dan jo rinnerwizer nei in leech itemslot en druk wer om it item del te lizzen.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Tap the item of your choice, then tap the empty item slot that you'd like to move it to.
