translation: Wolst wat ferpleatse tusken jo §ehotbar§f en jo ynventaris? Tap it item fan jo kiis, en tap dan it lege itemslot dêrst it nei ferpleatse wolst.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_input_key.use:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.
translation: Wolst wat ferpleatse tusken jo §ehotbar§f en jo ynventaris? Brûk de rinnerwizer om in item te selektearjen en druk :_input_key.use:. Ferpleats dan jo rinnerwizer nei in leech itemslot en druk wer om it item del te lizzen.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks give creators the ability to generate large structures in the world by connecting multiple structure templates.
translation: Puzelblokken jouwe makkers de mooglikheid om grutte struktueren yn de wrâld te generearjen troch meardere struktuersjabloanen te ferbine.

source_string: To get a Jigsaw Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Jigsaw Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Om in Puzelblok te krijen moatst de /give-slasjopdracht brûke. Om in Puzelblok te brûken, moatst Operator-tastimmingen hawwe.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks have multiple settings that control how they join together to form a larger structure.
translation: Puzelblokken hawwe meardere ynstellingen dy't kontrolearje hoe se tegearre ferbine ta in grutter struktuer.

source_string: §eTarget Pool§f - The path of the template pool to search for a connecting structure template. The template pool should contain at least one structure that matches the Jigsaw's "Target Name" field.
translation: §eDoelspul§f - It paad fan de sjabloanpoel om te sykjen foar in ferbinende struktuersjabloan. De sjabloanpoel moat op syn minst ien struktuer befetsje dy't oerienkomt mei it "doelnamme"-fjild fan de Puzel.

source_string: §eName§f - The name of the Jigsaw. This is used when connecting from Jigsaws with a matching "Target Name".
translation: §eNamme§f - De namme fan de Puzel. Dit wurdt brûkt by it ferbinen fan Puzels mei in oerienkommende "doelnamme".

source_string: §eTurns Into§f - The type of block the Jigsaw Block will turn into when placed in the world during structure generation.
translation: §eWurdt§f - It bloktype dat it Puzelblok wurde sil as it yn de wrâld setten wurdt tidens struktuergeneraasje.

source_string: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece is being processed for connections, this is the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descending priority with random ordering breaking ties.
translation: §eSeleksjeprioriteit§f - As it âlderstik ferwurke wurdt foar ferbinings, is dit de folchoarder wêryn dit Puzelblok besiket te ferbinen mei syn doelstik. Puzels wurde ferwurke yn dellendend prioriteit mei willekeurige folchoarder om gelikense gefallen op te lossen.

source_string: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this is the order in which that piece is processed for connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descending priority with insertion order breaking ties.
translation: §eDelsettingsprioriteit§f - As dit Puzelblok ferbint mei in stik, is dit de folchoarder wêryn dat stik ferwurke wurdt foar ferbinings yn de wider struktuer. Stikken wurde ferwurke yn dellendend prioriteit mei ynfoegingsfolchoarder om gelikense gefallen op te lossen.

source_string: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type is Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type is Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation of the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation of the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block is placed facing up or down.
translation: §eGewrichtstype§f - In gewricht kin Rôlber (standert) of Alinjeard wêze. As it gewrichtstype Rôlber is, wurdt de doelstruktuer willekeurich draaid om it boarne-Puzelblok. As it gewrichtstype Alinjeard is, wurdt de doelstruktuer setten sadat de rotaasje fan it doel-Puzelblok alinjeart mei de rotaasje fan it boarne-Puzelblok. Wês bewust dat dit allinnich fan tapassing is as it Puzelblok omheech of omleech rjochte delset wurdt.

source_string: The Jukebox will play Music Discs that you have found.
translation: De Jukebox sil Muzykskiven spylje dyst fûn hast.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Press :_input_key.use: the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Jukebox mei in Muzykskiif yn jo hân om it te spyljen. Druk :_input_key.use: op'e Jukebox wer om de Muzykskiif út te smiten.

source_string: Tap a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Tap the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Tap in Jukebox mei in Muzykskiif yn jo hân om it te spyljen. Tap de Jukebox wer om de Muzykskiif út te smiten.

source_string: When a Jukebox is playing a Music Disc, it will power Redstone Dust.
translation: As in Jukebox in Muzykskiif spilet, sil it Redstonepoeier krêft jaan.

source_string: Try different Music Discs for a different power level.
translation: Probearje ferskillende Muzykskiven foar in oar krêftnivo.

source_string: See what happens when you let it play to the end.
translation: Sjoch wat der bart as jo it hielendal ôfspylje litte.

source_string: A Hopper can put a Music Disc in for you, and take it out when it's done playing.
translation: In Trachter kin in Muzykskiif foar dy delsette, en it útnimme as it dien is mei spyljen.

source_string: There are a couple of Music Discs that can be found in Chests around the world.
translation: Der binne in pear Muzykskiven dy't fûn wurde kinne yn Kisten oer de wrâld hinne.

source_string: Others are more difficult to come by, Creepers secretly appreciate music.
translation: Oaren binne dreger te fine, Creepers wurdearje geheim muzyk.

source_string: The Loom is a fast and efficient way to apply patterns to Banners. The Loom only uses one Dye to apply a pattern. It can also use Loom patterns to apply special patterns.
translation: It Weefgetou is in flotte en effisjinte manier om patroanen op Banieren ta te passen. It Weefgetou brûkt allinnich ien ferve om in patroan ta te passen. It kin ek Weefgetoupatroanen brûke om spesjale patroanen ta te passen.

source_string: By placing a Banner into the Loom's first slot, and any color dye into the second slot, patterns can be added to the Banner. Once a pattern is selected, take it from the output slot on the right and move it to your inventory.
translation: Troch in Banier yn it earste slot fan it Weefgetou te setten, en elke kleur ferve yn it twadde slot, kinne patroanen tafoege wurde oan de Banier. Ienris in patroan selektearre is, nim it út it útfierslot rjochts en ferpleats it nei jo ynventaris.

source_string: A Banner can have multiple layers allowing you to experiment with many different banner possibilities. Up to 6 patterns can be applied to a Banner to create a unique design.
translation: In Banier kin meardere lagen hawwe, sadat jo mei in soad ferskillende banier-mooglikheden experimintearje kinne. Oant 6 patroanen kinne tapast wurde op in Banier om in unyk ûntwerp te meitsjen.

source_string: Adding a Loom Pattern to the Loom's third slot will allow the crafting of special patterns like a creeper face or a flower pattern. You will not lose your Loom Patterns when you apply these patterns to your Banners.
translation: It tafoegjen fan in Weefgetoupatroan oan it tredde slot fan it Weefgetou sil de meitsjen fan spesjale patroanen sa as in creeper-gesicht of in bloempatroan tastean. Jo ferlieze jo Weefgetoupatroanen net as jo dizze patroanen op jo Banieren tapasse.

source_string: Explore thrilling themed worlds, parceled up with matching skins, textures and more!
translation: Ferken spannende themawrâlden, ynpakt mei bijhearrende skins, texturen en mear!

source_string: Explore a world of possibility with Minecoins: Minecraft's in-game currency! Minecoins let you add variety to your gameplat across supported Minecraft games.
translation: Ferken in wrâld fol mooglikheden mei Minecoins: de yn-spul-munteenheid fan Minecraft! Minecoins litte dy fariëteit tafoegje oan jo spultsjes fan stipe Minecraft-spullen.

source_string: Once redeemed, your Minecoins are linked to your Microsoft account, so you can access your coins and purchases on other supported devices, too!
translation: Ienris ynlevere, binne jo Minecoins ferbûn oan jo Microsoft-account, sadatsto tagong ta jo munten en oankeapen op oare stipe apparaten hawwe kinst, ek!

source_string: *Minecoins require a version of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins are not compatible on PlayStation®. For compatibility information see minecraft.net/minecoins
translation: *Minecoins fereaskje in ferzje fan Minecraft: Bedrock Edition mei Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins binne net kompatibel op PlayStation®. Foar kompatibiliteitsynformaasje sjoch minecraft.net/minecoins

source_string: Not all crafting materials are on the surface - some may require you to dig underground or into a mountain.
translation: Net alle ambachtsmaterialen binne op it oerflak - guon fereaskje dat jo ûnder de grûn of yn in bergen groeve.

source_string: A §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: helps you uncover all sorts of materials, such as stone, coal, iron, and precious ore - though you may need extra sturdy tools for some rarer materials!
translation: In §epikeaks§f:wood_pickaxe: helpt dy alle soarten materialen ûntdekke, sa as stien, koal, izer, en weardefol erts - alhoewol jo miskien ekstra stevich ark nedich hawwe foar guon seldsumere materialen!

source_string: Some raw metals will need to be smelted using a §efurnace§f:furnace: . Place a fuel like coal or wood logs in the fuel slot, then add raw ore to smelt it into something useful.
translation: Guon rou metalen moatte smoltsje wurde mei in §efornús§f:furnace: . Set in brânstof sa as koal of houtstammen yn it brânstofslot, en foegje dan rou erts ta om it te smoltsjen ta wat brûkbers.

source_string: A player can ride any adult §eHorse§f, §eDonkey§f, §eMule§f, or §eCamel§f. Only Horses can be armored.
translation: In spiler kin elke folwoeksen §ePeard§f, §eEzel§f, §eMoal§f, of §eKamiel§f ride. Allinnich Peardsleauwen kinne bepantsere wurde.

source_string: Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags (for transporting items) by attaching a Chest. These saddlebags can then be accessed whilst riding or sneaking.
translation: Moallen en Ezels kinne mei sealekiste (foar it transportearjen fan items) oandien wurde troch in Kiste te befestigen. Dizze sealekisten kinne dan tagonklik wêze wylst ridend of slûpend.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Press :_input_key.use: with an empty hand to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Peardsleauwen, Ezels, en Moallen moatte §etamme§f wurde foardat se brûkt wurde kinne. In spiler kin in hynder tamje troch it te ride en der op te bliuwen wylst it besiket harren derôf te bokkjen. Druk :_input_key.use: mei in lege hân om te besykjen Peardsleauwen, Ezels, en Moallen te tamjen.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Tap the Mount button that appears when near a horse  to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Peardsleauwen, Ezels, en Moallen moatte §etamme§f wurde foardat se brûkt wurde kinne. In spiler kin in hynder tamje troch it te ride en der op te bliuwen wylst it besiket harren derôf te bokkjen. Tap de Ride-knop dy't ferskynt as jo tichtby in hynder binne om te besykjen Peardsleauwen, Ezels, en Moallen te tamjen.

source_string: When Hearts appear around the horse, it has been tamed and will no longer attempt to throw the player off.
translation: As Herten ferskine om it hynder, is it tamme en sil it net mear besykje de spiler derôf te smiten.

source_string: To steer horses and camels, the player must equip it with a §eSaddle§f.
translation: Om hynders en kamielen te stjoere, moat de spiler it útrêsten mei in §eSeal§f.

source_string: Saddles can be bought from villagers, found inside Chests hidden in the world, or acquired by fishing. While riding a horse, open your inventory and put a saddle in the horse's saddle slot.
translation: Sealen kinne kocht wurde fan doarpelingen, fûn yn Kisten ferburgen yn de wrâld, of krigen troch fiskjen. Wylst ridend op in hynder, iepenje jo ynventaris en set in seal yn it sealenslot fan it hynder.

source_string: A camel can carry two players at the same time.
translation: In kamiel kin twa spilers op itselde stuit drage.

source_string: Horses and Donkeys can be bred like other animals using Golden Apples or Golden Carrots.
translation: Peardsleauwen en Ezels kinne oantele wurde lykas oare bisten mei Golden Apels of Golden Woartels.

source_string: Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feeding them Wheat or Hay will speed this up.
translation: Fole sille yn'e tiid groeie ta folwoeksen hynders, alhoewol se te fiere mei Weet of Hea dit fersnellet.

source_string: Llamas are another ridable mob which can be tamed and used to transport large shipments of items.
translation: Lama's binne in oare ridbare mob dy't tamme wurde kin en brûkt wurde kin om grutte lâdingen fan items te transportearjen.

source_string: Llamas can be tamed the same as horses. However, even when tamed, the player can't control their movements when riding them.
translation: Lamas kinne krekt as hynders tamme wurde. Sels as se tamme binne, kin de spiler harren bewegingen net stjoere wylst men op harren rydt

source_string: A lead can be attached to one, and when this happens, surrounding llamas (both tamed and un-tamed) will follow, making a caravan.
translation: In lien kin oan ien befestige wurde, en as dit bart, sille omlizzende lama's (sawol tamme as net-tamme) folgje, en meitsje in karavaan.

source_string: Llamas can be equipped with chests, giving it 3-15 slots of inventory space depending on the strength of the Llama. They can also be equipped with carpets. Each carpet color yields a different pattern.
translation: Lama's kinne mei kisten útrêst wurde, jouwend it 3-15 slots fan ynventarisromte ôfhinklik fan de krêft fan de Lama. Se kinne ek útrêst wurde mei tapiten. Elke tapytkleur jout in oare patroan.

source_string: Pigs can be ridden as well, although they won't go where you want without a little incentive.
translation: Baarchen kinne ek ridden wurde, alhoewol se net gean sille wêr jo wolle sûnder wat oanmoedigjen.

source_string: Equip a pig with a Saddle and point a Carrot on a Stick in the direction you want to go.
translation: Rêst in baarch út mei in Seal en wiis in Woartel op in Stok yn de rjochting dêr jo hinne wolle.
Druk op :_input_key.sneak: om ôf te stappen.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to dismount an animal.
translation: By gebrûk fan it D-pad-bestjoerskema, tap :touch_jump: om ôf te stappen fan in bist.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to dismount an animal.
translation: By gebrûk fan in Joystick-bestjoerskema, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: om ôf te stappen fan in bist.

source_string: Welcome to the Overworld, a blocky world full of adventure and possibility!
translation: Wolkom bij de Oerwrâld, in bloklike wrâld fol aventoer en mooglikheid!
Sjoch om dy hinne mei de mûs.

source_string: Look around by touching and dragging the screen.
translation: Sjoch om dy hinne troch it skerm oan te reitsjen en te sleepjen.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Beweech troch de wrâld mei de joystick op it skerm:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen buttons.
translation: Beweech troch de wrâld mei de knoppen op it skerm.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Beweech troch de wrâld mei de joystick op it skerm:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: The world is full of resources, including §ebuilding blocks§f, §ecrafting materials§f, and §efood§f.
translation: De wrâld is fol boarnen, ynklusyf §ebouwblokken§f, §eambachtsmaterialen§f, en §efiedsel§f.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §epress and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Jo kinne §eblokken brekke§f mei jo bleate hannen om boarnen sa as modder en hout te sammeljen. Rjochtje op in blok, en §edruk en hâld§f :_input_key.attack: yn oant it brekt en de boarnen falle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. §eTouch and hold§f on the block until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Jo kinne §eblokken brekke§f mei jo bleate hannen om boarnen sa as modder en hout te sammeljen. §eReitsje en hâld§f it blok oan oant it brekt en de boarnen falle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §etouch and hold§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Jo kinne §eblokken brekke§f mei jo bleate hannen om boarnen sa as modder en hout te sammeljen. Rjochtje op in blok, en §ereitsje en hâld§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy: yn oant it brekt en de boarnen falle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §eclick and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Jo kinne §eblokken brekke§f mei jo bleate hannen om boarnen sa as modder en hout te sammeljen. Rjochtje op in blok, en §eklik en hâld§f :_input_key.attack: yn oant it brekt en de boarnen falle.

source_string: Pick up any dropped resources by walking over the floating icons.
translation: Pik alle fallende boarnen op troch oer de driuwende ikoanen te rinnen.

source_string: Resources you pick up will appear in your §ehotbar§f, which you'll find at the bottom of the screen.
translation: Boarnen dy'st opikest sille ferskine yn jo §ehotbar§f, dy'st ûnder oan it skerm fine kinst.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, scroll the mouse wheel to select the item. You can also use a number key: 1 is the first hotbar slot and 9 is the last.
translation: Om in item yn jo hân te hâlden, skow it mûswiel om it item te selektearjen. Jo kinne ek in nûmerknop brûke: 1 is it earste hotbarslot en 9 is it lêste.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select the item.
translation: Om in item yn jo hân te hâlden, brûk :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: en :_input_key.cycleItemRight: om it item te selektearjen.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, simply tap it in the hotbar.
translation: Om in item yn jo hân te hâlden, tap it gewoan yn de hotbar.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :rift_left_trigger: and :rift_left_grab: to select the item.
translation: Om in item yn jo hân te hâlden, brûk :rift_left_trigger: en :rift_left_grab: om it item te selektearjen.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to select the item.
translation: Om in item yn jo hân te hâlden, brûk :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: om it item te selektearjen.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :_input_key.use:.
translation: Guon items, lykas bûtsen, fiskstokken, en bôgen, kinne brûkt wurde troch te tikjen op de bou/brûk-knop :_input_key.use:.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by touching and holding anywhere on the screen.
translation: Guon items, sa as buckets, fiskangels, en bôgen, kinne brûkt wurde troch oeral op it skerm te reitsjen en te hâlden.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Guon items, lykas bûtsen, fiskstokken, en bôgen, kinne brûkt wurde troch te tikjen op de bou/brûk-knop :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: Any block you've picked up can placed back into the world. This way you can build a cozy §eshelter§f or anything else you can imagine!
translation: Elk blok dat jo opikest hawwe kin werom yn de wrâld setten wurde. Sa kinsto in noflik §eûnderkommen§f of wat oars dat jo je foarstelle kinne bouwe!

source_string: Choose a block in your hotbar, then press :_input_key.use: to place it.
translation: Kies in blok yn jo hotbar, en druk dan :_input_key.use: om it del te setten.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap somewhere in the world to place it.
translation: Tap in blok yn jo hotbar om it te selektearjen, dan tap earne yn de wrâld om it del te setten.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to place it.
translation: Tap in blok yn jo hotbar om it te selektearjen, dan tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: om it del te setten.

source_string: Don't worry if you place something in the wrong spot - simply break it again, then pick it back up!
translation: Gjin noed as jo wat op it ferkearde plak setten hawwe - brekje it gewoan wer, en pik it dan werom op!

source_string: Navigation is an important skill that you will learn in Minecraft as it's not always easy to find your way home.
translation: Navigaasje is in wichtige feardigens dy'st leare sil yn Minecraft, want it is net altyd maklik om jo wei nei hûs te finen.

source_string: First of all, there are some basic tools that you should know about.
translation: Foaral, der binne guon basisark dy'st witte moatst.

source_string: A Compass will point in the direction of the first place you spawned into the world, an easy way to find where you started.
translation: In Kompas sil wize yn de rjochting fan it earste plak dêrst yn de wrâld spawnearren, in maklike manier om te finen wêrst begûn bist.

source_string: A Map lets you see the area you've explored. Put it in your offhand slot to use it like a mini-map. You can increase its size by adding more paper to the edges in a Crafting Table.
translation: In Kaart lit dy it gebiet sjen dat jo ferkend hawwe. Set it yn jo oare-hânslot om it te brûken lykas in minykaart. Jo kinne syn grutte fergrutsje troch mear papier ta te foegjen oan de kanten yn in Wurkbank.

source_string: A Locator Map will show you where you are and what direction you are facing in relation to the Locator Map's origin. It will also show you the location of other players in the same world.
translation: In Lokaasjekaart sil dy sjen litte wêr jo binne en wêr jo hinne rjochte binne yn relaasje ta de oarsprong fan de Lokaasjekaart. It sil ek de lokaasje fan oare spilers yn de selde wrâld sjen litte.

source_string: A Cartography Table can help you create, expand, copy and even name maps.
translation: In Kartografytafel kin dy helpe kaarten te meitsjen, útwreidzje, kopiearje en sels beneame.

source_string: Place paper into the first slot to craft a Map. If you add a compass into the second slot you can craft a Locator Map. Adding Paper or a blank Map will let you expand or copy your Map.
translation: Set papier yn it earste slot om in Kaart te meitsjen. As jo in kompas yn it twadde slot tafoegje kinsto in Lokaasjekaart meitsje. It tafoegjen fan Papier of in liuwe Kaart lit dy jo Kaart útwreidzje of kopiearje.

source_string: Try to watch for landmarks as you explore. The more you play on a world, the more you will be able to remember where you are. Another good trick is to place Torches as you go so that you may find your way back home.
translation: Probearje op te lette foar mearkstiennen wylst jo ferkenne. Hoe mear jo op in wrâld spylje, hoe mear jo ûnthâlde kinne wêr jo binne. In oare goede trick is om Fakkels del te setten wylst jo geane, sadatsto jo wei werom nei hûs fine kinst.

source_string: The sun can also tell you what direction you are facing. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!
translation: De sinne kin dy ek sizze hokker rjochting jo hinne rjochte binne. Ûnthâld: de sinne komt op yn it easten en set yn it westen!

source_string: There are several places for you to explore. Find a village and look for a Cartographer. He will trade you Explorer Maps that will lead you to strange places very far away.
translation: Der binne ferskate plakken foar dy om te ferkenne. Fyn in doarp en sykje foar in Kartograaf. Hy sil dy Ferkennerkaarten ferhannelje dy't dy nei frjemde plakken hiel fier fuort liede.

source_string: A Nether Portal allows you to travel to a different dimension.
translation: In Netherportaal lit dy nei in oare dimenzje reize.

source_string: If constructed correctly the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.
translation: As it krekt bout is, kin it Netherportaal oanstutsen en aktivearre wurde.

source_string: Example of a portal construction shown here:
translation: In foarbyld fan in portaalkonstruksje hjir sjoen wurdt:

source_string: In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as you adventure in your world. As the sun sets, you must take precautions. There are many dangers at night!
translation: Yn Minecraft komt de sinne op en set as jo aventoerje yn jo wrâld. Wylst de sinne set, moatst foarsoarchsmaatregels nimme. Der binne in soad gefaren by nacht!

source_string: If you have not already, you will need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side of a hill or a small cabin in the forest.
translation: As jo it noch net hawwe, hawwe jo in plak nedich om ûnderkommen te sykjen fan it tsjuster en wat der binnen loeret. Dit kin sa simpel wêze as in gat yn de kant fan in heuvel of in lyts kabaan yn it bosk.

source_string: Be sure to block off all entrances, you may want to use a door so you can go in and out. If you have made a bed this is a good place to put it along with your Crafting Table and Furnace.
translation: Wês sûndersto ynstruksjes befesde te blokkearjen alle yngongen, jo wolle miskien in doar brûke sadatsto der yn en út kinst. As jo in bêd makke hawwe, is dit in goed plak om it hinne te setten mei jo Wurkbank en Fornús.

source_string: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save your life.
translation: Soargje ek derfoar dat jo it gebiet ferljochte mei fakkels, it kin jo libben rêde.

source_string: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.
translation: As de sinne begjint te setten, is it tiid om jo ree te meitsjen.

source_string: At night, the Overworld is home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.
translation: By nacht is de Oerwrâld thús foar sombys, spinnen, skeletten, en oare gefaarlike wêzens dy't wy §efijannige mobs§f neame.

source_string: Crafting some §etorches§f can help you see in the dark, while also keeping mobs from spawning too close.
translation: It meitsjen fan wat §efakkels§f kin dy helpe om yn it tsjuster te sjen, wylst it ek mobs derfan wjerhâldt te ticht by te spawnjen.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by right-clicking a nearby free surface.
translation: Wylst jo in fakkel hâlde, set it yn de wrâld troch rjochts te klikken op in tichtbijsjend frij oerflak.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by pressing :_input_key.use:.
translation: Wylst do in fakkel fêsthâldst, plakst dy yn de wrâld troch te drukken op :_input_key.use:.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by tapping a nearby free surface.
translation: Wylst jo in fakkel hâlde, set it yn de wrâld troch in tichtbijsjend frij oerflak oan te tikjen.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by aiming at a nearby block and tapping :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Wylst do in fakkel fêsthâldst, plakst dy yn de wrâld troch op in tichtby lizzend blok te rjochtsjen en te tikjen op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by pressing :_input_key.use: while looking at them.
translation: Der binne ferskate mobs yn Minecraft dyst tamje en jo húsdier meitsje kinst. Elk kin tamme wurde troch harren in item te jaan dat se leuk fine. Ienris tamme kinsto se stean litte troch :_input_key.use: te drukken wylst jo harren oansjocht.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by tapping the Sit Button.
translation: Der binne ferskate mobs yn Minecraft dyst tamje en jo húsdier meitsje kinst. Elk kin tamme wurde troch harren in item te jaan dat se leuk fine. Ienris tamme kinsto se stean litte troch de Sit-knop oan te tikjen.

source_string: Wolves are a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They will attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack you unless you provoke them. You can tame them by giving them Bones.
translation: Wolven binne in neutrale mob dy't jaget yn de kâldere klimaten. Se sille Kninen, Skeletten, en Skiep oanfalle mar rinne fuort fan Lama's. Se sille dy net oanfalle útsûnderd as jo harren provosearje. Jo kinne se tamje troch harren Bonken te jaan.

source_string: Cats are a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They will attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They will also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They will try to run from you so taming them can be tough. They like fish so give them Raw Cod or Salmon to tame them.
translation: Katten binne in neutrale mob dy't yn doarpen fûn wurde kinne. Se sille Kninen en Babyskylpodden oanfalle. Se sille ek Fantomen en Creepers fuorthâlde. Se sille besykje fuort te rinnen fan dy, dus se tamje kin dreech wêze. Se hâlde fan fisk, dus jou harren Rou Kod of Salm om se te tamjen.

source_string: Parrots are a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They will imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds are their favorite, give them a few to tame them. Parrots will also sit on your shoulder... Yes, you can have more than one up there.
translation: Pappegaaien binne in passive mob dy't yn de Jungel wenje. Se sille elke oare mob yn it gebiet imitearje. Siedden binne har favorite, jou harren in pear om se te tamjen. Pappegaaien sille ek op jo skouder sitte... Ja, jo kinne mear as ien dêr boppe hawwe.

source_string: While exploring the world you may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers are always looking for villages to raid. Taking their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.
translation: Wylst jo de wrâld ferkenne, kinne jo in Pleeger-kampemint of patrouille tsjinkomme. Pleegers sykje altyd doarpen om oer te fallen. It nimmen fan har Banieren sil har oandacht krije, en se kinne kieze om in tichtbijsjend doarp oan te fallen.

source_string: Be sure to defend your village, the attack will stop if you defeat all the raiders.
translation: Soargje derfoar datsto jo doarp ferdigenest, de oanfal sil ophâlde as jo alle oerfallers ferslaan.

source_string: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that you have saved them from the raiders. Be sure to check back with them, you might get a good deal.
translation: Doarpelingen sille wierskynlik hiel tankber wêze dat jo harren rêden hawwe fan de oerfallers. Soargje derfoar datsto by harren nochris del sjochst, jo krije miskien in goede deal.

source_string: In Minecraft, you can have your own ranch filled with livestock! Ranching provides lots of resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.
translation: Yn Minecraft kinsto jo eigen feefokkerij hawwe fol mei fee! Feefokkerij jout in soad boarnen sa as wol, aaien, en rou fleis.

source_string: In order to keep your livestock growing, you have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode for this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get them to enter Love Mode.
translation: Om jo fee te litten groeien, moatst baby-bisten meitsje. Folwoeksen bisten moatte de Leafdesmodus yngean om dit te litten barre. Fied de bisten mei har foarkommene fiedsel om se de Leafdesmodus yn te litten gean.

source_string: When two like animals are nearby and in Love Mode, they will kiss for a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After having a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before entering Love Mode.
translation: As twa gelikense bisten tichtby en yn Leafdesmodus binne, sille se momint kusje en dan sil in baby-bist ferskine! It baby-bist sil bij har âlden bliuwe oant se folwoeksen wurde. Nei it hawwen fan in baby, moatte folwoeksen bisten 1 minút wachtsje foardat se Leafdesmodus yngean.

source_string: Cows, mooshrooms, and sheep all eat Wheat. Pigs can eat Carrots or Beetroot. Chickens love Seeds of any kinds. Rabbits will eat Carrots, Golden Carrots, or Dandelions. Ocelots enjoy Raw Cod or Salmon. Wolves like to eat any kind of meat.
translation: Kij, mooshrooms, en skiep ite allegearre Weet. Baarchen kinne Woartels of Beetwoartel ite. Hinnen hâlde fan Siedden fan elke soarten. Kninen sille Woartels, Golden Woartels, of Pjuttebliedden ite. Ocelotten hâlde fan Rou Kod of Salm. Wolven hâlde fan elke soarte fleis ite.

source_string: Animals will follow you when you hold their desired food item. This will help you lead them to your ranch or another animal.
translation: Bisten sille dy folgje as jo har foarkommene fiedselitem hâlde. Dit sil dy helpe se te liede nei jo feefokkerij of in oar bist.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply click a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gjin noed, jo hawwe net nedich om elk resept út de holle te ûnthâlde. It §ereseptboek§f yn jo ynventaris hâldt track fan blokken en items dyst meitsje kinst - klik gewoan op in resept om te sjen wat jo nedich hawwe om it te meitsjen.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply select a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gjin noed, jo hawwe net nedich om elk resept út de holle te ûnthâlde. It §ereseptboek§f yn jo ynventaris hâldt track fan blokken en items dyst meitsje kinst - selektearje gewoan in resept om te sjen wat jo nedich hawwe om it te meitsjen.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply tap a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gjin noed, jo hawwe net nedich om elk resept út de holle te ûnthâlde. It §ereseptboek§f yn jo ynventaris hâldt track fan blokken en items dyst meitsje kinst - tap gewoan in resept om te sjen wat jo nedich hawwe om it te meitsjen.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, click the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ienris jo de fereaske ambachtsyngrediïnten sammele hawwe, klik it resept nochris, en ferpleats it dan fan it útfierslot nei jo hotbar of ynventaris.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, select the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ienris jo de fereaske ambachtsyngrediïnten sammele hawwe, selektearje it resept nochris, en ferpleats it dan fan it útfierslot nei jo hotbar of ynventaris.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, tap the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ienris jo de fereaske ambachtsyngrediïnten sammele hawwe, tap it resept nochris, en ferpleats it dan fan it útfierslot nei jo hotbar of ynventaris.

source_string: Redstone Dust comes from Redstone Ore. This dust transmits an electrical signal. When it has power it lights up and transmits its signal to other Redstone items that are next to it.
translation: Redstonepoeier komt fan Redstonets. Dit poeier stjoert in elektrysk sinjaal troch. As it krêft hat, ljochtet it op en stjoert syn sinjaal troch nei oare Redstoneitems neist him.

source_string: In order for one of these items to be powered, it needs a power source such as a Lever, Button, or Pressure Plate. Experiment to find them all!
translation: Om ien fan dizze items fan krêft foarsjoen te wurde, hawwe se in krêftboarne nedich sa as in slinger, knop, of drukplaat. Experimintearje om se allegearre te finen!

source_string: Place some Redstone Dust next to a power source and turn it on to power it.
translation: Set wat Redstonepoeier neist in krêftboarne en set it oan om it fan krêft te foarsjen.

source_string: There are many items that use a Redstone signal to do something, such as a Hopper or a Piston.
translation: Der binne in soad items dy't in Redstone-sinjaal brûke om wat te dwaan, sa as in Trachter of in Sûging.

source_string: Redstone allows for endless possibilities! Try creating something useful for yourself like an automatic farm!
translation: Redstone lit ûneindige mooglikheden ta! Probearje wat brûkbers foar dysels te meitsjen sa as in automatyske boerderij!

source_string: A social hub for you and all the members of the Realm. Share your adventures and creations by posting stories to the Story Feed, like and comment to celebrate stories posted by other members.
translation: In sosjale hub foar dy en alle leden fan de Realm. Diel jo aventoeren en kreaasjes troch ferhalen te postearjen op de Ferhalefeed, leuk en kommentaar fiere ferhalen postearre troch oare leden.

source_string: Clicking the ADD STORY button on the Story Feed will let you write a story of your own. You can choose to include a screenshot or text (or both!). Clicking the POST button will post your text/screenshot to the Story Feed for all the Realm's members to enjoy. If you don't have any screenshots to post, use the §ecamera§f:camera: on the game menu to capture the moment.
translation: It klikken op de knop NIJ FERHAAL op de Ferhalefeed lit dy jo eigen ferhaal skriuwe. Jo kinne kieze om in skermôfbylding of tekst te befetsjen (of beide!). It klikken op de POST-knop sil jo tekst/skermôfbylding postearje op de Ferhalefeed foar alle leden fan de Realm om te genietsjen. As jo gjin skermôfbyldingen hawwe om te postearjen, brûk de §ekamera§f:camera: op it spulmenu om it momint te fêstlein.

source_string: Whenever there is a new story in the Feed that you haven't read yet, a number will appear on the REALMS STORIES button. You'll always know when there is something new to read from your Realm's community. If you like what someone shared, go ahead and leave them a like or comment on their story!
translation: Elke kear as der in nij ferhaal yn de Feed stiet dat do noch net lêzen hast, komt der in nûmer op de REALMS STORIES-knop te stean. Sa witst altyd wannear't der wat nijs te lêzen is fan de mienskip fan dyn Realm. As do wat leuk fynst dat immen dield hat, gean der dan gerêst op yn troch in like te jaan of in reaksje te pleatsen ûnder harren ferhaal!

source_string: See who's playing and when in the Timeline. Scroll through the members of the Realm to see when they played last and who they played with. Use this information to set up times when you can all play together.
translation: Sjoch wa't spilet en wannear yn de Tiidline. Skoll troch de leden fan de Realm om te sjen wannear se lêst spile hawwe en mei wa se spile hawwe. Brûk dizze ynformaasje om tiden te organisearje wannear jo allegearre tegearre spylje kinne.

source_string: Know who is on the Realm
translation: Wit wa op de Realm is

source_string: Get to know who is part of the Realm by using the Members tab. It's a list of all the players who can play here. You can see who the Realm owner is, who the operators are, and who has joined Realms Stories for this Realm. There are search, sort, and filter options to help you find exactly who you're looking for.
translation: Learne wa in diel fan de Realm is troch de Ledenljepper te brûken. It is in list fan alle spilers dy't hjir spylje kinne. Jo kinne sjen wa't de Realm-eigener is, wa't de operators binne, en wa't Realms Stories foar dizze Realm bywenne hawwe. Der binne sykje-, sortear-, en filteropsjes om dy te helpen krekt te finen wa't jo sykje.

source_string: Realms Stories is available in the game menu when you're playing in the Realm and on the Realms Tab. You can keep up to date and tell your story from anywhere you are, even when you aren't playing. From your console, computer, and mobile device, Realms Stories is available everywhere.
translation: Realms Stories is beskikber yn it spulmenu wannear jo yn de Realm spylje en op de Realmsljepper. Jo kinne op'e hichte bliuwe en jo ferhaal fertelle fan oeral dêr jo binne, sels as jo net spylje. Fan jo konsole, kompjûter, en mobyl apparaat, is Realms Stories oeral beskikber.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Stegers kinne dy helpe om grutte bouwurken feilich te meitsjen! Do kinst yn in steger rinne en derop stean. As do in kolom fan stegers hast, kinst omheech gean troch yn de steger te stean en te drukken op :_input_key.jump:. As do omleech wolst, kinst drukke op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Stegers kinne dy helpe om grutte bouwurken feilich te meitsjen! Do kinst yn in steger rinne en derop stean. As do in kolom fan stegers hast, kinst omheech gean troch yn de steger te stean en te drukken op :_input_key.jump:. As do omleech wolst, kinst yndrukt hâlde op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help with building large structures by offering a way to reach higher places and safely descend without taking fall damage.
translation: Steger kin helpe by it bouwen fan grutte struktueren troch in manier te bieden om hegere plakken te berikken en feilich del te gean sûnder falskea te nimmen.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :touch_fly_down: to climb down.
translation: By gebrûk fan it D-pad-bestjoerskema, tap :touch_jump: om in kolom fan steger op te klimmen. Tap :touch_fly_down: om del te klimmen.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, press :tip_virtual_button_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to climb down.
translation: By gebrûk fan in Joystick-bestjoerskema, druk :tip_virtual_button_jump: om in kolom fan steger op te klimmen. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: om del te klimmen.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :rift_A:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :rift_X:.
translation: Stegers kinne dy helpe om grutte bouwurken feilich te meitsjen! Do kinst yn in steger rinne en derop stean. As do in kolom fan stegers hast, kinst omheech gean troch yn de steger te stean en te drukken op :rift_A:. As do omleech wolst, kinst yndrukt hâlde op :rift_X:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Stegers kinne dy helpe om grutte bouwurken feilich te meitsjen! Do kinst yn in steger rinne en derop stean. As do in kolom fan stegers hast, kinst omheech gean troch yn de steger te stean en te drukken op :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. As do omleech wolst, kinst yndrukt hâlde op :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Scaffolding needs support. You can only place so many scaffolding horizontally without touching a different block. When you attempt to place too many scaffolding blocks without proper support, it will fall. Scaffolding can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.
translation: Steger hat stipe nedich. Jo kinne allinnich sa folle steger horizontaal delsette sûnder in oar blok oan te reitsjen. As jo besykje te folle stegerblokken sûnder juste stipe del te setten, sil it falle. Steger kin delset wurde lykas normale blokken, mar it kin ek op syn eigen fûndamint delset wurde om flot in hege toer te bouwen.

source_string: When Scaffolding is broken it will also break every Scaffolding block that was being supported by it. This will let you quickly clean up your scaffolding by breaking the supporting blocks!
translation: As Steger brutsen wurdt, sil it ek elk Stegerblok brekke dat troch him stipe waard. Dit lit dy flot jo steger opromje troch de stypjende blokken te brekken!

source_string: Put on some fresh pixels and express yourself with a huge variety of inspired looks.
translation: Set wat farske piksels oan en drukke dysels út mei in enoarm ferskaat oan ynspireare uterlikheden.

source_string: Structure Blocks give creators the ability to copy and save out sections of their world into structures. Saved structures can then be pasted back into the world.
translation: Struktuerblokken jouwe makkers de mooglikheid om seksjes fan har wrâld te kopiearje en te bewarje as struktueren. Bewarre struktueren kinne dan werom yn de wrâld plakt wurde.

source_string: To get a Structure Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Structure Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Om in Struktuerblok te krijen moatst de /give-slasjopdracht brûke. Om in Struktuerblok te brûken, moatst Operator-tastimmingen hawwe.

source_string: Structure Blocks have 4 modes that can be switched between with the Mode dropdown: Save, Load, Corner, and 3D Export.
translation: Struktuerblokken hawwe 4 modussen dy't wikselje kinne mei it Modus-útklapmenu: Bewarje, Laad, Hoeke, en 3D-eksport.

source_string: Save mode saves an area of the world as a structure.
translation: Bewarjmodus bewarret in gebiet fan de wrâld as in struktuer.

source_string: Load mode loads a structure into the world. Only structures saved to the world or included in a behavior pack that is applied to the world can be loaded.
translation: Laadmodus laadt in struktuer yn de wrâld. Allinnich struktueren bewarre nei de wrâld of befet yn in gedragspakket dat tapast is op de wrâld kinne laden wurde.

source_string: Corner mode is used with save mode's detect button to automatically set the area you want to save. See the Corner Mode section below for more details.
translation: Hoekmodus wurdt brûkt mei de opsporreknop fan bewarjmodus om automatysk it gebiet ynstelle datsto bewarje wolst. Sjoch de Hoekmodus-seksje hjirûnder foar mear details.

source_string: 3D Export exports a 3D model file on supported platforms.
On the right side of the Structure Block screen, a preview of the area you have selected or the structure to load will appear depending on the mode the block is in.
translation: Oan de rjochterkant fan it Struktuerblok-skerm, sil in foarbyld fan it gebiet dat jo selektearre hawwe of de struktuer om te laden ferskine ôfhinklik fan de modus dêr't it blok yn is.

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Druk :_input_key.attack: en sleep, om it 3D-foarbyld te draaien.

source_string: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Reitsje en sleep op it foarbyld om it 3D-foarbyld te draaien.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: Redstone kin brûkt wurde om in Struktuerblok te aktivearje. Dit sil derfoar soargje dat it óf in struktuer bewarret óf in struktuer yn de wrâld laadt, ôfhinklik fan de modus fan it blok en syn ynstellingen.

source_string: You can change how much of a structure is loaded in by changing the values for Integrity and Seed.
translation: Jo kinne feroarje hoefolle fan in struktuer laden wurdt troch de wearden foar Yntegriteit en Sied te feroarjen.

source_string: Integrity - the percentage of blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values are 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed is not specified.
translation: Yntegriteit - it persintaazje fan blokken om te laden fan de struktuer, akseptearre wearden binne 0 oant 100. Blokken wurde willekeurich keazen as in Sied net spesifisearre is.

source_string: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when using Integrity. Leave this field blank if you want the blocks to be chosen randomly.
translation: Sied - de wearde hjir ynfierd sil bepale hokker blokken fuort te heljen by it brûken fan Yntegriteit. Lit dit fjild leech as jo de blokken willekeurich keazen ha wolle.

source_string: When a structure with Structure Void blocks is loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block is loading into, will instead stay in the world.
translation: As in struktuer mei struktuer-lege blokken yn de wrâld laden wurdt, sil elk blok dat fuortsmiten wurde soe wêr't it struktuer-lege blok yn laadt, ynstee bliuwe yn de wrâld.

source_string: Example: loading an empty shipwreck into the bottom of the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and you will have a shipwreck filled with water.
translation: Foarbyld: it laden fan in leech skipwrak yn de boaiem fan de oseaan sil normaal loft oer de wetterblokken kopiearje. As it skipwrak fol wie mei struktuer-lege, dan sil it wetter bliuwe, en jo krije in skipwrak fol wetter.

source_string: To automatically select the area you want to save, you can place Corner Mode blocks around your structure and name them with the same name as the structure you want to save.
translation: Om automatysk it gebiet dat jo bewarje wolle te selektearjen, kinne jo Hoekmodusblokken om jo struktuer sette en se beneame mei deselde namme as de struktuer dy'st bewarje wolst.

source_string: Pressing the Detect button in Save mode will find all of the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it will save everything inside of the volume those Corner Blocks make.
translation: It drukken op de Opsporreknop yn Bewarjmodus sil alle Hoekblokken mei deselde namme fine en in seleksjegebiet meitsje sadat it alles bewarret binnen it folume dat dizze Hoekblokken meitsje.

source_string: Combine two Shulker Shells with a Chest to create a Shulker Box. Shulker Shells are dropped by Shulkers found in End Cities. Unlike other containers, Shulker Boxes keep their items when broken. Shulker Boxes will break and drop as an item if pushed by Pistons, and can be placed using Dispensers.
translation: Kombinearje twa Shulker-skylpen mei in Kiste om in Shulker-doaze te meitsjen. Shulker-skylpen wurde falle troch Shulkers fûn yn End-stêden. Oars as oare konteners hâlde Shulker-doazen har items as se brutsen wurde. Shulker-doazen sille brekke en falle as in item as se pushed wurde troch Sûgingen, en kinne setten wurde mei Dispensers.

source_string: How to Play: The Crafting Table
Ready to take your crafting to the next level? Place four planks in a square in your crafting grid, and you'll get a §ecrafting table§f :crafting_table: - a whole new way to craft.
translation: Ree om jo ambacht nei it folgjende nivo te tillen? Set fjouwer planken yn in fjouwerkant yn jo ambachtsrooster, en jo krije in §ewurkbank§f :crafting_table: - in hielendal nije manier om te meitsjen.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then right-click it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Set jo wurkbank yn de wrâld, en klik dan rjochts op it om it te iepenjen. It grutter ambachtsrooster sil dy tastean grutter en better dingen te meitsjen, ynklusyf ark, bêden, en doarren.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then walk up to it and press :_input_key.use: to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Set jo wurkbank yn de wrâld, en rin dan derop ta en druk :_input_key.use: om it te iepenjen. It grutter ambachtsrooster sil dy tastean grutter en better dingen te meitsjen, ynklusyf ark, bêden, en doarren.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then tap it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Set jo wurkbank yn de wrâld, en tap it dan om it te iepenjen. It grutter ambachtsrooster sil dy tastean grutter en better dingen te meitsjen, ynklusyf ark, bêden, en doarren.

source_string: The End is another dimension which can be accessed through an active End Portal. The End Portal can be found in a Stronghold, which is deep underground in the Overworld.
translation: De End is in oare dimenzje dy't berikber is troch in aktyf Endportaal. It Endportaal kin fûn wurde yn in Fêsting, dy't djip ûnder de grûn is yn de Oerwrâld.

source_string: Every End Portal Frame block is missing something mysterious to bring out the power within.
translation: Elk Endportaalframe-blok mist wat mystearjeus om de krêft binnen ta útinoar te bringen.

source_string: Once the portal is active, jump into it to go to The End.
translation: Ienris it portaal aktyf is, sprong der yn om nei de End te gean.

source_string: The End is home to the dreaded Ender Dragon. She is a fierce and powerful enemy and seems to draw power from strange crystals. Her breath and fireball attacks leave lingering acid across the battlefield. Bring some friends to ensure your victory!
translation: De End is thús foar de dreamde Ender Draak. Sy is in fjochtlustige en krêftige fijân en liket krêft te helje út frjemde kristallen. Har breath- en fjoerbal-oanfallen litte oanhâldend soer nei har op it slachfjild. Bring wat freonen om jo oerwinning te garandearjen!

source_string: If once wasn't enough, add four End Crystals to the exit portal corners to reawaken the Ender Dragon.
translation: As ienris net genôch wie, foegje fjouwer Endkristallen ta oan de útgongsportaalhoeken om de Ender Draak wer op te wekken.

source_string: Texture packs visually transform the game's appearance, applying a fresh coat of paint to your Minecraft world.
translation: Texturepakken transformearje visueel it uterlik fan it spul, en jouwe in fris laachje ferve oan jo Minecraft-wrâld.

source_string: There are many tools in Minecraft that will allow you mine blocks faster than your fist. Tools can be crafted from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.
translation: Der binne in soad ark yn Minecraft dy't dy tastean blokken flugger te minen as jo fûst. Ark kinne makke wurde fan Hout, Stien, Izer, Goud, Diamant, of Netherite.

source_string: Using the right tool for the job will not only mine that block faster, but will also lose less durability. More complex tools must be created in order to mine rarer resources.
translation: It brûken fan it juste ark foar de taak sil net allinnich dat blok flugger minen, mar sil ek minder duorsumheid ferlieze. Kompleksere ark moatte makke wurde om seldsumere boarnen te minen.

source_string: The Pickaxe is good at breaking hard blocks like Cobblestone, Iron, or Furnaces.
translation: De Pikeaks is goed by it brekken fan hurde blokken sa as Kobblestien, Izer, of Fornuzen.

source_string: The Axe is good at breaking wooden blocks like Logs, Planks, or Crafting Tables.
translation: De Bile is goed by it brekken fan houten blokken sa as Stammen, Planken, of Wurkbanken.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by pressing :_input_key.use: on grass blocks.
translation: De Skoffel is goed by it brekken fan losse blokken sa as Modder, Sân, en Gravel. Skoffels kinne ek in paad meitsje troch :_input_key.use: te drukken op gêrsblokken.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by tapping on grass blocks.
translation: De Skoffel is goed by it brekken fan losse blokken sa as Modder, Sân, en Gravel. Skoffels kinne ek in paad meitsje troch op gêrsblokken te tikken.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Press :_input_key.use: on Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: De Skoffel is fereaske foar it ploegjen fan modder om oanwoaksen te plantsjen. Druk :_input_key.use: op Modder- of Gêrsblokken om se yn Boufjild te feroarje.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Tap Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: De Skoffel is fereaske foar it ploegjen fan modder om oanwoaksen te plantsjen. Tap Modder- of Gêrsblokken om se yn Boufjild te feroarje.

source_string: All of these tools can accept enchantments, either from the Enchanting Table or Anvil.
translation: Al dizze ark kinne betsjoeningen akseptearje, óf fan de Betsjoentafel óf Ambyld.

source_string: There are even more tools to aid you on your adventure:
translation: Der is noch mear ark om dy te helpen op jo aventoer:

source_string: A Bucket will allow you to collect things like Water, Milk, Lava, and even Fish.
translation: In Bucket sil dy tastean dingen te sammeljen sa as Wetter, Molke, Lava, en sels Fisk.

source_string: Flint & Steel allows you to light fires... be careful in densely wooded areas!
translation: Fjoerstien & Stiel lit dy fjoeren oanstekke... wês foarsichtich yn tichtbewoude gebieten!

source_string: A Fishing Rod lets you catch fish and other loot from water blocks. It can also be used to pull other players and mobs. Fishing Rods can also be enchanted!
translation: In Fiskangel lit dy fisk en oare plunder fange fan wetterblokken. It kin ek brûkt wurde om oare spilers en mobs te lûken. Fiskangels kinne ek betsjoene wurde!

source_string: Shears are very handy for collecting items like Wool, Leaves, and Cobwebs.
translation: Skjirren binne heel handich foar it sammeljen fan items sa as Wol, Bledden, en Spinnewevkleeën.

source_string: Trading can be done in villages. Each villager has a profession; they can be Farmers, Butchers, Blacksmiths, Cartographers, Librarians, or Priests. Some professions will trade for items that other professions cannot. Explore and trade with many villagers to find all the trades.
translation: Hannel kin dien wurde yn doarpen. Elke doarpeling hat in berop; se kinne Boeren, Slachters, Smeden, Kartografen, Bibleotekarissen, of Prysters wêze. Guon berops sille hannelje foar items dy't oare berops net kinne. Ferken en hannel mei in soad doarpelingen om alle hannels te finen.

source_string: You can find out what a villager is offering as trade by interacting with them. A villager may adjust the price of a trade whenever a player trades with it. A villager may run out of stock, temporarily disabling the trade if it is used too frequently. Trades usually involve buying or selling items for emeralds.
translation: Jo kinne útfine wat in doarpeling oanbiedt as hannel troch mei har te ynteraksjearjen. In doarpeling kin de priis fan in hannel oanpasse wannear in spiler mei him hannelt. In doarpeling kin sûnder foarrie komme, tydlik útskeakelend de hannel as it te faak brûkt wurdt. Hannels befetsje meastentiids it keapjen of ferkeapjen fan items foar smaragden.

source_string: As you trade with villagers, they will get better at their profession and start to offer better and more valuable trades.
translation: As jo mei doarpelingen hannelje, sille se better wurde yn har berop en begjinne te oanbieden bettere en weardefollere hannels.

source_string: Take care of your villagers, they need to rest, work, and eat to thrive.
translation: Soargje foar jo doarpelingen, se hawwe rest, wurk, en iten nedich om te florearje.

source_string: There are many ways to get around other than walking or riding a mount or flying.
translation: Der binne in soad manieren om om te gean oars as rinnen of ride op in ridbist of fleane.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails. You can make the Rails go wherever you want by placing them next to each other. Place a Minecart on the Rails and you are ready to ride.
translation: Mynkarren binne ridbere karren dy't op Rails rôlje. Jo kinne de Rails gean litte wêr jo wolle troch se neist elkoar te setten. Set in Mynkarre op de Rails en jo binne ree om te ride.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails, which you can build to go anywhere. Just place multiple Rails next to each other, place a Minecart on it, and you're ready to ride.
translation: Mynkarren binne ridbere karren dy't op Rails rôlje, dy'st bouwe kinst nei oeral hinne. Set gewoan meardere Rails neist elkoar, set in Mynkarre derop, en jo binne ree om te ride.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: wylst jo sjoche nei in Mynkarre om der yn te springen en te ride. Druk :_input_key.forward: om foarút te rôlje. Druk :_input_key.jump: of :_input_key.sneak: om der út te gean.

source_string: The Sword is the primary melee weapon in Minecraft. It can be made from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite. Jump attacks do critical damage!
translation: It swurd is it wichtichste hânwapen yn Minecraft. It kin makke wurde fan hout, stien, izer, goud, diamant of Netherite. Sprongoanfallen dogge krityske skea!

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: with a Sword in your hand to attack.
translation: Druk op :_input_key.attack: mei in swurd yn dyn hân om oan te fallen.
Tik op mobs om se oan te fallen.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the bow back. Release :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: De bôge is it wichtichste ôfstânswapen yn Minecraft. Druk :_input_key.use: yn en hâld him yn om de bôge oan te spannen. Lit :_input_key.use: los om in pylk ôf te sjitten. De bôge hat pylken nedich om te sjitten.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold the Screen to draw the bow back. Release the press to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: De bôge is it wichtichste ôfstânswapen yn Minecraft. Druk it skerm yn en hâld it yn om de bôge oan te spannen. Lit los om in pylk ôf te sjitten. De bôge hat pylken nedich om te sjitten.

source_string: Bows do more damage the further they are pulled back, make sure to pull it all the way back.
translation: Bôgen dogge mear skea hoe fierder se weromlutsen wurde, soarch derfoar dat se hielendal weromlutsen wurde.

source_string: The Crossbow is an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to load the crossbow. Once the Crossbow is loaded, it will stay loaded until it is fired. Press :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The Crossbow requires arrows to load.
translation: De krúsbôge is in oar ôfstânswapen. Druk :_input_key.use: yn en hâld him yn om de krúsbôge te laden. As de krúsbôge laden is, bliuwt er laden oant er ôfsketten wurdt. Druk op :_input_key.use: om in pylk ôf te sjitten. De krúsbôge hat pylken nedich om te laden.

source_string: The crossbow is a ranged weapon which requires an arrow to be loaded. Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to load the crossbow with an arrow.
translation: De krúsbôge is in ôfstânswapen dat laden wurde moat mei in pylk. Tik en hâld earne op it skerm yn om de krúsbôge te laden mei in pylk.

source_string: Once you've loaded the crossbow it'll stay loaded until fired, even when you put it in your inventory.
translation: As do de krúsbôge laden hast, bliuwt er laden oant er ôfsketten wurdt, ek as do him yn dyn ynventaris leist.

source_string: Tap anywhere on the screen to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: Tik earne op it skerm om in laden krúsbôge ôf te sjitten.

source_string: If you're using Action Buttons, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: As do Aksjeknoppen brûkst, tik op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: om in laden krúsbôge ôf te sjitten.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De trident is in wapen dat sawol as hânwapen as ôfstânswapen brûkt wurde kin. Druk op :_input_key.attack: om oan te fallen. Druk :_input_key.use: yn en hâld him yn om de trident werom te lûken. Lit :_input_key.use: los om de trident te smiten. De trident is it bêste wapen ûnder wetter.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De trident is in wapen dat sawol as hânwapen as ôfstânswapen brûkt wurde kin. Tik op mobs om se oan te fallen. Druk it skerm yn en hâld it yn om de trident werom te lûken. Lit los om de trident te smiten. De trident is it bêste wapen ûnder wetter.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, Crossbow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: It swurd, de bôge, de krúsbôge en de trident hawwe spesifike betsjoenings dy't do krije kinst fan de betsjoentafel of it oanbyld, dy't skea en duorsumens ferbetterje en sels mobs yn 'e brân sette kinne!

source_string: Worlds in the Minecraft Marketplace Minecraft levels where our partners have altered the terrain and placed new blocks to create amazing structures and terrain for you to explore and enjoy.
translation: Wrâlden yn de Minecraft Marketplace: Minecraft-wrâlden wêr't ús partners it terrein oanpast hawwe en nije blokken pleatst hawwe om geweldige bouwurken en terrein te meitsjen dy't do ferkenne en genietsje kinst.

source_string: Worlds can also include new items, mobs, blocks and even custom gameplay.
translation: Wrâlden kinne ek nije items, mobs, blokken en sels oanpast spultsje befetsje.

source_string: All of the content in the Marketplace is created by our professional commiunity creators.
translation: Alle ynhâld yn de Marketplace is makke troch ús profesjonele mienskipmakkers.

source_string: Worlds can do so much, we've created several Sub-Categories to help describe what they can do:
translation: Wrâlden kinne sa folle, wy hawwe ferskate subkategoryen makke om te beskriuwen wat se kinne dwaan:

source_string: Mini-Games are smaller worlds that include new game mechanics, challenges, or rules.
translation: Mini-games binne lytsere wrâlden mei nije spulmeganismen, útdagings of regels.

source_string: These games are made with multiplayer in mind, letting you test your skills and have fun with your friends.
translation: Dizze spultsjes binne makke mei multiplayer yn gedachten, sadat jo jo feardichheden testen kinne en wille hawwe kinne mei freonen.

source_string: Survival Spawns let you start playing in a custom-built world, while still enjoying the classic survival mechanics of Minecraft.
translation: Mei oerlibbingsspawns kinne jo begjinne te spyljen yn in oanpaste wrâld, wylst jo noch geniete fan de klassike oerlibbingsmeganismen fan Minecraft.

source_string: Just like in Survival mode you will have health and hunger, and need to fight dangerous mobs.
translation: Krekt as yn oerlibbingsmodus hawwe jo sûnens en honger, en moatte jo tsjin gefaarlike mobs fjochtsje.

source_string: Adventure Maps let you use Minecraft to play a totally different kind of game.
translation: Mei aventoerkaarten kinne jo Minecraft brûke om in hiel oare soarte spul te spyljen.

source_string: You can not break blocks or place new blocks in these worlds.
translation: Jo kinne gjin blokken ôfbrekke of nije blokken pleatse yn dizze wrâlden.

source_string: Dynamic Worlds allow you to explore the creative designs of our marketplace creators in a randomly generated map.
translation: Mei dynamyske wrâlden kinne jo de kreative ûntwerpen fan ús marketplace-makkers ferkenne yn in willekeurich generearre kaart.

source_string: Worlds can have new biomes, customized structures (randomly generated buildings), new blocks, textures, and mobs.
translation: Wrâlden kinne nije biomen, oanpaste struktueren (willekeurich generearre gebouwen), nije blokken, teksturen en mobs hawwe.

source_string: How to Play: Your First Craft
translation: Hoe te spyljen: Jo earste crafting

source_string: Many blocks, like wood, can be turned into useful items by crafting. To do this, you'll find a simple §ecrafting grid§f on the right-hand side of your inventory screen.
translation: In protte blokken, lykas hout, kinne troch crafting yn nuttige items feroare wurde. Dêrfoar fine jo in ienfâldich §ecraftingrooster§f oan de rjochterkant fan jo ynventarisskerm.

source_string: For example, put a single wood log anywhere on the crafting grid, and several planks will appear in the §eoutput slot§f.
translation: Lis bygelyks ien houtblok wêr dan ek op it craftingrooster, en der ferskine ferskate planken yn it §eútfiersleuf§f.

source_string: Simply tap your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Tik gewoan op jo skitterende nije planken en se ferskine yn jo hotbar. No binne jo ree om se yn de wrâld te pleatsen!

source_string: Simply drag your shiny new planks to your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Sleep gewoan jo skitterende nije planken nei jo hotbar. No binne jo ree om se yn de wrâld te pleatsen!

source_string: Simply select your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Selektearje gewoan jo skitterende nije planken en se ferskine yn jo hotbar. No binne jo ree om se yn de wrâld te pleatsen!

source_string: Some items require you to place your crafting ingredients in a certain shape - also called a §erecipe§f.
translation: Guon items fereaskje dat jo jo craftingyngrediïnten yn in bepaalde foarm pleatse - ek wol in §eresept§f neamd.

source_string: Try placing two planks above each other to create some sticks. Useful for all sorts of things!
translation: Probearje twa planken op inoar te lizzen om stokjes te meitsjen. Nuttich foar allerhande dingen!

source_string: Endlessly explore your own unique worlds and construct anything you can imagine - from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles! Play Creative mode to build wonders with unlimited resources. Or mine in Survival mode, crafting weapons and armor to fend off dangerous mobs and survive the nights. Plus, play with friends online! Unlock the full game today!
translation: Ferken ûneinich dyn eigen unike wrâlden en bou wat datst mar betinke kinst - fan it simpelste hûs oant it grutste kastiel! Boartsje yn Creative-modus om wûnders te bouwen mei ûnbeheinde grûnstoffen. Of dolf yn Survival-modus, meitsje wapens en pantser om gefaarlike mobs te bestriden en de nachten te oerlibjen. En boartsje online mei freonen! Untskoattelje it folsleine spul hjoed!

source_string: With the full Minecraft experience you get Creative mode, achievements, and more, plus with a Microsoft account you can meet others in the Minecraft community! Join your friends' worlds, make new friends on Servers, and sync your Marketplace purchases to everywhere you play Minecraft.
translation: Mei de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining krijst Creative-modus, prestaasjes, en mear, en mei in Microsoft-account kinst oaren yn de Minecraft-mienskip moetsje! Doch mei oan de wrâlden fan dyn freonen, meitsje nije freonen op servers, en syngronisearje dyn Marketplace-oankeapen oeral wêr'tst Minecraft boartsje.

source_string: In addition to the full Minecraft experience with Creative mode, Multiplayer, and more, you'll earn achievements and a Gamerscore to mark your Minecraft progress and show your Microsoft account friends your accomplishments. Get the full game to start earning them!
translation: Nêst de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining mei Creative-modus, Multiplayer, en mear, fertsjinnest prestaasjes en in Gamerscore om dyn Minecraft-fooruteitgong te markearjen en dyn Microsoft-account-freonen dyn prestaasjes te sjen litten. Krij it folsleine spul om se te begjinne fertsjinjen!

source_string: The full Minecraft experience lets you enjoy Creative mode, achievements and Multiplayer with your friends across Minecraft devices! Play with friends on console, PC and mobile to create, explore and survive together. Unlock the full Minecraft experience today!
translation: Mei de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining kinst genietsje fan Creative-modus, prestaasjes en Multiplayer mei dyn freonen op ferskate Minecraft-apparaten! Boartsje mei freonen op konsole, PC en mobyl om tegearre te meitsjen, te ferkennen en te oerlibjen. Untskoattelje de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining hjoed!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to enjoy Minecraft! Play great mini-games, meet the Minecraft community and make new friends. Unlock the full Minecraft experience to try Servers today!

source_string: Get access to Minecraft Marketplace, our in-game store. Switch up your look with new skins, change your world, or explore incredible new maps from the best community creators! Get the full game today!

source_string: Buy Minecraft and get Creative mode! Access the entire inventory - the only limit to what you can build is your imagination! Fly around your world, make your dream home out of anything and everything, or just blow up a mountain with unlimited TNT!
translation: Keapje Minecraft en krij Creative-modus! Krij tagong ta de hiele ynventaris - de iennige beheining foar wat do bouwe kinst is dyn ferbylding! Fleagje troch dyn wrâld, meitsje dyn dreamhûs fan alles en noch wat, of blaas gewoan in berch op mei ûnbeheinde TNT!

source_string: Want to make wolves act like bunnies? Turn all the trees into cotton candy? You can alter everything in the full Minecraft experience with add-ons! Plus get access to Multiplayer, Creative mode, achievements and more! Buy Minecraft now for full access!
translation: Wolst wolven as knyntsjes gedrage litte? Alle beammen omtoverje ta wattekleurige sûkerguod? Do kinst alles feroarje yn de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining mei add-ons! En krij tagong ta Multiplayer, Creative-modus, prestaasjes en mear! Keapje Minecraft no foar folsleine tagong!

source_string: Unlock the full Minecraft experience and get access to Seeds! Seeds help you discover new biomes - survive on ice plains, ascend extreme hills, or trek across deserts. Start with unique templates or explore random new worlds! Access Seeds, Creative mode, Multiplayer and more by buying Minecraft today!
translation: Untskoattelje de folsleine Minecraft-ûnderfining en krij tagong ta seeds! Seeds helpe dy nije biomen te ûntdekken - oerlibje op iisflakten, klim ekstreme heuvels, of trek troch woastinen. Begjin mei unike sjabloanen of ferken willekeurige nije wrâlden! Krij tagong ta seeds, Creative-modus, Multiplayer en mear troch Minecraft hjoed te keapjen!

source_string: Thank you for downloading the Minecraft Trial for Chromebook! Your playtesting will provide invaluable data for bug fixes and technical troubleshooting. Uncover a bug? Report it at bugs.mojang.com! Other questions? Check out our FAQ.

translation: Begjin mei it sammeljen fan wat hout en grûn foar in noodhûs om de earste nacht te oerlibjen! Dêrnei is it hielendal oan dy.

source_string: You'll also have access to Inspiration Island, a tutorial world and introduction to Creative mode that'll teach you how to be a master builder in no time! You can find more great worlds like this in Minecraft Marketplace.
