translation: Geweldige minispultsjes en nije spilers wachtsje op dy! Mar earst wol '%s' witte wa'tst bist.

source_string: You need to sign in with a Microsoft account to connect!
translation: Do moatst ynlogge mei in Microsoft-account om te ferbinen!

source_string: Sign out of your Microsoft account
Your Minecraft account lets you play online multiplayer with friends on PCs and mobile devices. And the best part?
translation: Mei dyn Minecraft-account kinst online multyspiler boartsje mei freonen op PC's en mobile apparaten. En it bêste diel?

source_string: You can use it anywhere you play Minecraft.
translation: Do kinst it brûke oeral wêr'tst Minecraft boartsje.

source_string: Sign in with your Microsoft account to play with friends.
translation: Log yn mei dyn Microsoft-account om mei freonen te boartsjen.

source_string: This Microsoft account does not have permission to join multiplayer games.
translation: Dizze Microsoft-account hat gjin tastimming om mei te dwaan oan multyspiler-spullen.

source_string: You must be friends with someone in this game in order to join.
translation: Do moatst freon wêze mei ien yn dit spul om mei te dwaan.

source_string: Success! %s was added to your friend list.
translation: Slagge! %s is tafoege oan dyn freonelist.

source_string: Favorite friends go first on your friends list. You'll see when they go online or start broadcasting.
translation: Favorite freonen komme earst op dyn freonelist. Do sjochst as se online komme of begjinne mei útstjoere.

source_string: Follow %s. After you both are friends, you can invite them to your game.
translation: Folgje %s. As jimme beide freonen binne, kinst se útnûgje foar dyn spul.

source_string: Manage your privacy settings for sharing your real name in the Xbox app.
translation: Behear dyn privacy-ynstellingen foar it dielen fan dyn wiere namme yn de Xbox-app.

source_string: An issue occurred while attempting to open the Player profile. Error Code: %d
translation: Der die him in probleem foar by it iepenjen fan it spilerprofyl. Foutkoade: %d

source_string: We were unable to send your report. Try again soon.
translation: Wy koenen dyn rapport net ferstjoere. Probearje it strak opnij.

source_string: Where did you observe the bad behavior?
translation: Wêr hast it minne gedrach sjoen?

source_string: Please let us know where the incident took place. This will help us in researching your case.
translation: Lit ús witte wêr it foarfal wie. Dit helpt ús by it ûndersykjen fan dyn saak.

source_string: Impersonating staff, Player Support, or Community representatives
translation: Meidwaan foar personiel, Player Support, of mienskipsfertsjintwurdigers
Treiterij en spam yn it spul

source_string: Posting links to inappropriate content or malicious software
translation: Keppelingen pleatse nei net-passende ynhâld of kwea-aardige software
Ynformaasje en driigingen oer it echte libben
Seksueel misbrûk of eksploitaasje fan bern
Grooming mei it doel fan seksueel misbrûk fan bern

source_string: You've been temporarily muted in chat.
translation: Do bist foar in skoftke stilset yn de chat.

source_string: Remember to follow the Minecraft Community Standards.
translation: Unthâld om de Minecraft Mienskipsstandaarden nei te libjen.

source_string: Your current skin violates our Community Standards. Please select a different skin to join a multiplayer game. Click "%s" to view our Community Standards or submit a case review for your current skin.
translation: Dyn hjoeddeiske skin skeant ús Mienskipsstandaarden. Selektearje in oare skin om mei te spyljen yn in multyspilerspul. Klik op "%s" om ús Mienskipsstandaarden te besjen of om in beoardieling foar dyn skin oan te freegjen.

source_string: §eChat and other user generated text is not available on this realm right now. Please try again later.§f
translation: §eChat en oare troch brûkers oanmakke tekst is op dit stuit net beskikber op dit realm. Probearje it letter noch ris.§f

source_string: Something went wrong. We can't verify that the server you are trying to connect to is one that we trust. We recommend that you try again later.
translation: Der is wat misgien. Wy kinne net ferifiearje dat de server dêr'st mei ferbine wolst, ien is dy't wy fertrouwe. Wy riede oan om it letter noch ris te probearjen.

source_string: This is bad. This server failed our verification test. Someone we don't trust might be pretending to be a trusted server.
translation: Dit is min. Dizze server hat ús ferifikaasjetest net trochstien. Ien dy't wy net fertrouwe, kin him foardwaan as in fertroude server.

source_string: You've been playing for greater than 24 hours
translation: Do spilest al langer as 24 oeren

source_string: Excessive gaming may interfere with normal daily life
translation: Dyn deistige libben kin oantaast wurde asto te folle gamest

source_string: Unable to find manifest in pack.
translation: Kin manifest yn pakket net fine.

source_string: Unable to parse pack manifest with stack: %s
translation: Kin pakketmanifest net ûntlede mei stack: %s

source_string: Required '%s' element is the wrong type in pack manifest.
translation: Fereaske elemint '%s' hat it ferkearde type yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Required '%s' element is empty in pack manifest.
translation: Fereaske elemint '%s' is leech yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Provided '%s' element has an invalid value in pack manifest.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' hat in ûnjildige wearde yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not a valid UUID in pack manifest.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' is gjin jildige UUID yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not SemVer (semver.org) compliant in pack manifest.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' folget net SemVer (semver.org) yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Missing '%s' element in pack manifest; Defaulting to resource pack.
translation: Elemint '%s' mist yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt boarnepakket brûkt.

source_string: Missing dependency with ID '%s' and version '%s'.
translation: Ofhinklikens mist mei ID '%s' en ferzje '%s'.

source_string: Provided format version '%s' is not supported.
Provided UUID '%s' element already exists in pack manifest.
translation: Opjûne UUID '%s' elemint bestiet al yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Multiple conflicting modules detected in pack manifest.
translation: Meardere botsende modules ûntdutsen yn pakketmanifest.

source_string: Revision component provided in version '%s' will be ignored and treated as 0.
translation: Revyzjekomponint opjûn yn ferzje '%s' wurdt negearre en behannele as 0.

source_string: The property '%s' is not used for this type of content. The field will be ignored.
translation: De eigenskip '%s' wurdt net brûkt foar dit type ynhâld. It fjild wurdt negearre.

source_string: The property '%s' has a version of '%s' which is too high. The highest value we accept is '%s'.
translation: De eigenskip '%s' hat in ferzje '%s' dy't te heech is. De heechste wearde dy't wy akseptearje is '%s'.

source_string: The property '%s' has a version of '%s' which is too low. The lowest value we accept is '%s'.
translation: De eigenskip '%s' hat in ferzje '%s' dy't te leech is. De leechste wearde dy't wy akseptearje is '%s'.

source_string: The property '%s` must have a value set less than `%s`. To use a higher version, you need to use format version 2.
translation: De eigenskip '%s` moat in wearde hawwe leger as `%s`. Om in hegere ferzje te brûken, moatst formaatferzje 2 brûke.

source_string: Folder structure in pack is too deep.
translation: Mapstruktuer yn pakket is te djip.

source_string: Provided '%s' element has an invalid value in pack manifest; Defaulting to resource pack.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' hat in ûnjildige wearde yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt boarnepakket brûkt.

source_string: Missing '%s' element in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Elemint '%s' mist yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: Required '%s' element is empty in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Fereaske elemint '%s' is leech yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not a valid UUID in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' is gjin jildige UUID yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: Provided '%s' element is not SemVer (semver.org) compliant in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Opjûn elemint '%s' folget net SemVer (semver.org) yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: This pack manifest has been upgraded to a new version.
translation: Dit pakketmanifest is opwurdearre nei in nije ferzje.

source_string: Provided UUID '%s' element already exists in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Opjûne UUID '%s' elemint bestiet al yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: Multiple conflicting modules detected in pack manifest; Defaulting to '%s'.
translation: Meardere botsende modules ûntdutsen yn pakketmanifest; standert wurdt '%s'.

source_string: You are about to delete this resource/behavior pack forever. Are you sure?
translation: Do stiest op it punt om dit boarne-/gedragspakket foargoed te fuortsmiten. Bist wis?

source_string: Editor extension packs can only be used on Editor projects. Your world will still load, however we recommend deactivating or deleting the extension packs.
translation: Editor-útwreidingspakketten kinne allinnich brûkt wurde op editorprojekten. Dyn wrâld sil noch wol laden wurde, mar wy riede oan om de útwreidingspakketten út te setten of te fuortsmiten.

source_string: %s: Child controls must have unique names: %sIn the future this will be an error and this file won't load.
translation: %s: Bernkontrolen moatte unike nammen hawwe: %sYn de takomst sil dit in flater wêze en sil dit bestân net laden wurde.

source_string: %s: Unable to parse UI JSON file with stack: %s
translation: %s: Kin UI JSON-bestân net ûntlede mei stack: %s

source_string: %s (%s): Can't find the control '%s' during operation '%s'
translation: %s (%s): Kin de kontrôle '%s' net fine by operaasje '%s'

source_string: %s (%s): Missing the value for the operation '%s'.
%s: Invalid type for property. Expected %s got %s
translation: %s: Ferkeard type foar eigenskip. Ferwachte %s krige %s

source_string: %s: Did not find valid value for property. Expected %s
translation: %s: Gjin jildige wearde fûn foar eigenskip. Ferwachte %s
Flater by it meitsjen fan formulier.

source_string: See output log for more details
translation: Sjoch it útfierlogboek foar mear details

source_string: Content in this world is not supported by Minecraft Education.
translation: Ynhâld yn dizze wrâld wurdt net stipe troch Minecraft Education.

source_string: Would you like to play your world now?
Adding an external server requires knowing the server name and server IP address. Once added, the server can be found in the server list for play.
translation: It tafoegjen fan in eksterne server fereasket de servernamme en it IP-adres fan de server te witten. As tafoege, kin de server fûn wurde yn de serverlist foar it spyljen.

source_string: This server has already been added

translation: Selektearje alles wat fan tapassing is:
Naam te lang om te laden

source_string: Got stuck on an error message
I didn't know it was free
translation: Ik wist net dat it fergees wie

source_string: I thought I needed a Xbox console
translation: Ik tocht dat ik in Xbox-konsole nedich wie

source_string: Feedback: Why didn't you sign in?
You can hold down Shift to take a close up picture using the Camera.
translation: Do kinst Shift ynhâlde om in foto fan tichtby te meitsjen mei de Kamera.

source_string: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.
translation: Oars as by Boarden, kinst Skriften, Posters en Boerden hieltyd wer opnij bewurkje.

source_string: Use Ctrl+B to turn on text-to-speech capabilities for in-game chat.
translation: Brûk Ctrl+B om spraakfoarming foar de yn-spul-chat oan te setten.

source_string: You can export your Minecraft world to share it with others.
translation: Do kinst dyn Minecraft-wrâld eksportearje om it mei oaren te dielen.

source_string: To have your peers connect to your world, pause your game and share your join code.
translation: Om dyn maten mei dyn wrâld ferbine te litten, pausearje dyn spul en diel dyn oanslútkoade.

source_string: Remember that to use slash commands, you need to enable cheats in your world.
translation: Unthâld dat do cheats yn dyn wrâld oansette moatst om skeafkommando's te brûken.

source_string: Done with your creation? Have others tour your world as visitors to protect your work.
translation: Klear mei dyn kreaasje? Lit oaren dyn wrâld besjen as besikers om dyn wurk te beskermjen.

source_string: To code in Minecraft, press "C" on your keyboard or touch the Agent icon at the top of your screen.
translation: Om te kodearjen yn Minecraft, druk op "C" op dyn kaartboerd of taast it Agent-ikoantsje oan boppe-oan dyn skerm.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.
translation: Brûk de Biblioteek om nije spulwrâlden te finen om yn te bouwen.

source_string: Looking for a specific biome? Try the Library.
translation: Op syk nei in spesifyk biotoop? Probearje de Biblioteek.

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: Yn Survival-modus moatte spilers har eigen boarnen fine.

source_string: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any of the blocks in Minecraft.
translation: Yn Creative-modus kinne spilers frij kieze om te bouwen mei elk blok út Minecraft.

source_string: Your code building robot helper is called the Agent.
translation: Dyn kodearboukjinstriedhelper wurdt de Agent neamd.

source_string: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone kin brûkt wurde yn Minecraft om saneamde circuits en ienfâldige masinen te meitsjen.

source_string: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board, or into chat.
translation: Do kinst kopiëarje en plakke fan in teksteditor nei in skrift, poster, boerd, of yn de chat.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Lit hints sjen foar faak brûkte kaartboerd- en mûskontrolen troch op "H" op dyn kaartboerd te drukken.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Do kinst Auto Springe oan- of útsette yn it Ynstellingen-menu ûnder Kontrolen.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: Yn Creative-modus, druk twa kear rap op springe om te fleane.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Kies in Standert Spulmodus by it meitsjen fan in wrâld om it type spulgedrach oan te jaan datst wolst.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Brûk de kommando "/setworldspawn" om nije spilers begjinne te litten wêr'st stiest.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Kies in standert spilertagong by it meitsjen fan dyn wrâld om oan te jaan hokker tagong dyn klassemakkers krije as se meidwaan.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Druk op "I" op dyn kaartboerd of taast it Immersive Reader-ikoantsje oan om spultekst te lêzen of te oersetten.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Om in NPC yn dyn wrâld ta te foegjen of te feroarjen, meitsje earst dysels in wrâldbouwer mei "/wb".

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: D'r is elke moanne in hielendal nije bouútdaging! Fyn se allegear yn de Biblioteek ûnder Moanlikse Bouútdagings.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Fyn relevante lessen troch op tags te klikken yn de Biblioteek.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Spul beweecht stadich? Probearje de rendearôfstân te ferminderjen yn Ynstellingen.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Wolst Code Builder brûke? Soargje derfoar dat cheats oan steane.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Druk op F5 om spilerperspektyf te feroarjen.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Brûk "/spawnpoint" om dyn respawnpunt te feroarjen. It is krekt as slepen yn in bêd!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: De measte monsters komme allinnich nachts nei bûten. Oerdeis bist feilich... wierskynlik.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Brek blokken, sammelje boarnen. Brûk it nifelrjuster om nuttige items te meitsjen. Nou bist oan it nifeljen!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Do hast einleaze libbens, mar dyn items falle op de grûn as do dea giest. Rin fluch werom om se op te heljen!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: It is in goed idee om in plak te bouwen dêr'st feilich de nacht troch bringe kinst.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Brûk it rjochte helpmiddel foar de klus! In beam hakke mei in bile giet folle flugger as mei dyn hannen.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Sels yn Minecraft wurdst honger, dus probearje wat te iten te finen foardat dat bart.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Rjochtstreeks nei ûnderen of nei boppen groeve is faaks gjin geweldich idee.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Monsters spawne yn it tsjuster. Nifelje in toarts om elke romte op te ljochtsjen.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Bêden binne geweldich! Nifelje ien om fluch de nacht troch te kommen en dyn respawnpunt yn te stellen.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Wês foarsichtich by it swimmen. Bliuw net te lang ûnder wetter, oars komst sûnder lucht te sitten.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Survival-modus hat 4 ferskillende dreechheidsnivo's - Freedsum, Maklik, Normaal, en Dreech. Of spylje Creative-modus en krij einleaze boarnen!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: De wrâld fan Minecraft is einleas ferrassend. Do fynst in protte ferskillende bisten, planten, en sels §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Fied in bonke oan in wolf om him tam te meitsjen. Do kinst him dan sitte of dy folgje litte.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: In pompoen op dyn kop drage hâldt Endermen derfan ôf om dy oan te fallen.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Ferwin learder fan kij, en brûk it om harnas en boeken te meitsjen.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Do kinst in lege amer folje mei wetter, lava, molke, poeiersnie... en sels guon mobs.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: In bist fieden hâldt him derfan ôf om te ferdwinen. Bou in hok om dyn bisten feilich te hâlden.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Kom flugger by dyn bestimming mei in mynkarre en wat spoaren!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: In portaal bouwe stelt dy yn steat om te reizigjen nei in oare dimensje neamd de Nether.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Bonemeel (nifele fan in skelettonbonke) kin brûkt wurde as bemesting en kin dingen ynienen groeie litte!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidiaan wurdt makke as wetter in lavaboarneblok reitsje.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: As it boarneblok foar wetter of lava fuortsmiten wurdt, stopt de streaming hielendal.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Blokken dy't brûkt wurde kinne as ljochtboarne, smelte snie en iis

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Wês foarsichtich by it bouwen fan struktueren fan wol yn de bûtenlucht, want wjerljocht fan tongerbuien kin wol yn 'e brân sette.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Ien inkelde amer lava kin yn in fornús brûkt wurde om 100 blokken te smelten.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: It ynstrumint spile troch in nootblok hinget ôf fan it materiaal derûnder.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: In wolf oanfallen soarget derfoar dat alle wolven tichtby agressyf wurde en dy oanfalle

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Wolven en izeren golems falle gjin creepers oan.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hinnen lizze om de 5 oant 10 minuten in ei.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidiaan kin dolven wurde mei in diamanten pikhouwer.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers binne de maklikst te bemachtigen boarne fan bûskrûd.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Tamme wolven litte har sûnens sjen troch de posyzje fan har sturt. Fied se fleis om se te helen.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Ferskillende kleuren kleurstof kinne makke wurde út in ferskaat oan materialen; koekje kaktus yn in fornús om griene kleurstof te krijen!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Bargen dy't troch wjerljocht rekke wurde, wurde zombified piglins.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Soms jouwe izeren golems blommen oan de doarpelbern!
Ozelotten litte creepers sjen wa't de baas is!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Brûk seegers om seeskylpodden oan te lûken en te fokken.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Babyskylpodden litte scutes falle as se groeie - dizze kinne nifele wurde ta skylpaddeskilden.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Dolfinen kinne dy liede nei skipswrakken en ûnderwetterruïnes, fied se kod en folgje har spoar!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
translation: Brûk skjirren om in pompoen te snije.

source_string: There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Seepikels kinne smolten wurde ta limoengriene kleurstof.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Brûk hoaibalen om Lama's te fokken!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompassen wize altyd nei de wrâldspawn - nifelje ien om dyn wei te finen!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Hannelje mei doarpelingen om iten, helpmiddels, en sels ferkennerskaarten te krijen!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Wisto dat do in kaart yn dyn ûnhân hâlde kinst?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Lieden kinne brûkt wurde op boaten.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Slûpe om feilich op magmablokken te rinnen.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Do kinst spinnenetten sammelje mei skjirren.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Trydinten wurde droppe troch de Drowned, en kinne fêsthâlden of smiten wurde.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Do kinst 20 items yn in fornús smelte troch in blok droege kelp as brânstof te brûken.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: In skeletonhoars taam meitsje freget gjin sadel.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Phantoms binne gefaarlike mobs dy't nachts opduke. Soargje derfoar dat do regelmjittich sliepst!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombies wurde drowneds as se ûnder wetter sakje.
Sprinte yn wetter om te swimmen!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: By it groeven rjocht nei boppen, sette in toarts by dyn fuotten om alle sân of gruit te brekken dy't miskien op dy delfalle kin.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Skear in Bijenkoer of nêst om Honekamers te krijen, brûk in Flesse om huning te krijen.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Sette in kampfjoer ûnder in bijenkoer of nêst om huning te ferwinnen.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Emerald-erts is it seldsumste erts yn Minecraft! It kin allinnich fûn wurde yn berchtenen en greiden.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Diamanten nedich? Se wurde faker foarkommend hoe djipper't do giest.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Kikkerts ite lytse en blokkerige mobs.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: De Allay is grutte gek op it sammeljen fan items! As do him in bepaald item jaan, sil hy probearje mear derfan te sammeljen.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Kikkerts kieze in fariant basearre op de temperatuer fan it biotoop dêr't de kikkertlarven opgroeie.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Do kinst kikkertlarven sammelje yn amers.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Alde stêden kinne fûn wurde ûnder bergtenen.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Allays hâlde fan muzyk en dêrom reagearje se op nootblokken!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Brûk in wetterflesse op in ierdeblok om modder te krijen!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: By it dwalen troch de deep dark is stilte de kaai.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Guon bisten folgje dy as do weet yn dyn hân hast.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Foardat do diamanten, redstone, of goud dolst, soargje derfoar datst in izeren of diamanten pikhouwer brûkst, oars wurket it net.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Twa kisten neist elkoar sette makket ien grutte kiste.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Kinst gjin stienkoal foar dyn toarts fine? Probearje wat houtblokken yn in fornús te smiten.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant wat sipkes en se groeie ta beammen.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Brûk in skoffel om gebieten fan grûn ta te bereidzje foar planten.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Zombified piglins falle dy net oan - útsein as do se lulk makkest.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Slaan dy fjoerballen werom nei de Ghast!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Klipsteen is bestand tsjin Ghast-fjoerballen, dat makket it nuttich om portalen te bewaken.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Us muzyk is troch C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, en Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: D'r komt op in stuit in fernijing foar dit spul!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers binne berne út in koadearingsfout.

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: De earste ferzje fan Minecraft waard makke yn mar 6 dagen!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: De taal fan de Enderman is eins Ingelsk werom.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: De oarspronklike namme foar Minecraft wie Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: In Spider Jockey is de seldsume ferskining fan in spider dy't riden wurdt troch in skelet!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: In blok reizigje yn de Nether is gelyk oan acht blokken reizigje yn de Overworld.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Brûk phantomvellen om dyn elytra te reparearjen.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Elytra kinne brûkt wurde om te glide, fyn se yn End city-skippen!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Probearje wat nije funksjes út troch Experimintele Spulgedrach oan te setten yn it ynstellingenmenu!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: Monsters dy't deade wurde troch skeletpiken hawwe kâns om muzykskiven te droppen.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: Teksturepakken feroarje hoe't blokken, items, en sels de menu's derút sjogge yn it spul. Probearje se út!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: It brûken fan fjoerwurkraketten fersnelt elytra-faasje yn de loft. Mar... soargje derfoar dat se net ûntploffe, oars docht it BROKKICH sear!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Riptide-betovering sil dy troch de loft ferskowe yn de rein.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: De Beacon is in krêftich item dat allinnich nifele wurde kin mei in Netherstjer fan de Wither!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Netherstjerren kinne net kapotmakke wurde troch eksploazjes.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Respawnen yn de Nether fereasket in laden respawnanker.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Do kinst in respawnanker laden mei glowstone.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Do kinst hoglins fokke mei krimson fungus, mar wês foarsichtich.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Goud komt it meast foar yn de Nether en yn it badlands-biotoop.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorite, do hâldst der fan of hastest it.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
translation: Meitsje in skermôfbylding mei it Spulmenu.

source_string: A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: In Realm is altyd online, sadat do en dyn freonen hjir spylje kinne wannear't jimme wolle.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Bliuw op de hichte fan wat der oan de hân is yn dyn Realm troch de Story Feed te besjen yn Realms Stories.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Diel dyn geweldige mominten mei de oare spilers op dit Realm troch in ferhaal ta te foegjen oan de Story Feed.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Sjoch nei de Timeline yn Realms Stories om út te finen wannear't oaren spylje.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Tagong Realms Stories fanút it spulmenu wylst it spyljen op it Realm.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Lear dyn Realm's mienskip te kennen op de Lid-ljepper yn Realms Stories.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Brûk Realms Stories om sosjaal te wurde, op de hichte te bliuwen fan dyn freonen har foarútgong, en spyltiid te organisearjen.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Sêd fan swiertekrêft? Springe twa kear om te fleane!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Roppe mobs op yn in eachwink mei spawn eggs.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Sammelje geitehoarnen en fol de wrâld mei muzyk.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Kombinearje flint en stiel mei in TNT-blok foar ûntploffende resultaten.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Probearje om te knipperjen oer de kaart mei in ender pearel. Wurd net dûzelich!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Brûk spoaren en in mynkarre om it perfekte ferfiersysteem te bouwen. Of rollercoaster!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Sikest wat mear gefaar? Survival-modus hat genôch.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Kruisbogen hawwe ammo nedich. Foegje wat pikanten ta oan dyn ynventaris foardatst op jacht giest.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Do kinst net dea, mar doarpelingen kinne dat wol. Brûk dy ynformaasje... wiislik.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Doarpelingen binne geweldich yn it bouwen fan doarpen. Tinksto datst it better kinst?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wolven falle skeletten oan om op harren lekkere bonken te kôgjen.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Taam wylde hynders troch derop te sitten oant se rêstich binne, sadel dan op en riid fuort. (Notysje: Hynders wurkje net sa bûten Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Ite safolle as do wolst, do wurdst noait fol! En do sultst noait honger krije.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Beweech troch fêste objekten mei spectator-modus.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Wa nedich helpmiddels? Slaan dyn wei nei sukses en smyt blokken direkt fuort yn creative-modus.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Do liket wat sjochst? Brûk de pick block-knop om te begjinne mei te bouwen mei wat do ek besjochst. Ja, sels mobs!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Mobs merke dy net op yn creative-modus, mar se merke elkoar noch wol op\u00A0…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: In warden op de dei hâldt de\u00A0… wol, alles op ôfstân.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Wêrom net in ûnderwetterbasis bouwe\u00A0? Do kinst dochs net fersûpe.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Wat do ek dreamst, kinst bouwe. D'r is gjin limyt oan dyn boarnen (yn creative-modus...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Phantoms kinne dy net sear dwaan, mar do kinst se noch altyd fuortjaan mei in bêd. Mar...net letterlik. Do slepst deryn.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Hasto ea probearre om yn lava te swimmen? It is as sinke yn in waarm bad. Probearje it allinnich net yn survival-modus...
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A second player can't join right now.
translation: In twadde spiler kin op dit stuit net meidwaan.

source_string: You have too many controllers connected while in Local Network Mode to join this game.
translation: Do hast te folle kontrôlers ferbûn yn Lokaal Netwurk-modus om mei te dwaan oan dit spul.

source_string: Some worlds are not available because they could not be moved. Restart Minecraft to try again.
translation: Guon wrâlden binne net beskikber omdat se net ferpleatst wurde koenen. Start Minecraft opnij op om it nochris te probearjen.

source_string: Read the FAQ for more info.
translation: Lês de FAQ foar mear ynfo.

source_string: You don't have enough free space to move your files to a new location.
translation: Do hast net genôch frije romte om dyn bestannen nei in nije lokaasje te ferpleatsen.

source_string: We need to move your files to a different location on your device.
translation: Wy moatte dyn bestannen ferpleatse nei in oare lokaasje op dyn apparaat.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device. Please press resume to finish the move.
translation: Wy binne midden yn it ferpleatsen fan dyn gegevens nei in nije lokaasje op dyn apparaat. Druk op trochgean om de ferpleatsing te foltôgjen.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device, but you don't have enough free space.
translation: Wy binne midden yn it ferpleatsen fan dyn gegevens nei in nije lokaasje op dyn apparaat, mar do hast net genôch frije romte.

source_string: Please free up at least %s to continue.
translation: Meitsje op syn minst %s frij om troch te gean.

source_string: Your files have been moved successfully. Please restart Minecraft.
translation: Dyn bestannen binne mei sukses ferpleatst. Start Minecraft opnij op.
Probleem by it ferpleatsen fan bestannen!

source_string: We couldn't move all your files. We encountered the following error: (%s).
translation: Wy koenen net al dyn bestannen ferpleatse. Wy stiene foar de folgjende flater: (%s).

source_string: Failed (file I/O error or no space left)
Select "Delete Now" to delete all previous log files.
translation: Selektearje "No fuortsmite" om alle foargeande logboekbestannen fuort te smiten.

source_string: Note: The log file for your currently active session will remain.
translation: Notysje: It logboekbestân foar dyn aktive sesje bliuwt bestean.

source_string: Based on your recent support ticket, Mojang Player Support has granted permission to upload your world. You can upload your affected world from the World Select screen or under World Settings.
translation: Op basis fan dyn resinte supportticket hat Mojang Player Support tastimming jûn om dyn wrâld te uploaden. Do kinst dyn troffen wrâld uploade fan it Wrâldseleksje-skerm of ûnder Wrâldynstellingen.

source_string: Do not show this screen again
translation: Dit skerm net wer sjen litte

source_string: To upload your world, accept the Microsoft Services Agreement. Uploaded worlds are subject to the Microsoft Services Agreement, which can be found under Terms of Use. You can still play with your world once uploaded.
translation: Om dyn wrâld te uploaden, akseptearje de Microsoft Services-oerienkomst. Uploade wrâlden falle ûnder de Microsoft Services-oerienkomst, dy't fûn wurde kin ûnder Gebrûksbetingsten. Do kinst noch altyd mei dyn wrâld spylje as it uploade is.

source_string: Uploading your world files may take a few minutes. Do not turn off the game or leave this screen during the upload process.
translation: It uploaden fan dyn wrâldbestannen kin in pear minuten duorje. Set it spul net út of ferlit dit skerm net wylst it uploadproses.

source_string: World sizes can be large. Please connect to WiFi to avoid using mobile data.
translation: Wrâldgruttes kinne grut wêze. Ferbyn asjebleaze mei WiFi om mobyl gegevens te foarkommen.

source_string: Your world upload has completed successfully. Thank you!
translation: Dyn wrâldupload is mei sukses foltôge. Tank!

source_string: Your world could not be uploaded because %s
translation: Dyn wrâld koe net uploade wurde omdat %s

source_string: Your world could not be uploaded because %s
translation: Dyn wrâld koe net uploade wurde omdat %s

source_string: it consists of too many files. Please get in touch with LiveOps if you want to try again.
translation: it bestiet út tefolle bestannen. Nim asjebleaze kontakt op mei LiveOps as do it nochris probearje wolst.

source_string: one of the files is too big. Please get in touch with LiveOps if you want to try again.
translation: ien fan de bestannen is te grut. Nim asjebleaze kontakt op mei LiveOps as do it nochris probearje wolst.

source_string: it has already been successfully uploaded. Please get in touch with LiveOps for more information.
translation: it is al mei sukses uploade. Nim asjebleaze kontakt op mei LiveOps foar mear ynformaasje.

source_string: of a network error. Please try again or get in touch with LiveOps.
translation: fan in netwurkflater. Probearje it nochris of nim kontakt op mei LiveOps.

source_string: of an unknown error. Please try again or get in touch with LiveOps. (Error code: %s)
translation: fan in ûnbekende flater. Probearje it nochris of nim kontakt op mei LiveOps. (Flaterkoade: %s)

source_string: Import a png (64x32, 64x64, or 128x128) from your device to use as your skin. This will not sync between devices or games.
translation: Ymportearje in png (64x32, 64x64, of 128x128) fan dyn apparaat om te brûken as dyn skin. Dit sil net syngronisearje tusken apparaten of spultsjes.

source_string: Your device cannot select a custom skin while in a multiplayer game. Please return to the main menu to equip one.
translation: Dyn apparaat kin gjin oanpaste skin selektearje wylst it in multyspilerspul is. Gean asjebleaze werom nei it haadmenu om ien te ekwipearje.

source_string: Players with custom skins will not be visible to you if the “Only Allow Trusted Skins” option is enabled
translation: Spilers mei oanpaste skins sille net foar dy sichtber wêze as de opsje "Allinnich betroude skins tastean" oan stiet

source_string: Please import a .png file of dimensions 64x64, 64x32, or 128x128
translation: Ymportearje asjebleaze in .png-bestân mei ôfmjittings 64x64, 64x32, of 128x128

source_string: This skin can be used here, but may not roam.
translation: Dizze skin kin hjir brûkt wurde, mar mei net swalke.

source_string: This skin will roam wherever you've logged in.
translation: Dizze skin swalket wêr datst dysels ynlogge hast.

source_string: *Buys %s Minecoins for %s and redeems this pack for %s Minecoins leaving %s left over.
translation: *Keapet %s Minecoins foar %s en ferlossen dit pakket foar %s Minecoins, dêr't %s oer bliuwt.

source_string: Choose the correct model type for your skin
translation: Kies it juste modeltype foar dyn skin

source_string: You must purchase the skin pack to use that skin, and we can't connect to the Marketplace.
translation: Do moatst it skinpakket keapje om dy skin te brûken, en wy kinne net ferbine mei de Marketplace.

context: %s is the category name (ie. Style or Body)

source_string: This item is unlocked through completing an achievement.
translation: Dit item wurdt ûntskoattele troch it foltôgjen fan in prestaasje.

source_string: This item is unlocked by completing the %s achievement.
translation: Dit item wurdt ûntskoattele troch it foltôgjen fan de %s-prestaasje.

source_string: This item was unlocked by completing the %s achievement.
translation: Dit item is ûntskoattele troch it foltôgjen fan de %s-prestaasje.

source_string: This item is unlocked by completing a challenge from Minecraft Earth.
translation: Dit item wurdt ûntskoattele troch it foltôgjen fan in útdaging fan Minecraft Earth.

source_string: This item was unlocked by completing a challenge from Minecraft Earth.
translation: Dit item is ûntskoattele troch it foltôgjen fan in útdaging fan Minecraft Earth.

source_string: You are switching over to the character creator in this slot. Character creator allows you to build a character in Minecraft item by item. Your classic skin will be saved as a back up in this slot if you want to switch back later.
translation: Do wikselst oer nei de karakterkreator yn dizze sleuf. De karakterkreator lit dy in karakter yn Minecraft item foar item bouwe. Dyn klassike skin sil bewarre wurde as backup yn dizze sleuf as do letter werom wikselje wolst.

source_string: You are switching over to a classic skin in this slot.  Classic skins are applied to the full character and cannot be customized. Your character creator look will be saved as back up in this slot if you want to switch back later.
translation: Do wikselst oer nei in klassike skin yn dizze sleuf. \u00A0Klassike skins wurde tapast op it hiele karakter en kinne net oanpast wurde. Dyn karakterkreator-uterlik sil bewarre wurde as reservekopy yn dizze sleuf as do letter werom wikselje wolst.

source_string: Failed to load character %s. You can reload it from your Profile.
translation: Kin karakter %s net laden. Do kinst it opnij laden fanút dyn Profyl.

source_string: A local or platform skin could not be loaded.
translation: In lokale of platform-skin koe net laden wurde.
context: A notification to the player that a skin from another device could not be loaded

source_string: Skin blocked from multiplayer for violating Community Standards.
translation: Skin blokkearre fan multyspiler foar it oertsjinjen fan de Mienskipsstandaarden.

source_string: The current character will be deleted. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: It aktuele karakter sil fuortsmiten wurde. Bist wis datst trochgean wolst?
Ferskillen tusken Karakter en Klassike skin

source_string: This content is available in most geographic regions, but restricted in a few.
translation: Dizze ynhâld is beskikber yn de measte geografyske regio's, mar beheind yn in pear.

source_string: Select items on the left to see how they look on your character!
translation: Selektearje items links om te sjen hoe't se derút sjogge op dyn karakter!

source_string: Deep Linking Failed: Unable to load profile
translation: Deep Linking mislearre: Kin profyl net laden

source_string: Deep Linking Failed: Unable to open offer
translation: Deep Linking mislearre: Kin oanbieding net iepenje

source_string: During online play you might see chat messages or other user generated content that might not be suitable for all ages.

source_string: How much does a Realm cost?

Your worlds are yours to keep. You have 18 months to download them to your device after your subscription expires. If you resubscribe within that time, you will regain access to your Realm just as you left it.
translation: Dyn wrâlden binne fan dy om te hâlden. Do hast 18 moannen om se te downloaden nei dyn apparaat neidat dyn abonnemint ferrint. As do dy binnen dy tiid opnij abonnearrest, krijst wer tagong ta dyn Realm krekt sa'stû him ferlitten hast.

source_string: What happens to the worlds on my Realm when my subscription expires?
translation: Wat bart der mei de wrâlden op myn Realm as myn abonnemint ferrint?

source_string: The people you invite (members) don’t need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on your Realm. You can invite any Minecraft player to join and play in your Realm for free.
translation: De minsken dysto útnûgest (leden) hoege gjin Realms-abonnemint te keapjen om op dyn Realm te spyljen. Do kinst elke Minecraft-spiler útnûgje om fergees by dyn Realm te kommen en te spyljen.

source_string: Do my friends need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on my Realm?
translation: Moatte myn freonen in Realms-abonnemint keapje om op myn Realm te spyljen?

source_string: You can store up to 3 worlds on your Realm at one time. Activate any one of them to make that world playable. Only one world is playable at a time.
translation: Do kinst oant 3 wrâlden opslaan op dyn Realm tagelyk. Aktivearje ien fan harren om dy wrâld spylber te meitsjen. Mar ien wrâld is spylber tagelyk.

source_string: How many worlds can I have on my Realm?
translation: Hoefolle wrâlden kin ik hawwe op myn Realm?

source_string: We put your world on a super-computer, with a huge amount of speed and power. We keep the computer running all the time so you can play that world whenever you and your friends want. We protect your world from getting corrupted by saving it automatically all the time. You control who connects to the world. How you play with it is up to you (the server will do all the heavy lifting).
translation:
Wy pleatse dyn wrâld op in supercomputer, mei in massale hoemannichte snelheid en krêft. Wy hâlde de computer altyd oan sadat do en dyn freonen dy wrâld spylje kinne wannear jimme mar wolle. Wy beskermje dyn wrâld tsjin korruptearjen troch him altyd automatysk te bewarjen. Do behearskest wa't ferbynt mei de wrâld. Hoe'stû derfan spylst is oan dy
(de server docht al it swiere wurk).

source_string: Realms are small personal servers to host your Minecraft world. Unlike a regular multiplayer session, Realms are always online, so you don’t have to be there for your friends to play. Unlike a large public Minecraft server, Realms are by invite only, so you control who gets in.
translation: Realms binne lytse persoanlike servers om dyn Minecraft-wrâld te hosten. Oars as in reguliere multiplayersessy, binne Realms altyd online, sadat do net der wêze moatst foar dyn freonen om te spyljen. Oars as in grutte publike Minecraft-server, binne Realms allinnich op útnûging, sadat do behearskest wa't der by komt.

- op elk momint, op elk apparaat. Leden kinne spylje sels as do fuort bist.

source_string: We would love to hear what you think of this new design. Keep in mind that it’s still work in progress and some functionality might be missing.
translation: Wy hearre graach wat jo tinke oer dit nije ûntwerp. Unthâld dat it noch wurk yn útfiering is en guon funksjonaliteit kin misse.

source_string: Find hundreds of additional templates and Add-Ons in the Marketplace
translation: Fyn hûnderten oanfoljende sjabloanen en Add-Ons yn de Marketplace

source_string: Find hundreds of additional templates in the Marketplace
translation: Fyn hûnderten oanfoljende sjabloanen yn de Marketplace

source_string: Go further with world templates and Add-Ons for Marketplace Pass subscribers.
translation: Gean noch fierder mei wrâldsjabloanen en Add-Ons foar Marketplace Pass-abonnees.

source_string: Go further with world templates for Marketplace Pass subscribers.
translation: Gean noch fierder mei wrâldsjabloanen foar Marketplace Pass-abonnees.

source_string: Please check your internet connection to browse Marketplace.
translation: Kontrolearje jo ynternetferbining om de Marketplace te sneupen.

source_string: To enable the Marketplace Pass screen, go to the Discovery Debug tab, set the Marketplace Discovery Environment to Production and restart.
translation: Om it Marketplace Pass-skerm yn te skeakeljen, gean nei it Discovery Debug-ljepper, set de Marketplace Discovery Environment op Production en start opnij.

source_string: Explore thousands of original worlds, templates, and skins on Marketplace — or import your own.
translation: Ferken tûzenen orizjinele wrâlden, sjabloanen en skins op de Marketplace\u00A0— of ymportearje dyn eigen.

source_string: You don’t own any content... yet!
Check your spelling or refine your search.
translation: Kontrolearje jo stavering of ferfyn jo sykopdracht.

source_string: Here you'll find all the templates you've purchased from the Marketplace.
translation: Hjir fine jo alle sjabloanen dy't jo kocht hawwe fan de Marketplace.

source_string: We can't download the template right now. Please make sure you're connected to the internet and try again.
translation: Wy kinne it sjabloan no net downloade. Kontrolearje oft jo mei it ynternet ferbûn binne en probearje it opnij.

source_string: You must free disk space before downloading a template.
translation: Jo moatte skiifromte frijmeitsje foardat jo in sjabloan downloade.

source_string: Import templates created by thousands of other players and export your own to share with the world.
translation: Ymportearje sjabloanen makke troch tûzenen oare spilers en eksportearje jo eigen om te dielen mei de wrâld.

source_string: Storage almost full. Delete data from Settings to create a world.
translation: Opslach hast fol. Wis gegevens út Ynstellingen om in wrâld te meitsjen.

source_string: Storage almost full. Delete data from Settings to enter a world.
translation: Opslach hast fol. Wis gegevens út Ynstellingen om in wrâld te iepenjen.

source_string: Storage is full. Delete data from Settings to create a world.
translation: Opslach is fol. Wis gegevens út Ynstellingen om in wrâld te meitsjen.

source_string: Storage is full. Delete data from Settings to enter a world.
translation: Opslach is fol. Wis gegevens út Ynstellingen om in wrâld te iepenjen.

source_string: Tap arrows to move. Drag anywhere else to look around. Tap and hold blocks to interact with them.
translation: Tik op pylken om te bewegen. Sleep earne oars om om te sjen. Tik en hâld blokken fêst om te ynteraksje.

source_string: Drag joystick to move. Drag anywhere else to look around. Aim crosshair and use buttons to interact with blocks.
translation: Sleep joystick om te bewegen. Sleep earne oars om om te sjen. Rjochtsje it draadkrús en brûk knoppen om mei blokken te ynteraksje.

source_string: Controls can be customized in the settings menu at any time
translation: Bestjoering kin op elk momint oanpast wurde yn it ynstellingenmenu

source_string: Touch a panel to see a preview
translation: Rekje in paniel oan om in foarbyld te sjen

source_string: Drag joystick to move. Drag anywhere else to look around. Tap and hold blocks to interact with them.
translation: Sleep joystick om te bewegen. Sleep earne oars om om te sjen. Tik en hâld blokken fêst om te ynteraksje.

source_string: Whether you want endless daylight or instant respawns, Advanced settings let you craft your adventure to perfection.
translation: Wolst do einleaze deiljocht of daliks werombringe, mei Avansearre ynstellingen meitsjesto jo aventoer perfekt.

source_string: With behavior packs from Minecraft Marketplace you can make zombies friendly, cows fly, or even create entirely new creatures and gameplay mechanics.
translation: Mei gedrachspakketten fan de Minecraft Marketplace kinsto zombies freonlik meitsje, kij fleane litte, of sels folslein nije skepsels en gameplay-meganismen meitsje.

source_string: Whether you want to change the weather, build without limits or just have some fun, cheats are for you.
translation: Wolst do it waar feroarje, sûnder beheiningen bouwe of gewoan wat plesier ha, cheats binne foar dy.

source_string: Test out upcoming changes, like new blocks, mobs, and mechanics, before they officially make it into the game.
translation: Test op takomstige feroaringen, lykas nije blokken, mobs, en meganismen, foardat se offisjeel yn it spul komme.

source_string: Play Minecraft with your friends, no matter what device they’re on. Get creative or survive together in online multiplayer.
translation: Spylje Minecraft mei jo freonen, wat apparaat se ek brûke. Wurd kreatyf of oerlibje tegearre yn online multiplayer.

source_string: Play Minecraft with your friends, no matter what device they’re on. Purchase the full game so you can get creative or survive together with online multiplayer.
translation: Spylje Minecraft mei jo freonen, wat apparaat se ek brûke. Keapje it folsleine spul sadat jo kreatyf wurde kinne of tegearre oerlibje mei online multiplayer.

source_string: Your own private Minecraft server. Members play for free, even when you’re offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any device.
translation: Jo eigen private Minecraft-server. Leden spylje fergees, sels as jo offline binne. Maklik op te setten, te beheare, en tagong ta fan elk apparaat.

source_string: Craving a medieval kingdom or a futuristic city? Resource packs from Minecraft Marketplace let you change textures, sounds; transform your world in any way you like.
translation: Ferlangje in midsieusk keninkryk of in futuristyske stêd? Boarnepakketten fan de Minecraft Marketplace lit jo teksturen, lûden feroarje; feroarje jo wrâld op elke wize dysto wolst.

source_string: Discover servers that offer unique Minecraft experiences. Explore new worlds, play minigames, and make friends.
translation: Untdek servers dy't unike Minecraft-ûnderfiningen biede. Ferken nije wrâlden, spylje minispultsjes, en meitsje freonen.

source_string: Trial mode is just the tip of the iceberg. Upgrade to the full version of the game and play online with friends on any other platform.
translation: Proefmodus is mar it topke fan de iisberg. Fernije nei de folsleine ferzje fan it spul en spylje online mei freonen op elk oar platfoarm.

source_string: Build without restrictions in Creative mode, set up private and persistent Realms with your friends and download content packs to make the game truly yours.
translation: Bou sûnder beheiningen yn Kreative modus, set private en bliuwende Realms op mei jo freonen en download ynhâldpakketten om it spul echt jo eigen te meitsjen.

source_string: All this and more in the full version!
translation: Al dit en mear yn de folsleine ferzje!

source_string: While in game, press the %1$s buttons at the same time or use the camera button in the game menu to take a screenshot.
translation: Yn it spul, druk op de %1$s-knoppen tagelyk of brûk de kameraknop yn it spulmenu om in skermôfbylding te meitsjen.

source_string: While in game, take a screenshot using the camera button in the game menu or the keyboard hotkey (F2 by default).
translation: Yn it spul, meitsje in skermôfbylding mei de kameraknop yn it spulmenu of de toetseboerd-hotkey (standert F2).

source_string: Use the camera button in the game menu to take a screenshot.
translation: Brûk de kameraknop yn it spulmenu om in skermôfbylding te meitsjen.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled.
translation: Jo kinne noch spylje op dizze wrâld, mar multiplayer-funksjes binne útskeakele.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled. Go to Learn more to troubleshoot.
translation: Jo kinne noch spylje op dizze wrâld, mar multiplayer-funksjes binne útskeakele. Gean nei Mear ynfo om te troubleshootjen.

source_string: You can still play on this world, but multiplayer features are disabled. View and manage your multiplayer settings with “Online safety” in the parental controls. Go to Learn more to troubleshoot.
translation: Jo kinne noch spylje op dizze wrâld, mar multiplayer-funksjes binne útskeakele. Besjoch en beheare jo multiplayer-ynstellingen mei "Online feiligens" yn de âlderlike kontrôle. Gean nei Mear ynfo om te troubleshootjen.

source_string: Attaches the scripting debugger on localhost port 19144. Check Log panel for connection status.
translation: Keppelt de skriptdebugger op localhost-poarte 19144. Kontrolearje it Logpaniel foar ferbiningsstatus.

source_string: Switch to Crosshair mode for single-block precision editing.
translation: Skeakel oer nei Draadkrúsmodus foar presize bewurking fan inkelde blokken.

source_string: Open Hotbars panel to manage all Hotbars and Hotbar items.
translation: Iepenje it Arkbalkenpaniel om alle arkbalken en arkbalkeûnderdielen te behearen.

source_string: Opens Keyboard Settings modal to configure registered bindings.
translation: Iepenet de modal Toetseboerdynstellingen om registrearre keppelingen te konfigurearjen.

source_string: Reloads all script files for all Behavior Packs and refreshes UI for all clients.
translation: Laadt alle skriptbestannen foar alle Behavior Packs opnij en fernijt de UI foar alle klanten.

source_string: Opens the Structures panel to save/load Structures.
translation: Iepenet it Struktuerenpaniel om struktueren te bewarjen/lade.

source_string: %1$s is already in use and will be removed from %2$s > %3$s if confirmed.
translation: %1$s is al yn gebrûk en sil fuortsmiten wurde út %2$s > %3$s as befêstige.

source_string: ESC or %1 to go back to Tool Mode
translation: ESC of %1 om werom te gean nei Arkmodus

source_string: This is the description of the tooltip. Adding extra characters to show overflow.
translation: Dit is de beskriuwing fan de tooltip. Tafoege ekstra tekens om oerstreaming te toanen.

source_string: Click on the input field and press keyboard keys to create the desired binding. Press ENTER or unfocus to confirm the binding, or ESCAPE to reset it. Right-clicking on the field while focused will unbind the current binding.
translation: Klik op it ynfierfjild en druk toetseboerdtoetsen om de winske keppeling te meitsjen. Druk ENTER of gean fuort om de keppeling te befêstigjen, of ESCAPE om it opnij yn te stellen. Rjochtsklikken op it fjild wylst fokusearre sil de aktive keppeling losmeitsje.

source_string: Global context for both Crosshair and Tool modes.
translation: Globale kontekst foar sawol Draadkrús- as Arkmodus.

source_string: Input context for when the viewport is in focus.
translation: Ynfierkontekst foar as it werjefteskerm fokusearre is.

source_string: When the exclusive toggle is enabled, single-key actions will activate only if no other modifiers are present, or if the specified modifier combination is used alongside the key.
translation: As de eksklusive skeakel oanstiet, wurde inkelde-toets-aksjes allinnich aktivearre as der gjin oare modifikators binne, of as de spesifisearre modifikator-kombinaasje mei de toets brûkt wurdt.

source_string: Global context for both crosshair and tool modes
translation: Globale kontekst foar sawol draadkrús- as arkmodus

source_string: Caution, the link you're about to open has not been verified by Minecraft.
translation: Pas op, de keppeling dysto ophandich iepenje wolst is net ferifiearre troch Minecraft.

source_string: Toggle automatically scroll to the bottom of the Log Panel as need entries are made.
translation: Skeakel automatysk skowe nei de ûnderkant fan it Logpaniel oan by nije yngongen.
Skeakel it toanen fan debugberjochten oan/út.
Skeakel it toanen fan flaterberjochten oan/út.

source_string: Filter where the errors and warning are coming from.
translation: Filterje wêr't de flaters en warskôgingen weikomme.
Skeakel it toanen fan ynfoberjochten oan/út.
Skeakel it toanen fan warskôgingsberjochten oan/út.

source_string: Copies one area of the world onto another area.
translation: Kopiearret ien gebiet fan de wrâld nei in oar gebiet.

source_string: Are you sure you want to delete %1$s structures?
translation: Bisto wis datsto %1$s struktueren fuortsmite wolst?

source_string: Are you sure you want to delete "%1$s"?
Note: Structures from imported packs can't be deleted (remove imported packs to remove them from your Structures list).
translation: Opmerking: struktueren fan ymportearre pakketten kinne net fuortsmiten wurde (smyt ymportearre pakketten fuort om se fan jo Struktuerenlist te helje).
Dit kin net ûngedien makke wurde.

source_string: Are you sure you want to exit the tutorial?
translation: Bisto wis datsto de hantlieding ferlitte wolst?

source_string: Now, let's explore the Brush Paint tool.[*newLine]Activate it by clicking %s on the toolrail or pressing %s.
translation: No sille wy it Boarstelferf-ark ferkenne.[*newLine]Aktivearje it troch %s op de arkrail te klikken of troch %s te drukken.

source_string: Hold Left Click and move the mouse to add blocks.
translation: Hâld Links Klik yn en beweech de mûs om blokken ta te foegjen.

source_string: Holding %1$s while using the Brush Paint tool removes blocks.
translation: As jo %1$s ynhâlde by it gebrûk fan it Boarstelferf-ark, wurde blokken fuortsmiten.

source_string: Great! You now know the basics of Minecraft Editor—enjoy creating your first Editor experience![*newLine]Use Test World to playtest anytime, then Export or upload to Realms to share with friends.[*newLine]For more, visit [*link|%1$s]Minecraft Editor Documentation[*link] or press the Info button on tooltips for details on specific tools.
translation: Geweldich! Jo kenne no de basis fan de Minecraft Editor—genietsje fan it meitsjen fan jo earste Editor-ûnderfining![*newLine]Brûk Test Wrâld om altyd te playtestjen, en eksportearje of upload nei Realms om te dielen mei freonen.[*newLine]Foar mear, gean nei [*link|%1$s]Minecraft Editor-dokumintaasje[*link] of druk op de Ynfo-knop op tooltips foar details oer spesifike ark.

source_string: The hotbar sets the block for Fill operations, brushes, and more.[*newLine]Switch slots with 1-9 keys or the mouse.[*newLine]To change the block, reselect the active slot.
translation: De arkbalke stelt it blok yn foar folopperaasjes, borstels, en mear.[*newLine]Skeakel plakken mei 1-9-toetsen of de mûs.[*newLine]Om it blok te feroarjen, selektearje it aktive plak opnij.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.[*%s]Use Middle Mouse scroll to zoom.[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Middle Mouse Button to pan the camera.
translation: Beweging[*%s]Brûk de mûs wylst jo Rjochts Klik ynhâlde om de kamera troch de wrâld te bewegen.[*%s]Brûk %s, %s, %s, en %s om foarút, efterút, links en rjochts te bewegen.[*%s]Brûk %s en %s om op en del te bewegen.[*%s]Brûk de skoftel fan de middelmûs om te zoomen.[*%s]Brûk de mûs wylst jo de middelmûsknop ynhâlde om de kamera te pannen.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.
translation: Beweging[*%s]Brûk de mûs wylst jo Rjochts Klik ynhâlde om de kamera troch de wrâld te bewegen.[*%s]Brûk %s, %s, %s, en %s om foarút, efterút, links en rjochts te bewegen.[*%s]Brûk %s en %s om op en del te bewegen.

source_string: Let’s explore the Selection tool.[*newLine]Activate the Selection tool by clicking %1$s on the toolrail or pressing %2$s.
translation: Litte wy it Seleksje-ark ferkenne.[*newLine]Aktivearje it Seleksje-ark troch %1$s op de arkrail te klikken of troch %2$s te drukken.

source_string: Left-click to set the selection start, then drag to adjust its size.
translation: Links-klik om it seleksje-begjin yn te stellen, en sleep dan om de grutte oan te passen.

source_string: Click the Fill button on the Action Bar or press %s to fill the selection with blocks.
translation: Klik op de Fol-knop op de Aksjebalke of druk %s om de seleksje mei blokken te folje.

source_string: The Selection tool lets you move, copy, and build with precision.
translation: It Seleksje-ark lit jo mei presyzje bewegen, kopiearje, en bouwe.

source_string: Welcome to Minecraft Editor, a powerful tool for creating stunning Bedrock worlds with ease.[*newLine]Things work differently in Editor and it's important that you understand a few basics first or you might get lost.[*newLine]Let's dive into the basics.
translation: Wolkom by de Minecraft Editor, in machtich ark om moaie Bedrock-wrâlden mei gemak te meitsjen.[*newLine]Dingen wurkje oars yn de Editor en it is wichtich datsto earst wat basisdingen begrypst, oars kinsto ferlern gean.[*newLine]Litte wy yn de basis dûke.
Probearje it út om troch te gean...

source_string: Set the font size for text in the Editor.
translation: Set de lettertypegrutte foar tekst yn de Editor.

source_string: Set the theme for the UI in Editor.
translation: Set it tema foar de UI yn de Editor.

source_string: Set the size of the UI elements.
translation: Set de grutte fan de UI-elementen.

source_string: We are so excited you're here and about to build with Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, where we want to empower Creators of all skillsets to easily create high-quality experiences.
translation: Wy binne sa optein datsto hjir bist en dwaande wolst bouwe mei Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, wêr wy Meitsjers fan alle feardigensnivo's oanmoedigje om maklik hege kwaliteit ûnderfiningen te meitsjen.

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - Der binne twa modi yn de Editor: Ark of Draadkrús. Ark rjochtet him op it brûken fan de multi-blok-bewurkingsark lykas beskikber fia de UI en de frij bewegende oanwizer, en Draadkrús is bedoeld foar mear presize, inkelde-blok-bewurkingen mei help fan in draadkrús yn 1e persoan.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - UI-oriïntaasje: de linkerreeks fan ark wurdt de "arkrail" neamd, de boppereeks is de "aksjebalke" (bgl. ûngedien meitsje/opnij dwaan), en it hielendal boppen is it "menu" (bgl. Bestân).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - Foar de measte UI-aksjes en ark is der in korresponderende fluchtoets en somtiden in slash-kommando.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Kamera draaie / beweging ûntskoattelje: yn Ark, hâld de rjochtermûsknop yn. Yn Draadkrús, hoechst jo de rjochtermûsknop net yn te hâlde.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
- Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Beweeg op de Y-as: E (omheech), Q (omleech)

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Skeakel tusken Ark- en Draadkrúsmodus: (CTRL+TAB) of de UI-knop ûnder yn it werjefteskerm. Yn Draadkrús moatte jo de fluchtoetsen brûke -- (CTRL+TAB) of ESC.

source_string: View the detailed directory of controls:
translation: Besjoch de detaillearre map fan bestjoeringen:

source_string: Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.
translation: Aksjes binne fluchtoetsen dy't boppen op jo skerm libje. Druk op de "+"-knop yn de Aksjebalke om oan te passen hokker toand wurde.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: Boppen yn it midden fan jo skerm is de Arkbalke. Klik ien kear om it aktive blok te feroarjen, klik twa kear om de Blokkiezer te iepenjen om de Arkbalke oan te passen.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.
translation: Jo kinne in nije Arkbalke meitsje troch de Arkbalkemenu-knop rjochts te klikken.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: Om te navigearjen yn de Editor, hawwe jo in toetseboerd en mûs nedich. Trackpads of controllers wurde net oanret.
Om te bewegen yn de Editor:

source_string: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.
translation: Hâld de rjochtermûsknop yn om om te sjen.

source_string: Use WASD to move horizontally and Q & E to move vertically.
translation: Brûk WASD om horizontaal te bewegen en Q & E om fertikaal te bewegen.

source_string: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.
translation: Jo fine ark op de linkerrail. Elk ark lit jo jo wrâld op ferskillende manieren bewurkje.

source_string: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.
translation: Klik op de Ynformaasje-knop ("i") yn de rjochterboppehoek fan elk ark om mear te learen oer hoe't it wurket.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft Editor, a tool designed to help you create stunning worlds in Bedrock with ease.
translation: Wolkom by de Minecraft Editor, in ark ûntworpen om jo te helpen moaie wrâlden yn Bedrock mei gemak te meitsjen.

source_string: You may find these links helpful on your journey:
translation: Jo kinne dizze keppelingen nuttich fine op jo reis:

source_string: To reopen Quick Start, you can find it under the ‘Help’ menu.
translation: Om Fluchstart opnij te iepenjen, kinsto it fine ûnder it 'Help'-menu.
Gean rjochts om dizze %1$s te sluten

source_string: Navigate left and right for more pages
translation: Navigearje links en rjochts foar mear sides

source_string: More pages available to the left and right
translation: Mear sides beskikber lofts en rjochts

source_string: Move to the right of this field for additional actions.
translation: Gean rjochts fan dit fjild foar oanfoljende aksjes.

translation: Freegje jo learaar om in lisinsje foar jo te keapjen op:
