translation: Klik hjir om in lisinsje te keapjen

source_string: Cannot access blocks outside of the world
translation: Kin gjin tagong ta blokken bûten de wrâld

source_string: Cannot access blocks outside of the world
translation: Kin gjin tagong ta blokken bûten de wrâld

source_string: The command can only be used by a valid player
translation: It kommando kin allinnich brûkt wurde troch in jildige spiler

source_string: No valid structure found in this dimension
translation: Gjin jildige struktuer fûn yn dizze diminsje
De tichtstby %1$s befynt him op blok %2$s, (y?), %3$s

source_string: You need to be signed into a valid, non-guest Xbox Live account to enable Mixer interactivity.
translation: Jo moatte oanmeld wêze mei in jildich, net-gast Xbox Live-akkount om Mixer-ynteraktiviteit yn te skeakeljen.

source_string: The device you are using does not support Mixer interactivity.
translation: It apparaat dat jo brûke stipet Mixer-ynteraktiviteit net.

source_string: No scene named %1$s exists. Make sure you have entered the scene name correctly.
translation: Gjin seane mei de namme %1$s bestiet. Kontrolearje oft jo de seanenamme goed ynfierd hawwe.

source_string: Could not find project with ID "%1$s". Make sure the ID or share code is correct.
translation: Koe gjin projekt fine mei ID "%1$s". Kontrolearje oft de ID of dielkoade goed is.
Gjin interaktive sesje om te stopjen.

source_string: Could not add %1$s to the whitelist
translation: Koe %1$s net tafoegje oan de wytlist

source_string: There are %1$d (out of %2$d seen) whitelisted players:
Could not remove %1$s from the whitelist
translation: Koe %1$s net fuortsmite fan de wytlist

source_string: Anyone with the link can join your Realm. Go to Game > Download World to download a backup of your world.
translation: Elkien mei de keppeling kin oanslute by jo Realm. Gean nei Spul > Wrâld downloade om in reservekopy fan jo wrâld te downloaden.

source_string: This will invalidate the old link and create a new one. Do you wish to continue?
translation: Dit sil de âlde keppeling ûnjildich meitsje en in nije meitsje. Wolst jo trochgean?

source_string: To use Realms, you need to subscribe to Nintendo Switch Online.
translation: Om Realms te brûken, moatte jo abonnearje op Nintendo Switch Online.

source_string: Microsoft Privacy Policy can be found at: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
translation: Microsoft Privacybelied is te finen op: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

source_string: Oops! Maybe check your internet connection? We can't find your friends' worlds.
translation: Hoppa! Kontrolearje jo ynternetferbining? Wy kinne jo freonen har wrâlden net fine.

source_string: Want added security for your coins and packs? Sign in to Xbox Live to save your Minecoins, Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Wolst do ekstra befeiliging foar jo munten en pakketten? Meld oan by Xbox Live om jo Minecoins, skins, teksturepakketten, wrâlden, en mash-ups te bewarjen. Se sille der altyd foar jo wêze op elk apparaat wêr jo Minecraft spylje.

source_string: Purchases left on your device may be lost if you lose your device or uninstall Minecraft.
translation: Oankeapen litten op jo apparaat kinne ferlern gean as jo jo apparaat ferlieze of Minecraft ferwiderje.

source_string: Transferring purchases to Xbox Live account...
In addition, you will be able to access them on any device you use to play Minecraft!
translation: Boppedat kinne jo se tagong ta op elk apparaat wêrmei jo Minecraft spylje!

source_string: Content purchased through a partner store will be available as long as your device is signed in to your partner store account.
translation: Ynhâld kocht fia in partnerwinkel sil beskikber wêze salang jo apparaat oanmeld is op jo partnerwinkel-akkount.

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not transfer this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dit Xbox Live-akkount sil net it haadakkount wêze foar dit apparaat as jo de oankeapen fan dit apparaat net oerdrage nei dit akkount. Jo sille net automatysk oanmelde as jo Minecraft starte.

source_string: %1 and %2	## comment.like(s) will be inserted at %1 and comment.comment(s) at %2
translation: %1 en %2	## comment.like(s) will be inserted at %1 and comment.comment(s) at %2

source_string: You can also wear a Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.
translation: Jo kinne ek in pompoen op jo kop drage. Dit jout jo gjin :armor: mar makket dat Endermen net lulk wurde as jo har oansjogge.

source_string: Minecraft is a game about placing blocks to build anything you can imagine. At night monsters come out, so make sure to build a shelter before that happens.
translation: Minecraft is in spul oer it pleatsen fan blokken om alles te bouwen wat jo jo foarstelle kinne. Nachts komme der monsters út, dus wês wis dat jo in skûlplak bouwe foardat dat bart.

source_string: Use the mouse to look around.
translation: Brûk de mûs om om te sjen.

source_string: Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Rekje it skerm oan en sleep om om te sjen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: to sprint. While you hold :_input_key.forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk twa kear flot efter elkoar op :_input_key.forward: of druk op :_input_key.sprint: om te sprintsjen. Sa lang as do :_input_key.forward: ynhâldst, silst trochgean mei sprintsjen oant do minder hast as :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :_gamepad_stick_left: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk :_gamepad_stick_left: twa kear flot efter elkoar foarút om te sprintsjen. Sa lang as do :_gamepad_stick_left: foarút ynhâldst, silst trochgean mei sprintsjen oant do minder hast as :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk twa kear flot efter elkoar op :touch_forward: om te sprintsjen. Sa lang as do :touch_forward: ynhâldst, silst trochgean mei sprintsjen oant do minder hast as :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :rift_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :rift_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk :rift_left_stick: twa kear flot efter elkoar foarút om te sprintsjen. Sa lang as do :rift_left_stick: foarút ynhâldst, silst trochgean mei sprintsjen oant do minder hast as :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk :windowsmr_left_stick: twa kear flot efter elkoar foarút om te sprintsjen. Sa lang as do :windowsmr_left_stick: foarút ynhâldst, silst trochgean mei sprintsjen oant do minder hast as :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Hâld :_input_key.attack: yn om te dolven en te houwen mei jo hân of wat jo ek fêsthâlde. Jo moatte miskien in ark meitsje om guon blokken te dolven.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Rekje it skerm oan en hâld it op in blok om te dolven en te houwen mei jo hân of wat jo ek fêsthâlde. Jo moatte miskien in ark meitsje om guon blokken te dolven.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: As jo in foarwerp yn jo hân hawwe, brûk :_input_key.use: om dat foarwerp te brûken of druk :_input_key.drop: om it falle te litten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: As jo in foarwerp yn jo hân hawwe, brûk :_input_key.use: om dat foarwerp te brûken of druk :_input_key.drop: om it falle te litten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :rift_right_grab: to use that item or press :rift_right_stick: to drop it.
translation: As jo in foarwerp yn jo hân hawwe, brûk :rift_right_grab: om dat foarwerp te brûken of druk :rift_right_stick: om it falle te litten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_trigger: to use that item or press :windowsmr_right_grab: to drop it.
translation: As jo in foarwerp yn jo hân hawwe, brûk :windowsmr_left_trigger: om dat foarwerp te brûken of druk :windowsmr_right_grab: om it falle te litten.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, touch the screen to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it.
translation: As jo in foarwerp yn jo hân hawwe, rekje it skerm oan om dat foarwerp te brûken of rekje it foarwerp yn jo arkbalke oan en hâld it om it falle te litten.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Slûpe is bysûnder nuttich yn Minecraft: slûpe soarget derfoar dat do net fan in blok ôf falst en ferstopt dyn nammelabel. Om te slûpen, hâld :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.
translation: Slûpen is bysûnder nuttich yn Minecraft, slûpen soarget derfoar dat jo net fan in blok falle en ferbrekt jo nammelabel. Om slûpen te skeakeljen, druk :_input_key.sneak: of klik :_gamepad_stick_right:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Slûpen is bysûnder nuttich yn Minecraft, slûpen soarget derfoar dat jo net fan in blok falle en ferbrekt jo nammelabel. Om slûpen te skeakeljen, tik :touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :rift_X:.
translation: Slûpen is bysûnder nuttich yn Minecraft, slûpen soarget derfoar dat jo net fan in blok falle en ferbrekt jo nammelabel. Om slûpen te skeakeljen, druk :rift_X:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Slûpen is bysûnder nuttich yn Minecraft, slûpen soarget derfoar dat jo net fan in blok falle en ferbrekt jo nammelabel. Om slûpen te skeakeljen, druk :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintsjen yn wetter sil jo swimme litte. Brûk de mûs om de rjochting te kontrolearjen wêryn't jo swimme.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :_gamepad_stick_right: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintsjen yn wetter sil jo swimme litte. Brûk :_gamepad_stick_right: om de rjochting te kontrolearjen wêryn't jo swimme.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Touch and drag along the screen to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintsjen yn wetter sil jo swimme litte. Rekje it skerm oan en sleep om de rjochting te kontrolearjen wêryn't jo swimme.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintsjen yn wetter sil jo swimme litte. Brûk :rift_right_stick: om de rjochting te kontrolearjen wêryn't jo swimme.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sprintsjen yn wetter sil jo swimme litte. Brûk :windowsmr_right_stick: om de rjochting te kontrolearjen wêryn't jo swimme.

source_string: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :_input_key.inventory: om tagong te krijen ta it Resepteboek en it Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :_input_container.crafting: om tagong te krijen ta it Resepteboek en it Nifelroaster.

source_string: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Tik op de Ynventarisknop om tagong te krijen ta it Resepteboek en it Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :rift_B: om tagong te krijen ta it Resepteboek en it Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :windowsmr_left_grab: om tagong te krijen ta it Resepteboek en it Nifelroaster.

source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Rangearje foarwerpen fan jo ynventaris of arkbalke yn it nifelroaster yn de foarm fan in foarwerpresept.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: As it resept goed is, sil it foarwerp dat jo besykje te nifelje ferskine yn it Utfierplak rjochts fan it Nifelroaster. Nim it fan it Utfierplak en set it yn jo ynventaris. Jo kinne it foarwerp no brûke.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: Der binne in protte resepten en foar guon hawwe jo in grutter Nifelroaster nedich as it 2x2-roaster wêrmei jo begjinne.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Nifelje 4 houten planken ta in Wurkbank en pleats it yn de wrâld.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Wurkbank yn de wrâld om tagong te krijen ta in 3x3 Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op in Wurkbank yn de wrâld om tagong te krijen ta in 3x3 Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :rift_right_grab: op in Wurkbank yn de wrâld om tagong te krijen ta in 3x3 Nifelroaster.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk :windowsmr_left_trigger: op in Wurkbank yn de wrâld om tagong te krijen ta in 3x3 Nifelroaster.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Tik op in Wurkbank yn de wrâld om tagong te krijen ta in 3x3 Nifelroaster.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: Oan de linkerkant fan it skerm sjogge jo it Resepteboek, wat goed is as jo in resept net witte of gau in resept nifelje wolle dat jo al kenne. Jo sjogge ek it Nifelroaster oan de rjochterkant fan it skerm boppe jo ynventaris.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: As jo it resept fûn hawwe dat jo nifelje wolle, :_input_key.attack: it resept om it yn it nifelroaster te lade, en nim it dan fan it Utfierplak rjochts fan it Nifelroaster en set it yn jo ynventaris. :_input_key.use: it resept om automatysk te nifeljen, dit nifelt automatysk ien set en set it yn jo ynventaris. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: it resept om in hiele stapel automatysk te nifeljen.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: As jo it resept fûn hawwe dat jo nifelje wolle, druk :_gamepad_face_button_down: op it resept om automatysk te nifeljen, dit nifelt automatysk ien set en set it yn jo ynventaris. Druk :_gamepad_face_button_up: op it resept om in hiele stapel automatysk te nifeljen.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: As jo it resept fûn hawwe dat jo nifelje wolle, tik op it resept om it yn it nifelroaster te lade, en tik dan op it foarwerp yn it útfierplak om it te nifeljen. Druk en hâld it foarwerp yn it útfierplak om trochgeand te nifeljen.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: As de :craftable_toggle_on: oan is, toant it Resepteboek alle resepten wêrfoar jo yngrediïnten hawwe. As de :craftable_toggle_off: út is, toant it Resepteboek elk resept yn it spul, sels as jo it net nifelje kinne. Kontrolearje de ljeppers of sykje as jo op syk binne nei wat spesifyks. Yn Kreative modus wurde guon resepten ynklapt binnen listen. It iepenjen fan de list sil it útklappe en jo alle resepten der binnen toane.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: Om te fleane yn Kreative modus, tik :_input_key.jump: twa kear rap. Om te stopjen mei fleane, werhelje de aksje. Om flugger te fleane, tik :_input_key.forward: twa kear rap efter elkoar wylst jo fleane. Yn fleanmodus kinne jo :touch_fly_up: drukke om omheech te gean en :touch_fly_down: om omleech te gean.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
translation: Hoe te spylje: Eye of Ender

source_string: - Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Alde wrâlden beheind yn grutte en hichte.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Mob-bút: Kontrolearret oft mobs bút drope as se stjerre.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: -Mob-fernieling: Foarkomt dat mobs de wrâld fernielje.

source_string: -Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Blokdroppen: As dizze ynstelling oanstiet, drope blokken harsels as se brekke.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Entiteiten drope bút: Kontrolearret oft dingen lykas mynkarts en bewâpeningsstanners harsels drope as se brekke.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Waarsyklus: It waar sil net feroarje as dizze ynstelling útstiet.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: Hoe te spylje: Host- en spileropsjes

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: De HUD toant ynformaasje oer jo status, jo sûnens, jo oerbleaune soerstof (as jo ûnder wetter binne), jo hongerpeil, en jo bewâpening (as jo wat drage).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: As do wat sûnens ferliest, mar noch op syn minst njoggen :shank: hast, sil dyn sûnens har oanfolje. It iten fan fiedsel oanfollet dyn :shank:.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Druk en hâld :_input_key.use: yn wylst jo in stik iten hawwe om it te iten.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Druk en hâld :_input_key.use: yn wylst jo in stik iten hawwe om it te iten.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Druk en hâld :rift_right_grab: yn wylst jo in stik iten hawwe om it te iten.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Druk en hâld :windowsmr_left_trigger: yn wylst jo in stik iten hawwe om it te iten.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Druk en hâld in stik iten om it te iten.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Jo moatte jo hongerpeil yn de gaten hâlde ûnder it aventoerjen, jo hongerpeil wurdt op jo HUD toand mei :shank:. It hongerpeil nimt ôf wylst jo ferkenne. Bepaalde aktiviteiten sille it hongerpeil flugger fermindere, lykas sprintsjen. Jo kinne jo hongerpeil oanfolje troch iten te iten. Guon iten is fiediger as oaren en sil mear :shank: opfolje. As jo jo hongerpeil op maksimum krije, past it lêste iten dat jo iten hawwe in satuaasjewearde ta. Satuaasje is in ferstoppe getal dat jo in ekstra bonus jout op jo hongerpeil.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: De Underfiningsbalke wurdt ek toand op de HUD. It getal toant jo aktuele Underfiningsnivo, en de balke toant hoefolle Underfiningspunten nedich binne om jo Underfiningsnivo te ferheegjen.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Underfiningspunten wurde krigen troch Underfiningsbollen te sammeljen. Jo kinne Underfiningsbollen krije fan aktiviteiten lykas it deadzjen fan mobs, it dolven fan bepaalde blokken, en mear! Lit gjin Underfiningsbollen efter, jo sille se nedich hawwe. Beweech tichtby Underfiningsbollen om se te sammeljen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: De arkbalke toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om te brûken. Skrol it mûswiel om it foarwerp yn jo hân te feroarjen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De arkbalke toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om te brûken. Brûk :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: en :_input_key.cycleItemRight: om it foarwerp yn jo hân te feroarjen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: De arkbalke toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om te brûken. Tik op items yn jo arkbalke om it foarwerp yn jo hân te feroarjen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De arkbalke toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om te brûken. Druk :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: om it foarwerp yn jo hân te feroarjen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De arkbalke toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om te brûken. Druk :rift_left_trigger: of :rift_left_grab: om it foarwerp yn jo hân te feroarjen.
Druk :_input_key.inventory: om jo ynventaris te besjen.
Druk :_input_key.inventory: om jo ynventaris te besjen.
Druk :rift_B: om jo ynventaris te besjen.
Druk :windowsmr_left_grab: om jo ynventaris te besjen.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: Dit skerm toant de foarwerpen dy't beskikber binne om yn jo hân te brûken, en al de oare foarwerpen dy't jo drage. Jo bewâpening wurdt hjir ek toand.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Brûk :mouse_left_button: om it foarwerp dat ûnder de rinnerij is op te pakken. As der mear as ien foarwerp hjir is, sil dit se allegear opnimme, of jo kinne :mouse_right_button: brûke om mar de helte fan harren op te pakken.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Brûk :_gamepad_face_button_down: om it foarwerp dat ûnder de rinnerij is op te pakken. As der mear as ien foarwerp hjir is, sil dit se allegear opnimme, of jo kinne :_gamepad_face_button_left: brûke om mar de helte fan harren op te pakken.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Tik om in foarwerp te selektearjen. As der mear as ien foarwerp hjir is, sil dit se allegear selektearje.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Jo kinne foarwerpen wer del sette troch :mouse_left_button: te brûken. Mei meardere foarwerpen op de rinnerij, brûk :mouse_left_button: om se allegear del te setten of :mouse_right_button: om mar ien del te setten.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Jo kinne foarwerpen wer del sette troch :_gamepad_face_button_down: te brûken. Mei meardere foarwerpen op de rinnerij, brûk :_gamepad_face_button_down: om se allegear del te setten of :_gamepad_face_button_left: om mar ien del te setten.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Tik op in oare plak yn de ynventaris om it foarwerp te ferpleatsen.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: Is it foarwerp ûnder de rinnerij bewâpening, dan kinst dat fluch nei it juste bewâpeningsfek ferpleatse mei SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Is it foarwerp ûnder de rinnerij bewâpening, dan kinst dat fluch nei it juste bewâpeningsfek ferpleatse mei :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: Om in foarwerp falle te litten, pak it foarwerp op en set it del bûten it ynventarisfinster.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Om in foarwerp falle te litten, pak it foarwerp op en druk :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: Om in foarwerp falle te litten, tik op it foarwerp en tik dan bûten it ynventarisfinster.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Jo kinne lokale spilers by jo spul oanslute litte troch controllers te ferbinen en op elk momint yn it spul in knop op harren controller te drukken.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standert start elke wrâld mei multiplayer ynskeakele. As jo de wrâld privé meitsje wolle, gean nei wrâldynstellingen en selektearje de multiplayeropsje, en skeakel multiplayer dan út.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standert start elke wrâld mei multiplayer ynskeakele. As jo de wrâld privé meitsje wolle, gean nei wrâldynstellingen en selektearje de multiplayeropsje, en skeakel multiplayer dan út.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Om by in multiplayerspul oan te sluten, gean nei it freonenljepper. Alle oanslútbere Realms, freonen, en LAN-spullen wurde hjir toand. Kies in spul en selektearje it om oan te sluten.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Om by in multiplayerspul oan te sluten, gean nei it freonenljepper. Alle oanslútbere Realms, freonen, en LAN-spullen wurde hjir toand. Kies in spul en selektearje it om oan te sluten.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: As jo in online spul starte of oansluten, sil it sichtber wêze foar minsken yn jo freonenljepper. As jo freonen oansluten, sil it spul no sichtber wêze foar freonen fan dizze freonen.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Opmerking: jo moatte in ynternetferbining hawwe en oanmeld wêze by Xbox Live om multiplayer te spyljen.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: As jo de tastimmingen fan yndividuele spilers beheare wolle, makket spilertastimmingen dit maklik. Iepenje it pauzemenu en oan de rjochterkant sjogge jo in list mei spilers dy't op it stuit yn de wrâld binne. Selektearje harren tastimmingikoan om dy spiler har tastimmingen oan te passen.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: Realms is in geweldige plak om in multiplayerspul te hosten dat altyd rint. Sels as jo net spylje, sil jo Realm draaien en ree wêze foar jo freonen om te ferkennen!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: Om in Realm op te setten, selektearje Nij Meitsje fan it Wrâlden-ljepper. Selektearje dan de Nije Realm-knop, en dan de Nije Wrâld Meitsje-knop. Hjir kinne jo jo Realm in namme jaan, en it oantal spilers ynstelle. Dan kinne jo freonen tafoegje oan jo Realm.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: As jo in Realm oanmakke hawwe, selektearje de Potleadknop om de Realm-ynstellingen te feroarjen.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Under de Spul-knop kinne jo de Realm omneame, de muoilikheidsgraad en spulmodus ynstelle, cheats oansette, en de wrâld downloade/uploade.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Under de Leden-knop kinne jo alle freonen beheare dy't jo útnoege hawwe foar jo Realm, leden tafoegje/fuortsmite, en harren tastimmingen ynstelle.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Under de Abonnemint-knop kinne jo sjen wannear't de Realm ferrint, de tiid ferlingje oant fervalle, en de Realm iepenje/slute.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: Hoe te spylje: Boarne- en Behavior Packs

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Jo kinne feroarje hoe't Minecraft der útsjocht en him gedraacht mei Resource en Behavior Packs.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: Yn it Ynstellingenmenu, kies in pakket út de list mei beskikbere pakketten en selektearje it plusteken derneist. No sil jo pakket syn feroaringen tapasse op it standert Minecraft-pakket.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
translation: It Server-ljepper sil populêre Minecraft-servers toane.

source_string: The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: De Minecraft Marketplace is in plak om nije skins, wrâlden, teksturen, en mash-uppakketten te finen fan ferskate begavene meitsjers.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Probearje in nije skin foar in frisse nije look!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Bekyk wrâlden om nije kaarten en útdagingen te ûntskoatteljen dy't jo wer en wer spylje wolle!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Jou jo âlde spul in nije look mei teksturepakketten dy't laach foar laach oer jo aktuele wrâlden en Realms lein wurde kinne!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Jou jo âlde spul in nije look mei teksturepakketten dy't laach foar laach oer jo aktuele wrâlden en Realms lein wurde kinne!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Of probearje se allegear mei mash-uppakketten dy't kuratearre kolleksjes binne fan skins, wrâlden, en teksturen dy't, as kombinearre, jo wrâlden en Realms transformearje!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Of probearje se allegear mei mash-uppakketten dy't kuratearre kolleksjes binne fan skins, wrâlden, en teksturen dy't, as kombinearre, jo wrâlden en Realms transformearje!

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Tik op de Rideknop wylst jo tichtby in mynkart binne om ynstappe en te riden. Druk :_input_key.forward: om foarút te rôljen. Tik :_input_key.jump: om der út te gean.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Tik op de opstapknop wylst jo tichtby in boat binne om der op te stappen. Druk :_input_key.left: of :_input_key.right: om links of rjochts te draaien. Druk se beide om foarút te bewegen. Tik op de boat-ferlittenknop om der út te gean.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: It swurd, de bôge, en de trident hawwe spesifike betoveringen dy't jo krije kinne fan de Betoveringstafel of it Oanbeald dy't skea, duorsumens ferbetterje en sels mobs oan fjoer stelle!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De trident is in tûk-doel wapen foar sawol delnei as op ôfstân. Druk :_input_key.attack: om oan te fallen. Druk en hâld :_input_key.use: om de trident tebek te lûken. Lit :_input_key.use: los om de trident te smiten. De trident is it bêste wapen ûnder wetter.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De trident is in tûk-doel wapen foar sawol delnei as op ôfstân. Tik op mobs om se oan te fallen. Druk en hâld it Skerm om de trident tebek te lûken. Lit de druk los om de trident te smiten. De trident is it bêste wapen ûnder wetter.

source_string: %s has changed from %s skin to %s skin.

Want to broadcast your game? You need to have a compatible broadcasting app installed. We recommend Mixer Create as it allows you to broadcast with sub-second latency, co-stream with friends and lets your viewers interact in fun ways. Certain features like Chat and Viewer Count only work with Mixer Create.
translation: Wolst do jo spul útstjoere? Jo moatte in kompatibele útstjoer-app ynstallearre hawwe. Wy rikommandearje Mixer Create om't it jo tastiet om út te stjoeren mei sub-sekonde fertraging, mei-streamje mei freonen en jo besjochters op leuke manieren ynteraksje litte. Bepaalde funksjes lykas Chat en Sjochtal wurkje allinnich mei Mixer Create.
Ree om jo spul út te stjoeren?

source_string: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please go to xbox.com and sign in to your account to fix this
translation: Jo hawwe gjin tastimming om dizze funksje te brûken. Gean nei xbox.com en meld oan by jo akkount om dit op te lossen
Meld oan om út te stjoeren

source_string: We need you to sign in before you can start broadcasting your game.
translation: Wy hawwe jo nedich om oan te melde foardat jo jo spul útstjoere kinne.

source_string: Xforge Requests Wait for Sign In
This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dizze wrâld hat Behavior Packs tapast dy't jo downloade moatte om oan te sluten. Wolst jo se downloade en oansluten?

source_string: This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join and Resource Packs that you may optionally download before joining. What would you like to download before joining?
translation: Dizze wrâld hat Behavior Packs tapast dy't jo downloade moatte om oan te sluten en Resource Packs dy't jo opsjoneel downloade kinne foardat jo oansluten. Wat wolst jo downloade foardat jo oansluten?

source_string: This world has Behavior and Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dizze wrâld hat Behavior- en Resource Packs tapast dy't jo downloade moatte om oan te sluten. Wolst jo se downloade en oansluten?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Dizze wrâld hat Resource Packs tapast. Wolst jo se downloade foardat jo oansluten?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dizze wrâld hat Resource Packs tapast dy't jo downloade moatte om oan te sluten. Wolst jo se downloade en oansluten?

source_string: Adding or removing Behavior Packs after playing a world might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: It tafoegjen of fuortsmiten fan Behavior Packs nei it spyljen fan in wrâld kin de wrâld brekke en derfoar soargje dat jo ferlieze wat jo makke hawwe.

source_string: Removing Behavior Packs with a plugin might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: It fuortsmiten fan Behavior Packs mei in plugin kin de wrâld brekke en derfoar soargje dat jo ferlieze wat jo makke hawwe.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Dizze resolúsje is net kompatibel mei jo apparaat om't jo apparaat net genôch ûnthâld hat.

source_string: This pack is incompatible with your device because it doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Dit pakket is net kompatibel mei jo apparaat om't it net genôch ûnthâld hat.

source_string: Unlock all %s Skins, Texture Pack, and World for %s:minecoin:
translation: Untskoattelje alle %s skins, teksturepakket, en wrâld foar %s:minecoin:

source_string: Tell the creator and the community about your experience with this item!
translation: Fertel de meitsjer en de mienskip oer jo ûnderfining mei dit item!

source_string: Before we can let you rate an item, you will need to sign in with Xbox Live.
translation: Foardat wy jo in item beoardielje litte kinne, moatte jo oanmelde mei Xbox Live.

source_string: Write a description of your structure.
translation: Skriuw in beskriuwing fan jo struktuer.

source_string: Your awesome creation has been uploaded to Remix3D.com using your Remix 3D profile. You can update your profile name and image on Remix3D.com anytime.
translation: Jo geweldige skepping is uploade nei Remix3D.com mei jo Remix 3D-profyl. Jo kinne jo profylnamme en ôfbylding op Remix3D.com op elk momint bywurkje.

source_string: New! Your Remix 3D profile is no longer linked to your Xbox Live gamertag. If you’ve already got a Remix 3D profile, we reserved your current gamertag as your name. If you’re new, we will autogenerate a Remix 3D profile for you. (You can edit it later on Remix3D.com.) Hit Agree to acknowledge this change and upload your creation to Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statements apply.
translation: Nij! Jo Remix 3D-profyl is net mear keppele oan jo Xbox Live-gamertag. As jo al in Remix 3D-profyl hawwe, hawwe wy jo aktuele gamertag reservearre as jo namme. As jo nij binne, sille wy in Remix 3D-profyl foar jo autogenerearje. (Jo kinne it letter bewurkje op Remix3D.com.) Druk op Iens om dizze feroaring te befêstigjen en jo skepping te uploaden nei Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services-oerienkomst en Privacyferklearingen jilde.

source_string: You must be signed in to Xbox Live to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Jo moatte oanmeld wêze by Xbox Live om te uploaden nei Remix3D.com.

source_string: Oh no! You don't have permission to join Remix3D.com.
translation: Och nee! Jo hawwe gjin tastimming om by Remix3D.com oan te sluten.

source_string: Uh oh! Your model is too large. Please try uploading a smaller file.
translation: Hoppa! Jo model is te grut. Probearje in lytser bestân te uploaden.

source_string: Oops! Your model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Hoppa! Jo model koe net uploade wurde nei Remix3D.com.

source_string: Something went wrong. We weren't able to convert your world. You can send us your world later by going to your old world and pressing Y. Or send us your world now so we can investigate further.
translation: Der gie wat mis. Wy koenen jo wrâld net konvertearje. Jo kinne ús letter jo wrâld stjoere troch nei jo âlde wrâld te gean en Y te drukken. Of stjoer ús jo wrâld no sadat wy fierder ûndersykje kinne.
Mobs waarden minder gedraacht as ferwachte of misten

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Ik ferlear myn items, skeppingen, en/of spilerstatistiken

source_string: By hitting Agree, you are uploading your world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement apply.
translation: Troch op Iens te drukken, uploade jo jo wrâld nei it Minecraft-team. De Microsoft Services-oerienkomst en Privacyferklearing jilde.

source_string: By uploading your World you hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute and publicly display your World in support of transferring your World to Minecraft.
translation: Troch jo wrâld te uploaden autorisearje jo hjirmei Microsoft om jo wrâld te testen, reproduseren, oanpassen, distribuearjen en iepenbier te toanen ta stipe fan it oerdragen fan jo wrâld nei Minecraft.

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Tank jo! Wy binne drok dwaande mei it opknappen fan dingen en sille net weromkomme oer dizze spesifike wrâld. Hjir is jo befêstiging dy't befêstiget dat wy it krigen hawwe:

source_string: It appears you don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure you have downloaded and installed Minecraft from the store
translation: It liket derop dat jo gjin lisinsje foar Minecraft hawwe. Wês wis datsto Minecraft downloade en ynstallearre hast fan de winkel

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: As jo dit ikoan sjogge, bewarje wy jo spul. Skeakel jo Nintendo Switch net út wylst dit ikoan op it skerm is.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Xbox Live is oankommen yn Minecraft! It is in spulmienskip foar telefoans, PC's, en Xbox. En it bêste diel?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Gjin Gamertag? Meitsje ien om prestaasjes te fertsjinjen, online mei freonen te spyljen en by Realms oan te sluten!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Gjin Gamertag? Meitsje ien om prestaasjes te fertsjinjen, online mei freonen te spyljen en by Realms oan te sluten!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: Wy hawwe besocht jo oan te melde by jo Xbox Live-akkount, mar der gie wat mis.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: As jo spylje sûnder oan te melden kinne jo jo freonenlist net sjen, gjin prestaasjes fertsjinje, net by Realms oansluten, of online spylje op Xbox Live.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: Prestaasjes en Gamerscore markearje jo foarútgong troch Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Meld oan by Xbox Live om se te begjinne fertsjinjen!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Foegje in freon ta om te sjen wannear se online binne en om online multiplayer te spyljen sûnder de rompslomp fan IP-adressen en poarten.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Meld oan by Xbox Live om te begjinnen mei it tafoegjen fan freonen!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Noegje jo freonen út om online multiplayer mei jo te spyljen sûnder de rompslomp fan IP-adres en poarten.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Meld oan by Xbox Live om te begjinnen mei it útnoegjen fan freonen!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Servers biede guon fan de meast kreative manieren om Minecraft te spyljen! Wy hawwe jo allinnich nedich om oan te melden sadat wy wis wêze kinne dat jo tastimming hawwe om online mei nije minsken te spyljen.

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Tank jo dat jo ús in kopy fan jo wrâld stjoerd hawwe en ús helpe bûgs te finen! Wy binne drok dwaande mei it opknappen fan dingen en sille net weromkomme oer dizze spesifike wrâld. Hjir is jo befêstiging dy't befêstiget dat wy it krigen hawwe: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Hoppa! Wy koenen jo wrâld net ûntfange. Probearje jo ynternetferbining te kontrolearjen of it letter opnij te stjoeren.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: Seach of wurke jo âlde wrâld net sa as it moatte soe? Stjoer ús jo wrâld en helpe ús de bûgs te finen!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Jo kinne it uterlik fan jo karakter feroarje mei in Skinpakket fan de Winkel. Selektearje 'Winkel' op it Haadmenu om te sjen wat beskikber is.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Izeren golems sille foar jo fjochtsje!

source_string: Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Feroarje de helderheidsynstelling om it spul ljochter of donkerder te meitsjen.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: As jo de muoilikheidsgraad ynstelle op Freedsum, sil jo sûnens automatysk regenerearje, en komme der gjin monsters út nachts!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Fied in bonke oan in wolf om it te tammen. Jo kinne it dan sitte litte of jo folgje litte.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: It drage fan in pompoen op jo kop hâldt Endermen der fan om jo oan te fallen.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Sliepe yn in bêd nachts sil it spul foarút spyljen nei de dei, mar alle spilers yn in multiplayerspul moatte tagelyk yn bêden sliepe.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Sammel iten fan bargen, kij, skiep, konijnen, en hinnen. Kookje en it iten om sûnens werom te krijen!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sammel lear fan kij, en brûk it om bewâpening en boeken te meitsjen.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: As jo in lege bûtse hawwe, kinne jo it folje mei wetter, lava, of molke fan in kou!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Brûk in skoffel om gebieten fan grûn foar te bereiden foar it planten.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Spinnen falle jo net oan by dei - útsein as jo se oanfalle.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: It fieden fan in bist hâldt it fan despawnen. Bou in hokje om jo bisten feilich te hâlden.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: It iten fan kookt iten fermindert honger better as it iten fan rau iten.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Nifelje fakkels om donkere gebieten te ferljochtsje. Monsters loerje yn it tsjuster!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Kom flugger op bestimmingen mei in mynkart en rails!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant wat siedlingen en se sille groeie yn beammen.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Pigmen falle jo net oan - útsein as jo se oanfalle.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Jo kinne jo spul-spawnpunt feroarje, en oerslaan nei dei troch te sliepen yn in bêd.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Slaan dy fjoerbollen werom nei de Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: It bouwen fan in portaal lit jo reizigje nei in oare diminsje - de Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Brûk it goede ark foar it wurk! It dolven fan grûn mei in spa is folle flugger as it brûken fan in mynkeel!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: As jo gjin koal fine kinne foar jo fakkels, kinne jo altyd houtskoal meitsje fan beammen yn in ofûne.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Rjocht nei ûnder of rjocht nei boppe dolven is gjin goed idee.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Bonemeel (nifele fan in skelletonbonke) kin brûkt wurde as keunstmis en kin dingen daliks groeie litte!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Creepers eksplodearje as se tichtby jo komme!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidiaan wurdt makke as wetter in lavaboarneblok raakt.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: As it boarneblok foar wetter of lava fuortsmiten wurdt, sil it de stream folslein stopje.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Klapstien is wjerstannich foar Ghast-fjoerbollen, wêrtroch it nuttich is foar it bewâkjen fan portalen.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Blokken dy't brûkt wurde kinne as ljochtboarne sille snie en iis smelte. Dit omfettet fakkels, glowstones, en jack-o-lanterns.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Wês foarsichtich by it bouwen fan struktueren fan wol yn de iepen romte, om't ûngelok fan tongerbuien wol yn brân kin stelle.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: In inkelde bûtse lava kin brûkt wurde yn in ofûne om 100 blokken te smelten.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: It ynstrumint spile troch in noateblok hinget ôf fan it materiaal derûnder.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombies en skelletons kinne deilicht oerlibje as se yn wetter binne of in helm drage.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: It oanfallen fan in wolf sil oare wolven yn de direkte omjouwing fijannich meitsje en jo oanfalle. Dizze trekk wurdt ek dield troch zombie pigmen.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Wolven en izeren golems sille creepers net oanfalle.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hinnen lizze in aai elke 5 oant 10 minuten.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidiaan kin allinnich dolven wurde mei in diamanten mynkeel.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers binne de makliktst te krijen boarne fan bússkrûd.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: It pleatsen fan twa kisten neist elkoar makket ien grutte kist.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Tammene wolven toane har sûnens mei de posysje fan har sturt. Fied har fleis om se te genêzen.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Ferskillende kleuren kleurstoffen kinne makke wurde fan in ferskaat oan materialen, kookje kaktus yn in ofûne om griene kleurstof te krijen!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Op mobile apparaten kinne jo it "Music by Minecraft"-pakket downloade fan de Muzykkategorie yn de Minecraft-winkel.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Guon bisten sille jo folgje as jo weet yn jo hân hawwe.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Der komt eventueel in fernijing foar dit spul!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mojang hat mear prizen as personiel!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
translation: Sjoch net direkt nei de bugs.

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
translation: Is it in hin of is it in ein?

source_string: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: Nimmen by Mojang hat ea it gesicht fan Junkboy sjoen.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Wisto dat der in Minecraft Wiki is?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: MINECON 2011 wie yn Las Vegas, Nevada, VS!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: MINECON 2013 wie yn Orlando, Florida, VS!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: Nimmen kin him herinnerje wêr't MINECON 2014 wie.

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: MINECON 2016 wie yn Anaheim, Kalifornje, VS!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Gean der altyd fan út dat rûzjes net wier binne, ynstee fan derfan út te gean dat se wol wier binne!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: De earste ferzje fan Minecraft waard makke yn mar 6 dagen!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: De taal fan de Enderman is eigentlik Ingelsk efterstefoaren.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: De oarspronklike namme foar Minecraft wie Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: Bargen dy't troch de wjerljocht rekke wurde, wurde Zombie Pigmen!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Somtiden jouwe izergolems blommen oan de bernen fan doarpsbewenners!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: In Spider Jockey is it seldsume ferskynsel fan in spin dy't riden wurdt troch in skelet!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Ien blok reizigje yn de Nether is lykweardich oan acht blokken reizigje yn de Overworld.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Do hasto in Agent noadich om te koadearjen! Krij in Agent-aai út dyn Creative-ynventaris.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Meld dy oan by Xbox Live om dyn skins, texture packs, wrâlden en mash-ups te syngronisearjen. Se sille foar dy klearlizze op elts apparaat wêrop't do Minecraft spilest.

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Oankeapen wurde syngronisearre mei it Xbox Live-akkount...

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dit Xbox Live-akkount sil net it haadakkount foar dit apparaat wurde as do de oankeapen fan dit apparaat net mei dit akkount syngronisearrest. Do silst net automatysk oanmeld wurde as do Minecraft start.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: Dyn oankeapen yn de app store binne beskikber wêr't do ek mei %s oanmeldst. Do kinst dizze packs mar op ien akkount syngronisearje, mar se bliuwe beskikber foar elkenien dy't dit apparaat brûkt.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Is dit it akkount dat do brûke wolst om tagong te krijen ta dyn eardere oankeapen?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Do kinst dyn Realm no net útwreidzje. Wy hawwe no abonneminten foar Realms op Xbox yntrodusearre en do kinst in nij abonnemint keapje sa gau as dyn Realm binnen %d dagen ferrûn is. Mar gjin noed! Wy jouwe dy 14 ekstra dagen fergees en dyn Realm bliuwt online, sadat do genôch tiid hast om it dan te ferlingjen.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition hat ferskate spesjale blokken dy't it makliker meitsje foar dosinten om lessen te meitsjen en te brûken. World Builder-fermogen negearret de beheiningen fan dizze blokken.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: Tastean- en ferbiede-blokken rjochtsje har op wêr't spilers yn in wrâld bouwe kinne.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: Tastean-blokken litte spilers blokken pleatse of ferwoastje yn it gebiet derboppe.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: Ferbiede-blokken ferhinderje brûkers om blokken te pleatsen of te ferwoastjen yn it gebiet derboppe.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Gjin fan beide blokken beynfloedet it gebiet derûnder.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: As in tastean-blok earne pleatst wurdt mei in ferbiede-blok derûnder, wurdt de romte tusken de twa blokken beskerme, wylst de romte boppe it tastean-blok brûkers talit om blokken te pleatsen en te ferwoastjen.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: Grinsblokken binne heldere, reade muorren dy't as in krêftfjild wurkje, en foar altyd omheech en omleech útwreidzje!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.
translation: Grinsblokken foarkomme dat spilers derdroch, deroer, of deronder gean, útsein as se in World Builder binne.

source_string: Border blocks cannot be destroyed by non-World Builders.
translation: Grinsblokken kinne net troch net-World Builders ferwoastge wurde.

source_string: Structure blocks save existing structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported for later use.
translation: Struktuerblokken bewarje besteande struktueren, sadat se op in oare plak laden wurde kinne of sels eksportearre wurde kinne foar letter gebrûk.

source_string: NPCs display their dialog text when interacted with by non-World Builders.
translation: NPC's litte har dialooktekst sjen as se ynteraksje hawwe mei net-World Builders.

source_string: NPCs can also launch external URLs or execute commands automatically on closing their dialog box, or by assigning actions to buttons for players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) are executed in the order they are added to the NPC.
translation: NPC's kinne ek eksterne URL's iepenje of kommando's automatysk útfiere by it sluten fan har dialoochfinster, of troch aksjes oan te wizen oan knoppen wêrmei't spilers ynteraksje hawwe kinne. Alle automatyske kommando's (en URL's) wurde útfierd yn de folchoarder wêryn't se tafoege binne oan de NPC.

source_string: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".
translation: Ienris pleatst, sjoch de kamera oan en druk op de knop op it skerm mei it lebel "Foto meitsje".

source_string: The Camera will track you during this time, doing its best to keep you in the shot, even if you move around.
translation: De kamera folget dy yn dizze tiid en docht syn bêst om dy yn byld te hâlden, sels as do beweegst.

source_string: After the five second timer counts down, your picture is taken.
translation: Nei't de fiif sekonden ôfteld binne, wurdt dyn foto makke.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book using the Book & Quill.
translation: Foto's kinne besjoen wurde yn it Portfolio of ynfoege wurde yn in boek mei it Boek & Pin.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's byskriften jaan troch op :mouse_left_button: te drukken op it byskrift-lebel.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by selecting the caption label and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's byskriften jaan troch it byskrift-lebel te selektearjen en op :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drukken.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by tapping the caption label.
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's byskriften jaan troch op it byskrift-lebel te tikken.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's fuortsmite troch op :mouse_left_button: te drukken op it jiskefetsymboal ûnder de foto.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by selecting the trash icon below the picture and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's fuortsmite troch it jiskefetsymboal ûnder de foto te selektearjen en op :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drukken.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by tapping the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Do kinst dyn foto's fuortsmite troch op it jiskefetsymboal ûnder de foto te tikken.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Do kinst dyn Portfolio eksportearje as in searje ôfbyldingen troch op :mouse_left_button: te drukken op de Portfolio-eksportknop.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by selecting the Export Portfolio button and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Do kinst dyn Portfolio eksportearje as in searje ôfbyldingen troch de Portfolio-eksportknop te selektearjen en op :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drukken.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by tapping the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Do kinst dyn Portfolio eksportearje as in searje ôfbyldingen troch op de Portfolio-eksportknop te tikken.

source_string: Code Connection is an extension that allows educators and students to explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writing code!
translation: Code Connection is in útwreiding dy't dosinten en learlingen de kâns jout om te ferkennen, meitsje en spylje yn in ymmersive Minecraft-wrâld... allegearre troch koade te skriuwen!

source_string: You can launch Code Connection using the command "/code" to get started.
translation: Do kinst Code Connection starte mei it kommando "/code" om te begjinnen.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing the :touch_jump: button. If you want to travel downward you can press the :touch_fly_down: button.
translation: Steger kin dy helpe om grutte struktueren feilich te bouwen! Do kinst yn de steger rinne en derop stean. As do in kolom fan steger hast, kinst omheech gean troch yn de steger te stean en op de :touch_jump:-knop te drukken. As do omleech reizigje wolst, kinst op de :touch_fly_down:-knop drukken.

source_string: We're unable to connect to the library. Maybe check your internet connection?
translation: Wy kinne net ferbine mei de biblioteek. Kontrolearje asjebleaze dyn ynternetferbining?

source_string: This will save and quit your current game and any multiplayer connections, are you sure you want to quit?
translation: Dit bewarret en ferlit dyn hjoeddeistige spul en alle multyspiler-ferbiningen, bisto der wis fan datst ferlitte wolst?

source_string: Sorry, we weren't able to find that item in the Library.
translation: Sorry, wy koene dat item net fine yn de Biblioteek.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft: Education Edition Library!
translation: Wolkom by de Minecraft: Education Edition Biblioteek!

source_string: The Library is a new feature we've created to make it easy for teachers and students to find and import educational content directly in the game. In this release, you'll find a list of some of our most popular worlds to import and use, along with a link to the full world library on our website.
translation: De Biblioteek is in nije funksje dy't wy makke hawwe om it makliker te meitsjen foar dosinten en learlingen om edukative ynhâld direkt yn it spul te finen en te ymportearjen. Yn dizze release fynst in list fan guon fan ús populêrste wrâlden om te ymportearjen en te brûken, tegearre mei in keppeling nei de folsleine wrâldbiblioteek op ús website.

source_string: We're working on adding support for more types of content and functionality in the coming months. Please let us know what you think by clicking the feedback button.
translation: Wy wurkje oan it tafoegjen fan stipe foar mear soarten ynhâld en funksjonaliteit yn de kommende moannen. Lit ús asjebleaze witte wat do derfan tinkst troch op de feedbackknop te klikken.

source_string: Preparing to import new world. This could take a few minutes.
translation: Tariedzje om nije wrâld te ymportearjen. Dit kin in pear minuten duorje.

source_string: with field in rawtext must contain a array. Example: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]
translation: it "with"-fjild yn rawtext moat in array befetsje. Foarbyld: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]

source_string: The world you are trying to enter requires your device to run scripts.  Your device doesn't support scripting at this time, so you can't join from this device.
translation: De wrâld dêr'tsto besikest te gean easket dat dyn apparaat scripts útfiere kin. Dyn apparaat stipet no gjin scripting, dus do kinst net fanôf dit apparaat meidwaan.

source_string: Press W, A, S, or D to move
translation: Druk op W, A, S, of D om te bewegen
Druk op de spaasjebalke om te springen

source_string: Tap the right button to jump
translation: Tik op de rjochterknop om te springen
Druk op A om te springen

source_string: Press W and space at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Druk tegearre op W en spaasje om op in blok te springen

source_string: Touch the up arrow and the right button at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Rekje de omheech-pylk en de rjochterknop tegearre oan om op in blok te springen

source_string: Move the left stick up and press A at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Beweeg de linker joystick omheech en druk gelyktiid op A om op in blok te springen

source_string: Find a tree to gather wood
translation: Fyn in beam om hout te sammeljen

source_string: Left click and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Lofterklik en hâld om 3 stikken hout te sammeljen

source_string: Tap and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Tik en hâld om 3 stikken hout te sammeljen

source_string: Hold down right trigger to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Hâld de rjochtertrigger yn om 3 stikken hout te sammeljen

source_string: Have an idea to improve Minecraft? Find a bug that you want fixed? Or encounter an issue you need help with?  Let us know!
translation: Hast in idee om Minecraft te ferbetterjen? In bug fûn dysto fikst wolst hawwe? Of in probleem dêr'tsto help by nedich hast? Lit it ús witte!

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb
translation: Besykje dizze website op in oar apparaat. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/mcbugs
translation: Besykje dizze website op in oar apparaat. https://aka.ms/mcbugs

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/helpMC
translation: Besykje dizze website op in oar apparaat. https://aka.ms/helpMC

source_string: The world you are about to enter contains scripts that run on your device. Would you like to join this world?
translation: De wrâld dêr'tsto op it punt bist om yn te gean befettet scripts dy't op dyn apparaat útfierd wurde. Wolsto dizze wrâld meidwaan?

source_string: Gold is more abundant in Mesa biomes!
translation: Goud is riker fertsjinwurdige yn Mesa-biomen!

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorite, do hâldst der fan of hast der de nekke fan fol.
Sprint yn wetter om te swimmen!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: De Meistreamje-fertoverje stjut dy troch de loft yn de rein.

source_string: MINECON Earth is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
translation: MINECON Earth is in wrâldwiid ynteraktyf live-streamevenemint. Pak dyn items en dwaan mei oan it feest!

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
translation: De Beacon is in machtich item dat allinnich makke wurde kin mei in netherstjer fan de Wither!
Doch gjin dolfinen deamakke, do monster!

source_string: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
translation: Wisto dat netherstjerren net troch explosjes ferwoastge wurde kinne?

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: As do rjocht omheech grave, pleats in fakkel by dyn fuotten om sân of gravel te brekken dat op dy fallen kin.

source_string: Attempts to connect to the websocket server to send a video stream.
translation: Besiket te ferbinen mei de websocket-server om in fideostream te ferstjoeren.

source_string: Walk over items to pick them up
translation: Rin oer items om se op te pakken

source_string: Press E to open your inventory
translation: Druk op E om dyn ynventaris te iepenjen

source_string: Tap the ... button to open your inventory
translation: Tik op de ...-knop om dyn ynventaris te iepenjen

source_string: Press Y to open your inventory
translation: Druk op Y om dyn ynventaris te iepenjen

source_string: Left click to select the wood, then left click in the crafting grid
translation: Lofterklik om it hout te selektearjen, klik dan lofts yn it makkerij

source_string: Tap to select the wood, then tap in the crafting grid
