source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription to Realms Plus ends?
translation: Wat bart der mei myn Realms en wrâlden as myn abonnemint op Realms Plus einiget?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to the packs or cloud storage. You will be able to purchase and download any world templates saved to your Realm and cloud storage within 18 months of ending your subscription unless they are no longer offered by Minecraft. If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups, you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.
translation: As dyn abonnemint einiget, kinne do en dyn freonen net mear tegearre online spylje op Realms, en hast do gjin tagong mear ta de packs of de cloudopslach. Do kinst alle wrâldsjablonen dy't bewarre binne op dyn Realm en cloudopslach keapje en ynladen binnen 18 moannen nei it einigjen fan dyn abonnemint, útsein as se net mear oanbean wurde troch Minecraft. As do Realms Plus-wrâlden, texture packs, of mash-ups brûkt hast, moatsto dy packs yn de store keapje of, as dizze packs noch yn Realms Plus binne, dy op 'e nij abonnearre om dy wrâldsjablonen te spyljen.

source_string: How many world templates can I play with Realms Plus?
translation: Hoefolle wrâldsjablonen kin ik spylje mei Realms Plus?

source_string: You can play and save ALL the packs included in the Realms Plus on your local device.  As well, you can host one of your world templates on a Realm for your friends to play with you for free!  You can change which world you load on your Realm anytime.
translation: Do kinst ALLE packs dy't yn Realms Plus opnaam binne, spylje en bewarje op dyn lokale apparaat. Ek kinst ien fan dyn wrâldsjablonen hoste op in Realm sadatst dyn freonen fergees mei dy spylje litte kinst! Do kinst op elts momint wikselje hokker wrâld do laadst op dyn Realm.

source_string: If you're holding an item, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it. Tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to eat a food item you're holding.
translation: As do in item fêsthâldst, tik op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: om dat item te brûken of rekje it item yn dyn hotbar oan en hâld it in om it fallen te litten. Tik en hâld :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: om iten dat do fêsthâldst te iten.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.
translation: Slûpen foarkomt dat do fan blokken ôffalst, ferstoppet dy foar mobs, en ferstoppet dyn nammelabel foar oare spilers. Om te slûpen, tik\u00A0:tip_virtual_button_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Slûpen foarkomt dat do fan blokken ôffalst, ferstoppet dy foar mobs, en ferstoppet dyn nammelabel foar oare spilers. Om te slûpen, tik\u00A0:touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.
translation: Slûpen foarkomt dat do fan blokken ôffalst, ferstoppet dy foar mobs, en ferstoppet dyn nammelabel foar oare spilers. Om te slûpen, tik\u00A0:tip_virtual_button_sneak:.

source_string: If you lose health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will automatically replenish. Eating food will also replenish your :shank:.
translation: As do sûnens ferliesst mar op syn minst njoggen :shank: hast, sil dyn sûnens automatysk oanfolle wurde. It iten fan iten sil ek oanfolling jaan oan dyn :shank:.

source_string: Your health will automatically replenish if you have at least nine :shank:. Your :shank: will slowly decrease as you explore and get hungry, but eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Dyn sûnens sil automatysk oanfolle wurde as do op syn minst njoggen :shank: hast. Dyn :shank: sil stadichoan ôfnimme wylst do ferkennest en honger krijst, mar it iten fan iten sil oanfolling jaan oan dyn :shank:.

source_string: To eat something, tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold the screen to eat.
translation: Om wat te iten, tik op it iteneftich yn dyn hotbar, en tik en hâld it skerm om te iten.

source_string: If you use Action Buttons, first tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to eat it.
translation: As do Aksjeknoppen brûkst, tik earst op it iteneftich yn dyn hotbar, en tik en hâld dan :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: om it te iten.

source_string: Certain activities will make you more hungry faster, like sprinting. Fortunately, some foods are more nourishing and will fill up more :shank:.
translation: Bepaalde aktiviteiten meitsje dy flugger honger, lykas sprinte. Lokkigernôch binne guon soarten iten fiediger en foltsje se mear :shank:.

source_string: If you have full :shank:, the last food you ate will apply a saturation value - a hidden value that gives an extra boost to your hunger level.
translation: As do folle :shank: hast, jout it lêste iten dat do gietten hast in fersadigingswearde - in ferburgen wearde dy't dyn hongerpeil in ekstra boost jout.

source_string: If you tap on a stack of items, you'll automatically select all items in the stack. You can move the stack the same way you would a single item.
translation: As do op in stapel items tikst, selektearrest do automatysk alle items yn de stapel. Do kinst de stapel op deselde wize ferpleatse as in inkeld item.

source_string: To split a stack of items, tap and hold on the item stack until the selection slider appears. Without releasing the screen, slide your finger left and right to select the number of items you want to remove from the stack.
translation: Om in stapel items te splitsen, tik en hâld op de itemstapel oant de selektearskúf ferskynt. Sûnder it skerm los te litten, sleep dyn finger nei lofts en rjochts om it oantal items te selektearjen datst fan de stapel fuortsmite wolst.

source_string: For more information, please visit https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting in any web browser.
translation: Foar mear ynformaasje, besykje asjebleaze https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting yn elke webbrowser.

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end in your area. After you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access your Marketplace purchases, but you will no longer be able to make purchases in the Marketplace. Realms managed from this device will continue to work for 6 months. On Sept. 30th, 2023 you will no longer have access to the realm. It is recommended you download your world prior to this and cancel your subscription by viewing your Subscriptions settings on your device. %sIf you have signed in with a Microsoft/Xbox Live account, your Marketplace purchases & Minecoins and your Realms subscription will be available on other platforms. If you would like to move your worlds from this device to another device, you can do so by uploading the world to a Realm, and downloading a backup onto your new device. %sClick on the button for more information, including ways to move your world to a new device.

Realms behearre fan dit apparaat bliuwe wurkjen foar 6 moannen. Op 30 sept. 2023 hast do gjin tagong mear ta de realm. It is oanret om dyn wrâld hjirfoar te downloaden en dyn abonnemint te annulearje troch dyn Abonneminten-ynstellingen op dyn apparaat te besjen. %sAs do oanmeld hast mei in Microsoft/Xbox Live-akkount, sille dyn Marketplace-oankeapen & Minecoins en dyn Realms-abonnemint beskikber wêze op oare platforms. As do dyn wrâlden fan dit apparaat nei in oar apparaat ferpleatse wolst, kinst dat dwaan troch de wrâld op te laden nei in Realm, en in reservekopy nei dyn nije apparaat te downloaden. %sKlik op de knop foar mear ynformaasje, ynklusyf manieren om dyn wrâld nei in nij apparaat te ferpleatsen.

source_string: Looks like you've been busy reporting other players. Thank you for helping us make Minecraft a safe and welcoming place. Keep in mind, filing false reports is against our Community Standards.
translation: It liket derop dat do drok bezich west hast mei it melden fan oare spilers. Tank foar it helpen om Minecraft in feilich en freonlik plak te meitsjen. Hâld yn gedachten dat falske meldingen tsjin ús Community Standards binne.

source_string: %s is a friend of yours. Are you sure you want to report them? Filing false reports is against our Community Standards.
translation: %s is in freon fan dy. Bisto der wis fan datst him/har melden wolst? It ynsjenden fan falske meldingen is tsjin ús Community Standards.

source_string: Need more smithing templates? Try to copy them.
translation: Mear smidssjablonen nedich? Probearje se te kopiearjen.

source_string: The sniffer egg seems to like moss blocks.
translation: It snuffelder-aai liket wol fan mosblokken te hâlden.

source_string: Mob heads make sounds, try them out on note blocks!
translation: Mob-koppen meitsje lûden, probearje se út op noteblokken!

source_string: Some sand might be suspicious. Use your brush on it to find some good stuff!
translation: Guon sân kin fertocht wêze. Brûk dyn boarstel derop om guon goede spullen te finen!

source_string: Two players can ride together on a camel.
translation: Twa spilers kinne tegearre op in kameel riden.

source_string: §4You have been sent a warning. Your behavior may be found offensive by other players. Please be mindful of others you are playing with.
translation: §4Do hast in warskôging krige. Dyn gedrach kin troch oare spilers as offensyf beskôge wurde. Wês asjebleaze rekkenskiplik mei oaren wêr'tst mei spilest.

source_string: Minecraft is for everyone! Please be sure to conduct yourself according to our community standards.
translation: Minecraft is foar elkenien! Wês asjebleaze wis datst dysels neffens ús community standards fielst.

translation: Koe spiler net fine. Selektearje asjebleaze in jildige spiler.

translation: Do kinst de marketplace net brûke oant dyn opskoarsing ferrint.

translation: It útskeakeljen fan dizze opsje kin FPS ferheegje, mar kin skermskuring feroarsaakje

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end. To cancel your realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created from. You will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information, including ways to move your world to a new device.
translation: Us fermogen om dit apparaat te stypjen komt ta in ein. Realms behearre fan dit apparaat bliuwe wurkjen foar 6 moannen, útsein as se troch de Realm-eigner bywurke wurde op in oar apparaat. Om dyn realm-abonnemint te annulearjen, moatsto dat dwaan yn it Ynstellingenmenu foar Abonneminten op it apparaat wêrfan't de Realm makke is. Do krijst gjin nijste updates mear en kinst net mear multyspiler spylje mei apparaten of Realms dy't noch updates krije. Do kinst ek net ferbine mei bepaalde servers.%sKlik op de knop foar mear ynformaasje, ynklusyf manieren om dyn wrâld nei in nij apparaat te ferpleatsen.

translation: Hege konsintraasjes fan chlorofyl produsearje griene kleuren, om't chlorofyl blauwe en reade weachlingten sterk absorbearret

source_string: High concentrations of suspended sediment produces red to red-brown colors, due to suspended sediment strongly absorbing blue and green wavelengths

source_string: Frame Length The number of seconds to spend on a single frame of animation in the caustics sprite sheet texture. A larger value will result in a slower animation, while smaller values will result in a faster animation

source_string: Controls the size of the caustics texture when it is projected on the world. source_string: Determines how many waves there are per water block. Larger values will create more tightly packed waves, whereas smaller values will spread waves out over a wider area

source_string: Determines how many different layers of waves to simulate. Larger values will produce more complex waves

source_string: Determines how much waves displace the water surface. Larger values will result in deeper waves, whereas smaller values will produce shallower waves

The Aligned joint type ensures that the white bars on the Jigsaw blocks are always aligned when placed.  Joint type is only valid when the Jigsaw is facing up or down.

source_string: Color Grading allows for the customization of the final image by giving control over saturation, contrast, gain, and offset of pixels per RGB channel along with highlights and shadows.
translation: Kleurgradaasje makket it mooglik om de einlike ôfbylding oan te passen troch kontrôle te jaan oer sêding, kontrast, fersterking en ferskowing fan piksels per RGB-kanaal, tegearre mei ljochtpunten en skaden.

source_string: Midtones are settings allowing for control over saturation, contrast, gain, and offset of pixels per RGB channel.
translation: Middentoanen binne ynstellingen dy't kontrôle jouwe oer sêding, kontrast, fersterking en ferskowing fan piksels per RGB-kanaal.

source_string: Contrast describes the difference in luminance between the bright and dark pixels in an image.
translation: Kontrast beskriuwt it ferskil yn ljochtsterkte tusken de ljochte en donkere piksels yn in ôfbylding.

source_string: Gain is a multiplication factor applied to each color channel to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image.
translation: Fersterking is in fermannichfâldigingsfaktor dy't tapast wurdt op elk kleurkanaal om de algemiene ljochtsterkte-yntensiteit fan de ôfbylding oan te passen.

source_string: Gamma is an exponential factor applied to the final color after both color grading and tone mapping to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image.
translation: Gamma is in eksponinsjele faktor dy't tapast wurdt op de einlike kleur nei sawol kleurgradaasje as toanmapping, om de algemiene ljochtsterkte-yntensiteit fan de ôfbylding oan te passen.

source_string: Offset is an additive factor that is multiplied by the average luminance of the scene and then added to a given color channel to adjust the overall luminance intensity of the image.
translation: Ferskowing is in additive faktor dy't fermannichfâldige wurdt mei de trochsneed ljochtsterkte fan de sêne en dêrnei tafoege wurdt oan in bepaald kleurkanaal, om de algemiene ljochtsterkte-yntensiteit fan de ôfbylding oan te passen.

source_string: Saturation determines the hue intensity of colors.
translation: Sêding bepaalt de yntensiteit fan de kleurtoan fan kleuren.

source_string: Custom Mesh Tool - Import a 3d model in the .STL format, preview it in the world, and convert it into blocks.
translation: Oanpaste Mesh-ark - Ymportearje in 3D-model yn it .STL-formaat, besjoch it yn de wrâld, en set it om yn blokken.

source_string: Custom Dimensions - Add custom void dimensions to your world. New dimensions will appear in both the Custom Dimensions panel and the World/Dimensions menu.
translation: Oanpaste Dimensjes - Foegje oanpaste lege dimensjes ta oan jo wrâld. Nije dimensjes komme sichtber yn sawol it paneel Oanpaste Dimensjes as it menu Wrâld/Dimensjes.

source_string: Biome Data Assignment - Assign biome metadata to a selection, including within Custom Dimensions. This affects systems like weather, spawning rules, and Vibrant Visuals but does not place or alter blocks.
translation: Biotoopgegevenstawizing - Wiis biotoop-metadata ta oan in seleksje, ek binnen Oanpaste Dimensjes. Dit hat ynfloed op systemen lykas waar, spawnregels en Vibrant Visuals, mar plakket of feroaret gjin blokken.

source_string: Vibrant Visuals: Biome Config Mapping - Easily mix and match Vibrant Visual settings across multiple biomes using the new config mapping window. Find it in the Vibrant Visuals panel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]
translation: Vibrant Visuals: Biotoopkonfiguraasje-yndieling - Miks en pas Vibrant Visuals-ynstellingen maklik oan oer meardere biotopen mei it nije konfiguraasje-yndielingsfinster. Jo fine it yn it Vibrant Visuals-paneel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]

source_string: Cursor improvements - We've added contextual cursors to improve feedback. You should now see a "loading" icon when you're blocked from taking action by something that requires processing time, such as chunk regeneration or placing a very large primitive shape.
translation: Cursorferbetteringen - Wy hawwe kontekstuele cursors tafoege om de feedback te ferbetterjen. Jo sjogge no in "laden"-ikoan as jo blokkearre wurde troch eat dat ferwurkingstiid fereasket, lykas chunk-regeneraasje of it delsetten fan in hiel grutte primitive foarm.

source_string: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" to choose a 3D mesh on your hard drive that you've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s You can move, rotate and scale the mesh preview in your world using the viewport widget and the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn your mesh into a shell of blocks using your active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh
translation: %s Brûk "Ymportearje Oanpaste Mesh" om in 3D-mesh op jo hurde skiif te kiezen dy't jo download of eksportearre hawwe út in modellearprogramma.%s Jo kinne it foarbyld fan de mesh yn jo wrâld ferpleatse, draaie en skalearje mei de viewport-widget en de skowers yn it arkpaneel.%s "Blokken delsette" set jo mesh om yn in skil fan blokken mei jo aktive hotbar-seleksje.%s "Annulearje" wisket de laden mesh

source_string: %s Add your own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list to visit it and start placing blocks. You can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.
translation: %s Foegje jo eigen Oanpaste Dimensjes ta mei de knop "Oanpaste Dimensje tafoegje".%s Dimensjenammen moatte in namespace befetsje, lykas "namespace:mydimension".%s Klik op elke dimensje yn de list om der hinne te gean en te begjinnen mei it delsetten fan blokken. Jo kinne se ek fine yn it menu Wrâld/Dimensjes.%s Oanpaste dimensjes kinne op it stuit net omneamd of wiske wurde.

source_string: %s Biome Data Assignment lets you assign a selection to the biome of your choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawning, Vibrant Visuals, and weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome to Assign" box, and use the "Assign Biome to Selection" to reassign data.
translation: %s Mei Biotoopgegevenstawizing kinne jo in seleksje tawize oan de biotoop fan jo kar.%s Dit foeget gjin blokken ta en feroaret se ek net, mar hat ynfloed op spulsystemen lykas begroeiingstint, mob-spawning, Vibrant Visuals en waar.%s Kies in biotoop yn it fak "Biotoop om ta te wizen", en brûk "Biotoop tawize oan seleksje" om gegevens opnij ta te wizen.

source_string: %s You'll be reassigning a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, you can use additional settings to determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up to world ceiling" and "Extend down to world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, including all blocks above or below your selection respectively.%s Masking your selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existing Biome boundaries to restrict the effect further. These settings will not extend data assignment beyond your selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list of available biomes and tags will be filtered to show only valid options within your existing selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" to see the full list.
translation: %s Jo sille in seleksje yn de wrâld opnij tawize. Binnen it paneel Biotoopgegevenstawizing kinne jo ekstra ynstellingen brûke om te bepalen hoe't de gegevenstawizing gearwurket mei dy seleksje.%s "Utwreidzje oant de wrâldplafond" en "Utwreidzje oant de wrâldflier" wreidzje it effekt út op de Y-as, ynklusyf alle blokken respektivelik boppe of ûnder jo seleksje.%s As jo jo seleksje maskearje mei Biotopen of Biotooptags, wurde de besteande biotoopgrinzen brûkt om it effekt fierder te beheinen. Dizze ynstellingen wreidzje de gegevenstawizing net út bûten jo seleksje, mar jouwe wol mear kontrôle.%s Standert wurdt de list mei beskikbere biotopen en tags filtere sadat allinnich jildige opsjes binnen jo besteande seleksje toand wurde. Skeakel "Allinnich biotopen/tags binnen de aktive seleksje toane" út om de folsleine list te sjen.

source_string: %s Any areas you've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows you the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X and Z), and the full height in Y, so you can determine whether the affected area extends to the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s to move your camera to that location.%s Use %s to change the assignment of that area to another biome.%s It is not currently possible to revert a reassigned area to the world's original state.
translation: %s Alle gebieten dy't jo al opnij tawiisd hawwe, wurde hjir list. Elk item lit de aktuele biotooptawizing fan de regio sjen, it rûge sintrum (yn X en Z), en de folsleine hichte yn Y, sadat jo bepale kinne oft it beynfloede gebiet oant de wrâldplafond of -flier rikt.%s Brûk %s om jo kamera nei dy lokaasje te ferpleatsen.%s Brûk %s om de tawizing fan dat gebiet te feroarjen nei in oare biotoop.%s It is op it stuit net mooglik om in opnij tawiisd gebiet te herstellen nei de oarspronklike steat fan de wrâld.

source_string: Controls the scattering of light through the atmosphere, affecting sky color, haze, and the appearance of the sun and moon.
translation: Bepaalt de fersprieding fan ljocht troch de sfear, wat de loftkleur, dize en it uterlik fan de sinne en moanne beynfloedet.

source_string: Adjusts the final image colors by controlling saturation, contrast, gain, and offset per RGB channel.
translation: Past de einlike ôfbyldingskleuren oan troch sêding, kontrast, fersterking en ferskowing per RGB-kanaal te kontrolearjen.

source_string: Configures the global lighting setup including sun, moon, and ambient light properties.
translation: Konfigurearret de globale ferlichtingsopset, ynklusyf eigenskippen fan sinne-, moanne- en omjouwingsljocht.

source_string: Controls water appearance including surface color, transparency, and reflections.
translation: Bepaalt it uterlik fan wetter, ynklusyf oerflaktekleur, transparânsje en reflekjes.

source_string: Specifies the skybox cubemap used for ambient sky color and reflections.
translation: Spesifisearret de skybox-kubuskaart dy't brûkt wurdt foar de omjouwingsloftkleur en reflekjes.

source_string: Import a 3D Mesh, preview it in the world, and convert it to blocks.
translation: Ymportearje in 3D-mesh, besjoch it yn de wrâld, en set it om yn blokken.

source_string: Choose a mesh to import. You'll be able to adjust it before converting it to blocks
translation: Kies in mesh om te ymportearjen. Jo kinne dizze oanpasse foardat jo it omsette yn blokken

source_string: Recreate your imported mesh as a shell of blocks. They will be created as a Paste Preview clipboard selection

source_string: Adjust the position, rotation and scale of the mesh preview. This will control block placement when you Place Blocks
translation: Pas de posisje, rotaasje en skaal fan it mesh-foarbyld oan. Dit bepaalt hoe't blokken delset wurde as jo Blokken delsette brûke

source_string: An unexpected error occurred during import.

translation: It roastervolume oerskrydt %1$s voxels. Ferminderje de skaal.

translation: It pleatsen fan blokken is al oan de gong.

translation: In oare mesh-pleatsing is al oan de gong.

translation: It roaster oerskrydt de limyt fan blokken per as. Ferminderje de skaal of pas de rotaasje oan.

translation: It roastervolume oerskrydt de voxellimyt. Ferminderje de skaal of pas de rotaasje oan.

source_string: The selected block type is invalid.
translation: It selektearre bloktype is net jildich.

source_string: Placement parameters are out of range. Adjust position or scale and try again.
translation: De pleatsingsparameters lizze bûten berik. Pas de posysje of skaal oan en probearje it opnij.

source_string: Voxelization produced no blocks. Try increasing the scale.
translation: Voxelisaasje hat gjin blokken oplevere. Probearje de skaal te fergrutsjen.

source_string: Mesh placement failed - no active transaction.
translation: It pleatsen fan de mesh is mislearre - gjin aktive transaksje.

source_string: Mesh placement failed - player is unavailable.
translation: It pleatsen fan de mesh is mislearre - spiler net beskikber.

source_string: Voxelization timed out. Reduce scale or mesh complexity and try again.
translation: Voxelisaasje rûn fêst troch tiidslimyt. Ferminderje de skaal of de kompleksiteit fan de mesh en probearje it opnij.
It pleatsen fan de mesh is ûnferwachte mislearre.

source_string: Overwrite the biome assignment of a selection. This does not change the blocks currently present, but affects mob spawning, weather, Vibrant Visuals, and other per-biome systems.
translation: Oerskriuw de biome-tawizing fan in seleksje. Dit feroaret de blokken dy't no oanwêzich binne net, mar hat wol effekt op it spawnjen fan mobs, waar, Vibrant Visuals, en oare per-biome-systemen.

source_string: Choose which biome's data to use.
translation: Kies hokker biome-gegevens brûkt wurde moatte.

source_string: Also assign biome data to all blocks above the selection.
translation: Wiis ek biome-gegevens ta oan alle blokken boppe de seleksje.

source_string: Also assign biome data to all blocks below the selection.
translation: Wiis ek biome-gegevens ta oan alle blokken ûnder de seleksje.

source_string: Include or exclude parts of your selection based on existing biome boundaries.
translation: Nim parten fan dyn seleksje mei of slút se út, basearre op besteande biome-grinzen.

source_string: Create a list of biomes and choose how they affect the final data assignment
translation: Meitsje in list fan biomes en kies hoe't se de definitive gegevenstawizing beynfloedzje

source_string: Restrict data assignment to only the listed biomes, or exclude the listed biomes from data assignment.
translation: Beheine de gegevenstawizing ta allinnich de neamde biomes, of slút de neamde biomes út fan de gegevenstawizing.

source_string: Only show biomes within active selection
translation: Toan allinnich biomes binnen de aktive seleksje

source_string: When checked, the "Add Biome" list will only show biomes that are present in your current selection.
translation: As dit oanfinke is, toant de list "Biome tafoegje" allinnich biomes dy't oanwêzich binne yn dyn hjoeddeiske seleksje.

source_string: Specify biome tags to include in or exclude from the final data assignment. For more info about biome tags, see https://minecraft.wiki/w/Biome_tag_%28Bedrock_Edition%29
translation: Jou biome-tags op om mei te nimmen yn of út te sluten fan de definitive gegevenstawizing. Foar mear ynfo oer biome-tags, sjoch https://minecraft.wiki/w/Biome_tag_%28Bedrock_Edition%29

source_string: Restrict data assignment only to areas of your selection that have certain tags.
translation: Beheine de gegevenstawizing ta allinnich de gebieten fan dyn seleksje mei bepaalde tags.

source_string: Add Biome Tag to Allow List
Add a new biome tag to the list of allowed tags.
translation: Foegje in nije biome-tag ta oan de list fan tastiene tags.

source_string: Exclude areas with certain tags from data assignment.
translation: Slút gebieten mei bepaalde tags út fan de gegevenstawizing.

source_string: Add Biome Tag to Exclude List
Add a new biome tag to the list of excluded tags.
translation: Foegje in nije biome-tag ta oan de list fan útsletten tags.

source_string: Only show tags within active selection
translation: Toan allinnich tags binnen de aktive seleksje

source_string: When checked, the Add Biome Tag buttons will only show tags that are represented in the current selection.
translation: As dit oanfinke is, toane de knoppen "Biome-tag tafoegje" allinnich tags dy't fertsjintwurdige wurde yn de hjoeddeiske seleksje.

source_string: Overwrite biome data for the selected area, as modified by your tool settings.

source_string: When filling biomes, if any of the selected positions are in regions that have an assigned biome that is eligible for replacement but the position itself is not (due to the above filters), reassign those regions to a biome in this list instead of filling them with the selected biome.
